description: Steps to delete internet cookies and cache.
fullText:
Question
How do I clear cache and cookies
I want to submit final grades for my 8-week course but I am unable to access the Final Grade link in the Faculty Main Menu in SNAP.
I am unable to open D2L in Chrome. I get an error message.
I am unable to log into usd.myprintdesk.net
Error: Bad Request - Header Field Too Long
HTTP Error 400. A request header field is too long
Slido has not been loading for me when I attempt to create an account with Slido via Webex
Products or Services Involved
Google Chrome
Mozilla Firefox
Microsoft Edge
Safari
Instructions
Tips:
Updating to the latest version of the Internet browser may also need to be done
Reboot computer after completing steps below
Log out of any sync'd profiles in browser
If the option to clear Passwords and other sign-in data is checked, all login information will need to be re-entered
Steps to Clear Cache and Cookies in Windows
Google Chrome
Open Chrome
Press CTRL+SHIFT+DELETE keys at the same time
Select All time from the Time range list
Note: If set to the last hour it will not resolve your issue
Select Cached images and files
Select Cookies and other site data
Click Clear data
Mozilla Firefox
Open Firefox
Press CTRL+SHIFT+DELETE keys at the same time
Select Everything from the When: dropdown menu
Cookies and site data
Temporary cached files and pages
Click OK
Open Firefox
At the top right, click the Menu button
Select Settings
Click on Privacy & Security
In the Cookies and Site Data section, click Clear Data
Select Cookies and Site Data
Click Clear
Microsoft Edge
Open Microsoft Edge
Press CTRL+SHIFT+DELETE keys at the same time
Select Cached data and files
Select Cookies and saved website data
Click Clear
Steps to Clear Cache and Cookies in Mac OS
Safari
Open Safari
Click on Safari next to the Apple logo
Click Clear History...
Select all history
Click Clear History
Chrome
Open Chrome
Click More
Click Delete Browsing Data
Choose a time range. To delete everything select All time
Check the boxes next to Cookies and other site data and Cached images and files
Click Delete data
Firefox
Open Firefox
Click Firefox next to the Apple logo
Click Settings...
Click Privacy & Security
Under Cookies and Site Data click Clear Data...
Select Everything in the When: drop down menu
Check the boxes for:
History
Cookies and site data
Temporary cached files and pages
Site settings
Click Clear
Steps to Force Refresh
Open the Internet Browser
Press the SHIFT key and click Reload button in your browser
Need More Help?
If you need further assistance, please contact the Service Desk

cause: Multiple causes
description: Troubleshooting steps for a laptop that will not charge or power on
fullText:
Issue/Question
Laptop is not charging
Laptop is not turning on
Laptop battery was charged but laptop shutdown and will not turn back on
Battery does not last long enough
Error: plugged in, not charging
Laptop screen flashing different colors
Environment
Laptop
Cause
Multiple causes
Resolution
Note: If the laptop is almost completely charged, the docking station may be designed to work that way to prevent damage to the battery
Try holding power button down for 30-60 seconds
Try a different power outlet
Try a known good power adapter
Try removing the battery
Lenovo X1 Carbon, X1 Yoga, or T14 - Perform a hard reset
Turn laptop off
Remove the power adapter
Locate the small Reset hole on the bottom of the laptop
Use a paperclip to press the Reset Button for 5 seconds
Plug power adapter in
Turn system on
HP and Lenovo laptop - Perform a hard reset
Turn laptop off
Disconnect the power adapter
Press and hold down the power button for 30 seconds
Reconnect power adapter
Turn system on
Note: Lenovo How To's has more troubleshooting steps and video
Update operating system and drivers
Apple - Restart
Hold down power button for 15 seconds
Contact the Service Desk for further assistance

description: How to add or remove Owners to a Listserv
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
Adding Owners to a Listserv
I would like to be added as an administrator to a listserv
I would like to be added as an owner to a listserv list
I’d like to add colleagues to our listserv
How do I add people to a LISTSERV?
I cannot seem to get new members added to my Listserve Account
Could we please have the following members added to our email Lists?
How do I remove owners from a listserv
Environment
Listserv
Resolution
Note: listserv.usd.edu is only accessible on campus
Go to the Listserv web interface
Click Log In
Type your email address and Listserv password
Email address must be in First.Last format, and use your primary email address (First.Last@usd.edu for faculty and staff, First.Last@coyotes.usd.edu for students)
Your Listserv password is not tied to the password you use for email, the portal, etc
If you don't remember your Listserv password or don't yet have one, see Setting a New Listserv Password
From the List Management drop-down menu, select List Dashboard
Click the list of owners for the Listserv you want to make changes to
Note: If you are the only owner, it will show up as just your email address under the Owner's column
In box below Owner=
To Add type email addresses for Owners of the list on separate lines
To Remove: Delete the email address you want to remove
Note: Owners listed under Quiet: will not receive non-delivery notices
Note: USD email addresses must be in First.Last format and use the primary email address
Click Update at the top or bottom of the page
Note: May need to scroll to the side to see the Update button

description: What steps can be taken to lessen the amount of SPAM received in email? SPAM is unsolicited, unwanted emails typically sent for marketing purposes.
fullText:
Issue/Question
How do I stop SPAM email messages?
How do we go about blocking an email on our current outlook program?
Environment
Outlook Web Access
Outlook
SPAM
Cause
SPAM is unsolicited, unwanted emails typically sent for marketing purposes.
Resolution
Note: If the email address is listed in both Safe Senders and Blocked Senders, the email will not be blocked
Option 1: Add a sender or domain to blocked senders from Outlook Web Access
Log into Outlook
Click at top right corner
Click Junk email
Click Add under Blocked senders and domains
Example 1: To block a particular person at spammerdomain.com type person@spammerdomain.com
Example 2: To block all email at spammerdomain.com type spammerdomain.com
Click Save
Note: See Microsoft's documentation for more information
Option 2: Add a sender or domain to blocked senders from Outlook
At the top of the page, select Settings
Select Mail > Junk email
If you want to block an email address or domain, select Blocked senders and domains and select Add blocked sender. Enter the email address you'd like to block, or if you want to block all email from a domain, enter the domain name
Select OK, and then Save
Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance

How do I stop SPAM email messages?
How do we go about blocking an email on our current outlook program?

sections.heading: Environment
sections.text:
Outlook Web Access
Outlook
SPAM

sections.heading: Cause
sections.text: SPAM is unsolicited, unwanted emails typically sent for marketing purposes.

sections.heading: Resolution
sections.text:
Note: If the email address is listed in both Safe Senders and Blocked Senders, the email will not be blocked
Option 1: Add a sender or domain to blocked senders from Outlook Web Access
Log into Outlook
Click at top right corner
Click Junk email
Click Add under Blocked senders and domains
Example 1: To block a particular person at spammerdomain.com type person@spammerdomain.com
Example 2: To block all email at spammerdomain.com type spammerdomain.com
Click Save
Note: See Microsoft's documentation for more information
Option 2: Add a sender or domain to blocked senders from Outlook
At the top of the page, select Settings
Select Mail > Junk email
If you want to block an email address or domain, select Blocked senders and domains and select Add blocked sender. Enter the email address you'd like to block, or if you want to block all email from a domain, enter the domain name
Select OK, and then Save
Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance

title: Blocking SPAM in Outlook

cause: There are numerous reasons why an account can be compromised. Clicking on a suspicious link and entering USD credentials could be one of the causes.
description: If you notice suspicious activity on your account or have reason to believe your USD Account or USD email has been hacked/compromised, seek help immediately.
fullText:
Issue/Question
What do I do if I think my USD email account is compromised (hacked)?
Is my USD account compromised?
Environment
USD Account
USD Email
Cause
There are numerous reasons why an account can be compromised. Clicking on a suspicious link and entering USD credentials could be one of the causes.
Resolution
Note: If USD identifies your account has been compromised, We will disable the account and attempt to contact you by phone or alternate email address (if on file). If your account is disabled, You will need to contact the Service Desk to have it enabled before resetting your password.
Change your password immediately
Self-service Password Reset
Change your password to something completely different. Re-using the same password will allow the hacker back into your account
Select a strong password you haven't used before.
If you have used the same password for other services, we encourage you to change those passwords to something unique as well
If you think that your account may have been compromised, contact the Service Desk immediately to secure your account.

Cause

How to Deposit Money to Coyote Card
Types of Funds:
Coyote Cash
Debit account that can be used at all flex locations, as well as many locations around Vermillion
Funds can be used all year round and remain on your account per policy
You may also use Coyote Cash at on-campus vending and laundry machines
Printing funds when USD Print Debit funds have been depleted
Flex
Dollars that will come out of your selected meal plan each semester
You may carry over flex dollars from fall to spring semesters
You CANNOT carry over after the spring semester
If you run out of flex, you may purchase additional add-on flex dollars
Note: keep an eye out for promotions featured by Campus Dining! Bonus Flex dollars are frequently offered
Print Funds
Anyone with a current Coyote Card and USD username and password can print in any of the labs where printing is available
Note: Visit the Coyote Card Office in the MUC to obtain a Coyote Card and visit Accounts Pickup to determine your USD username
There is a $24 printing quota for a regular Fall/Spring academic year
Note: If only taking one semester, such as Spring or Summer only, each student receives $12 in USD Print Fund printing quota
for more details see Printing

fullText:

Dental Hygiene Evaluations
Cause
Clinical Faculty is not active

Go to Student Tracking and login
Hover over the Dental Hygiene menu option in the left-hand navigation menu

If they are active, you will see them in the list of active Clinical Faculty and can skip the next steps. Instead, please contact the Help Desk for assistance.
Uncheck the Show Active checkbox
Click the magnifying glass icon next to the person's name
In the person's profile page, if the Active checkbox is not checked, check it
Click Save
Ask the Clinical Faculty to resubmit the form

environment:

footer:
Printing refunds are only issued when a problem has occurred with the printer resulting in a damaged print job, or if the document failed to print at all (needs to be evident in the job log).
Examples include a printer jam, smearing, ripping, etc.
Refunds are NOT available for misprints, incorrect page format, accidental amount of copies, document typos, etc.
Money will be refunded to your PaperCut account once the refund is fully processed by our Service Desk.
Note: Refunds are only usable within the Student Printing system. It does not refund back to Coyote Cash. You will carry a balance in Student Printing system which will be used first the next time you print.
Pages that aren’t successfully printed will be refunded automatically as PaperCut can detect if a print job is successfully delivered
Your documents are only stored on the print server for 1 hour before they are deleted and refunded automatically
After 24 hours they will be unable to assist you
Contact the Service Desk immediately Report an Incident
Include the date and time of the print
Printer/Copier location
If the print was of poor quality, please hold onto it while we investigate the Refund Request
Note: Print funds are refunded to PaperCut, This balance will need to be viewed on a Multifunction device and is not shown on eAccounts

description: How to list all subscribers of a Listserv
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
Listing the subscribers of a Listserv
Environment
Listserv 17.0
Resolution
Go to the Listserv web interface
Click Log In
Type your email address and Listserv password
Email address must be in First.Last format, and use your primary email address
Note: First.Last@usd.edu for faculty and staff, First.Last@coyotes.usd.edu for students
Your Listserv password is not tied to the password you use for email, the portal, etc.
If you don't remember your Listserv password or don't yet have one, see Setting a New Listerv Password
Click Log In
Click Subscribers Reports in the left hand column
Select your list from the Select List: pulldown
You will now see the users added directly to the list in the browser
Note: if this a query based list click LISTSERV Command in the left column and enter REVIEW ListName-LIST RCPT in the Command: field, this will send you an email of all query recipients

footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
Outlook closing when sending or deleting emails
Outlook will not send items. I also cannot delete anything
Outlook opens two windows
Trying to add Zoom meeting in Outlook opens a blank web page
Errors have been detected in the file C:\users\first.last\AppData\Local\Microsoft\Outlook\First.Last@usd.edu.ost.

Environment
Outlook 2013
Outlook 2016
Outlook 365
Resolution
If able to open Outlook, try signing out of your Office account and then sign in again:

Click Office Account
Click Sign out
Click Sign out
Click Sign in and enter USD credentials
Reboot the computer
Uninstall Office and install the latest version of Office 365
Delete Outlook .ost data file
Close Outlook
Open File Explorer
Paste %localappdata%\Microsoft\outlook into the Address Bar
Press Enter
Find the .ost file that the error message reported, and delete it
Start Outlook
Recreate Outlook Profile
If unable to send a specific email message, recreate the message and attempt to send the new message

Can't print PDFs but can print other items

Some pages printing in wrong orientation
Some pages have different fonts than are set
Some PDFs have some sections of text missing
Error: An error occurred while printing the document
Environment
Windows OS
Adobe Acrobat
Network or Local Printer
Cause
Multiple causes
Resolution
Try printing other PDF files to identify if the problem is only with one file
Verify that the page orientation print setting is correct for the PDF being printed
Verify if there are multiple versions of Adobe installed
Note: If multiple versions are installed, try printing from other versions
Set Internet Browser(s) to always open PDFs in Adobe Acrobat instead of showing a preview
Set Adobe Acrobat to Print as Image
Open the PDF in Acrobat
Click File
Click Print
Select the printer from the drop down menu
Click Advanced
Check Print as Image
Click OK
Click Print
Change printer settings to Optimize for Text and Vector
Open the PDF in Acrobat
Click File
Click Print
Click Properties
Click the Advanced tab
Under Print Data Optimization select Optimize for Text and Vector
Click OK
Click Print
Contact the Service Desk to have your printer drivers updated

description: Set up the fax function
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
Our fax machine hasn’t been receiving faxes. Please send someone to look at it.
Environment
Fax Machine
Resolution
Note: ITS only supports Fax on Sharp Multifunction Copiers. All other requests on Vermillion campus should be directed to Facilities Management for support. Problems with the fax phone lines at the Yankton Med campus should be handled by Avera.
Find manual and follow steps to set the fax phone number
Send a test fax to 1-855-FX-CANON (1-855-392-2666)
To see when the last fax was received on the Copier,
Go to the Copier Tap Job Status key on the home screen
Tap Fax tab, and then tap the Complete key to display past receive history
Contact sender and have them verify that other machines are able to receive their faxes
Plug in TEST ANALOG phone
Pickup Handset and you should hear dialtone
Call that specific Fax Number and test that the Analog phone rings
Note: (If you only get busy signal it is possible the phone is plugged into non configured port on the voice gateway)
Dial your cell number from the Analog Phone to test other way
Unplug the phone line and plug fax back in
Verify Faxing Works

Environment
Smart Classroom
SMART board
Cause
SMART Ink is not enabled
An issue with the touch driver on the computer
Resolution
Go to the Windows Start Menu
Locate SMART Technologies
Click SMART Settings
Click SMART Ink Settings
Verify that SMART Ink is turned on
If it is set to OFF, Turn On SMART Ink
Click Apply and OK
Close the SMART Settings window
Try using a pen
Still unable to use a pen to write see step 11
Locate the Purple puck on the instructor desk with 3 USB cable attached
Reseat the middle cable
Wait for the LED on the side of the SMART board to turn solid green
Try the SMART board again
In SMART Settings, select About Software and Product Support > Tools > Diagnostics. Select Service > Stop and then Service > Start.
Try the SMART board again

description: How to fix sound issues in classrooms
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
The sound from the projector is not working
Volume control is not working
Sound is not coming from the speakers
Sound from microphone is distorted
Environment
Classroom
Cause
Computer output device not set correctly
Audio mixer lost settings
Sound amplifier is powered off
Volume is turned down on sound amplifier
Resolution
Check the Computer Sound Settings:
Make sure computer sound is not muted
Make sure computer sound is turned up
Check playback device
For PC's do the following:
Right click in task bar
Click Open Sound Settings
Verify correct device under Choose your output device
For Macs do the following:
Click System Preferences
Click Sound
Click Output
Verify if correct device is selected
Check the Room System Sound Settings:
On the Crestron panel, verify that the Mute button is not enabled
On the Crestron panel, press repeatedly to increase the volume
Microphone volume settings may be accessed by pressing Advanced Settings
Note: Advanced Settings are not available in all rooms
Rooms with Sound Amplifiers:
Check the sound amplifier is powered on
Check the volume knobs are not turned down
Restart the Classroom Equipment:
Power down the system by pressing Exit or End Class on the Crestron touch panel or XPanel application
Select YES to end class or meeting
Wait 1-2 minutes for the projector to cool down
Turn system on again from Crestron panel or XPanel application

Microsoft Outlook 365
Microsoft Outlook Online (OWA)
Instructions
Outlook default is set to cache only 12 months of email
Tips:
Shared Mailbox settings will be the same as the main email account
Turn off cached mode to show all emails
Older emails for individual and departmental or organizational mailboxes can also be viewed through Outlook Online (OWA)

Double click the user's name in the Name/Type box
Slide the slider to the length of time wanted
Click Next
Click Finish
Restart Outlook
Outlook 365

Click Account Settings
Click Account Settings
Double-Click the user's email address in the Name/Type box
Slide the slider to the length of time wanted
Click Next
Click Done
Restart Outlook

description: How to block a phone number from calling your office phone
environment: Cisco Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) Phone
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:

I am receiving a large number of unwanted robocalls or sales calls
I need a phone number blocked from calling my office phone
I received a call from Loraine from Adobe Events Team about Adobe Acrobat VIP/Perpetual Licenses
Environment
Cisco Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) Phone
Resolution
Call blocking is not an effective deterrent for unwanted sales calls, SPAM, and robocalls
Please see The FCC's guide on stopping unwanted robocalls and optionally file a complaint
Block requests for these types of calls will not be approved
If the unwanted calls pose a potential safety issue:
File an Informational Report with the University Police Department with the number and reason for the block
Contact the Service Desk with the case number to create a Service Request for approval

Error: In 30 days, the membership giving you access to Creative Cloud will expire. Please contact your administrator for additional assistance
Error: Please update your billing information to avoid losing access to Illustrator CC
Environment
Adobe Creative Cloud
Cause
Annual renewal process not yet completed
Resolution
Note: Adobe Creative Cloud licenses renew each September 14. The renewal window is August 14 to October 14. Your existing license will continue to work until Oct 14.
Renewal process:
ITS will contact each department to confirm the number of licenses that need to be renewed.
ITS will then issue a single purchase order for the campus to renew the licenses and bill each department for their licenses.
Once Adobe processes the purchase order, your license will renew automatically.
Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance

description: How to help keep your computer clean with free antivirus software provided through the myUSD Portal
footer: Please contact the service desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
Could you recommend a free program that would be a good one to use
Environment
Personal Computer
Resolution
Note: Windows computers come with Defender, otherwise you will want to purchase Anti-Virus software that best fits your needs
If a program looks to good to be true, it probably is
The number one source of spyware infections is free software programs you download from the Internet
Pay careful attention to what you are downloading
Know what other programs it may bring into your PC along with the original file
Practice Safe Surfing
Avoid websites that offer unscrupulous content such as pirated software or adult material
These sites are notorious for spreading spyware
Secure your browser
Set your browser's security settings high enough (Medium on Internet Explorer) to protect yourself from "drive-by-downloads"or Automatic installation of unwanted programs
Delete Spam
Email is a common delivery vehicle for spyware
Delete messages from unknown senders
Use caution with any email containing an attachment, even if it's from someone you know
Beware of peer-to-peer file sharing services (P2P)
P2P networks such as Kazaa, Limewire, Morpheus etc. often install spyware and/or viruses onto your PC when you sign up for their services
Another reason to be cautious of P2P is that the files you may be swapping and sharing (photos, music, videos or games) often contain spyware and/or viruses
Install Windows Updates
Windows updates will ensure that your computer is up-to-date with new features and the latest security.
Run anti-spyware software
You may purchase your own software or use one of these well-known software with a free trial
Malwarebytes
Superantispyware

description: Creating a Backup .PST File of your emails
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:

I would like a copy of my emails
Can you transfer my emails to a new account?
Environment
Microsoft Outlook
Resolution
Creating a Backup .PST File
Open Microsoft Outlook (Classic)
Click File in the top left
Select Open & Export
Select Import/Export
Select Export to a file
Click Next
Select Outlook Data File (.pst)
Click Next
Select the mail folder you want to back up and select Next
Click Browse
Select the location where you want the new .PST file to be saved
Create and name the .PST File for your USD emails
Click Finish
Moving Emails from a .PST File to Outlook
Open a different email account in Microsoft Outlook
In Outlook, select the File tab
In the Open category
Click Import
In the Import and Export Wizard, select Important from another program or file
Click Next
Select Browse and select the .PST File to import
Click Next
Select the folder that you would like to import
Note: To import everything in the .PST File, select the top of the hierarchy
Note: The top folder (usually Personal Folders, Outlook Data File, or your email address) is selected automatically. Include subfolders is selected by default. All folders under the folder selected will be imported
Click Finish

description: Calls to main department lines are often set up to go to a group of users called a hunt group. If a user is logged out of the hunt group, they will no longer receive the calls.
environment:
Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) Phones
Hunt Groups
Main Departmental Phone Lines
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
I am no longer receiving calls from our main line hunt group
One of our phones is no longer in the call rotation
Calls aren't rolling over to one of our phones
Environment
Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) Phones
Hunt Groups
Main Departmental Phone Lines
Cause
The phone has logged out of the hunt group
Resolution
Note: If you are a member of a hunt group your phone should have AgPickup, AgSignIn/AgsignOut, AgStatus buttons along the bottom of the screen
Note: If you have a green check mark beside your name - you are signed into your hunt group.
Login to the hunt group
Click the AgSignIn button below the bottom of the screen
Hit the AgStatus
Select 1 on the keypad to be available on the hunt group (green check mark should be beside name on phone)
logout of the hunt group
Select AgSignOut to log out of the hunt group
OR - click on AgStatus and click 2 on the keypad for unavailable

cause:
Volume not set correctly
Bluetooth pairing is malfunctioning
description: During a call, a headset used for voip loses its connection and the call remains active
fullText:
Issue/Question
Wireless headset drops its connecting during a call on a Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) phone
Headset from my phone is no longer working
There is a bad echo on our headsets people cannot talk or hear me
Wireless headset disconnects from computer when receiving or ending calls
Environment
VoIP
Plantronics
Jabra
Cause
Volume not set correctly
Bluetooth pairing is malfunctioning
Resolution
Adjust the volume setting on the headset and VOIP phone
Follow Changing Audio Output to Speakers to switch to the correct audio output devices
Power-cycle the phone by unplugging it and plugging it back in
Follow Jabra Headset Losing Phone Connection when Paired to Computer
If you hear an echo or feedback with your headset, it may be caused by your Microphone Volume being set slightly louder than it needs to be
Note: You will always hear a little of your voice come through your headset speaker, which is called side tone. If you have too much side tone causing echo, turn down your Microphone Volume on the base of your headset enough so your caller still hears you comfortably, but enough so the side tone is not distracting to you.
For Plantronics brand headsets, change the configuration switch to a different setting
Please Contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance

Respondus LockDown Browser
Desire2Learn (D2L)

Close out of open Applications
Connect to the network using an ethernet cable if possible
Click on the Quiz to start Lockdown Browser

Close out of the exam and re-open it
Note: As long as there is time remaining, you will not need to use another Attempt to access the exam

description: Projector issues in a classroom
fullText:
Issue/Question
The projector will not power on, will not power off or doesn't display an image.
The smart panel turns on, as does the computer screen, but no image shoots from the projector to the screen.
Projector displays a gray image
SMART display will not power off
Environment
Smart Classroom
Conference room
XPanel
Resolution
Check to see if the light on the projector is green
If not, turn off the system via XPanel
wait 2 minutes and restart the system
If the projector light is green and still not working
check to see if the display is muted in XPanel
If the projector is not muted, check to see if the proper input source is selected on xPanel or via the manual switch (if present)
SMART display that does not have a Crestron touch panel or XPanel, try using the power button on the SMART display to turn the TV off or try changing batteries in the remote
If still not working, contact the Service Desk for further assistance

cause: Holding a web conference in a meeting room that does not have built-in web conferencing equipment
description: Instructions for setting up Web Conferencing in conference rooms across campus that are not equipped with cameras, microphones, or speakers
environment:
Classroom or Conference Room with Projector or Display
Web Conferencing
USD Main Campus (Vermillion)
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
How do I set up web conferencing in the various conference rooms and classrooms on campus?
Environment
Classroom or Conference Room with Projector or Display
Web Conferencing
USD Main Campus (Vermillion)
Cause
Holding a web conference in a meeting room that does not have built-in web conferencing equipment
Resolution
If you do not have a webcam and the room is not equipped with a webcam, check out a USB web conference camera from our Equipment Checkout Service.
Note: If video is not needed you can check out a USB microphone instead. You can also use a conference phone for audio if your WebConferencing service supports it.
Connect your laptop to the projector or TV with HDMI or VGA Cables
Note: If you are using VGA you will also need to plug in the 1/8" audio cable into the headphone jack for sound.
Connect the web conference camera or microphone to the computer via USB
Launch your web conferencing software and select the web conference camera as the video device and audio input device
Select the correct audio output device:
Crestron if using HDMI
Headphones if using VGA and 1/8" audio
Test call with someone to verify they can see and hear you and you can see and hear them

Can open all files in a folder but one document on the network share. I get the following error:
Error: Access denied
Environment
Windows 10
Network (X) drive
Cause
File saved with wrong permissions
Permissions have changed
Resolution
Note: If a Word document is emailed to another who converts it to PDF, the Word document needs to be saved then opened. If the Word document is opened directly from Outlook, it opens in Read Only and those permissions are transferred to the PDF.
Contact owner of the document
Ask them to open and re-save the document
Refresh document folder
Try accessing the document again

Click on Word in the menu bar
Click on Sign Out...
Click on Sign In
Sign in with your USD email address and password
If still not working, uninstall and reinstall the app
If still having the issue follow Unable to Activate Office on a Mac

description: How to create a DocuSign template for electronic signature
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
I need a template created in DocuSign for electronic signature
Environment
DocuSign
Resolution
Note: Templates must be digitally accessible. See Guidelines for Accessible Documents
Log into the DocuSign TEST Environment
Enter your USD email address
Select the blue Use Company log in button
Click Templates
Click New Template
Note: If New Template is missing see Requesting Access to DocuSign
Enter a name and description for your template
Upload one or more documents for signature
Click UPLOAD
Select your file(s)
Click ADD SELECTED
Add recipient roles and any named recipients
Note: See Bulk Send for Multiple Recipients to send to document to multiple recipients
To set a routing order for your document follow the regular procedure described in Add Recipients
To define a standard email message for your template, or to add private messages for individual recipients, follow the regular procedure described in Add Messages
To set the signing fields for your document, click NEXT
To add signing fields for each of your template recipients, follow the regular procedure described in Add Fields to Documents
To finish your template, click SAVE AND CLOSE
Your template is saved and ready to use
Submit DocuSign Template Move Request to move to Production

description: Information on Sanford School of Medicine Laptop recommendation and how to purchase
environment:
Incoming med school student
Med School Laptop
Physician Assistant Laptop
fullText:
Issue/Question
Requesting information on a laptop for medical school
I will be attending USD's medical school in July and will need to purchase a computer
Will my laptop meet the requirements for the Sanford School of Medicine (SSOM)?
What are the computer system requirements for med school?
Environment
Incoming med school student
Med School Laptop
Physician Assistant Laptop
Resolution
Minimum System Requirements for Med School Testing Platforms (reviewed 7/15/2026)
Note: The SSOM uses ExamSoft Examplify and National Board of Medical Examiners (NBME) testing platforms. The requirements below incorporate the requirements of those two platforms.
All Laptops
1GHz processor or higher
4GB of usable RAM or higher
4GB or higher of available storage space
Minimum screen resolution of 1280x768 with a 32-bit color setting and scaling set to 100%
13” screen or larger
Both wired and wireless network connection capability
Administrator-level account permissions
English (United States) Language
Virtual machines and applications are not allowed
Only genuine versions of Windows or Mac Operating Systems are supported
Current, or one previous version of Safari, Chrome, Firefox, or Edge
Windows Systems
x86 or ARM CPU Processor
ARM Processors are only supported on Windows 11 24H2 and higher
64-bit version of Windows 11 (23H2, 24H2, or 25H2)
Windows 11 S mode is not compatible
ASUS Laptops with touchpad/touchscreen are not allowed
For support, a working USB port, flash drive and account passwords, including BitLocker keys may be required
Mac Systems
Intel or M series processor
Mac OS v14, v15, or v16 (Sonoma, Sequoia, or Tahoe)
Server version of Mac OS X is not supported
For support, a working USB port and account passwords may be required
Note: Laptops may be available for purchase from USD. See Buying a Laptop from USD for Personal Use
Please contact the Service Desk for additional information

What are the computer system requirements for med school?

sections.heading: Environment
sections.text:
Incoming med school student
Med School Laptop
Physician Assistant Laptop

sections.heading: Resolution
sections.text:
Minimum System Requirements for Med School Testing Platforms (reviewed 7/15/2026)
Note: The SSOM uses ExamSoft Examplify and National Board of Medical Examiners (NBME) testing platforms. The requirements below incorporate the requirements of those two platforms.
All Laptops
1GHz processor or higher
4GB of usable RAM or higher
4GB or higher of available storage space
Minimum screen resolution of 1280x768 with a 32-bit color setting and scaling set to 100%
13” screen or larger
Both wired and wireless network connection capability
Administrator-level account permissions
English (United States) Language
Virtual machines and applications are not allowed
Only genuine versions of Windows or Mac Operating Systems are supported
Current, or one previous version of Safari, Chrome, Firefox, or Edge
Windows Systems
x86 or ARM CPU Processor
ARM Processors are only supported on Windows 11 24H2 and higher
64-bit version of Windows 11 (23H2, 24H2, or 25H2)
Windows 11 S mode is not compatible
ASUS Laptops with touchpad/touchscreen are not allowed
For support, a working USB port, flash drive and account passwords, including BitLocker keys may be required
Mac Systems
Intel or M series processor
Mac OS v14, v15, or v16 (Sonoma, Sequoia, or Tahoe)
Server version of Mac OS X is not supported
For support, a working USB port and account passwords may be required
Note: Laptops may be available for purchase from USD. See Buying a Laptop from USD for Personal Use
Please contact the Service Desk for additional information

staffOnly.text: Follow Laptop Purchase Process

Purchasing University software

Item is not listed in the SDezBuy catalog

Note: You will need permissions to SDezBuy to assign and create carts
Login to SDezbuy directly or via SNAP
Click Non-Catalog Item
Type information based on the quote provided by supplier
Search for Supplier
Select Order From Fulfillment Address
Enter Product Description
Note: For maintenance subscriptions, enter dates of coverage. For renewals, some vendors will require serial numbers. These get added to the Product Description with dates of coverage
Enter Part Number as Catalog Number
Update Quantity
Update Price Estimate
Packaging
Note: For maintenance subscriptions enter 1
Click Save or Save and Add Another
When all items have been added, click Save
Click Cart
Click View My Cart
Update Cart Name (something applicable)
Update Requested Delivery Date
Update Quote/Contract Number
Review item number, Unit Price, Quantity, Price
Update Commodity Code
38100 Computer PC Based
38800 – networking hardware, cables,
38650 Computer Peripherals drive ,etc.
39000 Software
39100 Software-Hosted, Cloud, Software as a Service Agreement
39400 Computer Supplies
39500 Information Technology & Telecommunicate SVS (maintenance and renewals)
51500 Freight charges (lined item if we are charged)
Click Proceed to Checkout
Click General tab
Click Edit
Click Select a different user
Enter the last name of superuser
Click Select
Click Save
Go to Comments Tab to add comments if applicable
Note: Use comments field if note to Assignee is needed to clarify a fund source, rebilling, change to budget, etc.
Note: If cart is for software that must be purchased with a procurement card, indicate this in the comment so requisition can be cancelled after ITS approval
Note: For Lee Med orders include comment with requestor name and Index number provided by requestor
Go to Summary Tab
Go to Attachments Tab
Click Add Internal Attachment
Click Browse to add attachement
Click Save Changes
Click Assign Cart
Start typing in the First name of superuser
Click Assign
After cart is assigned copy the Requisition Summary Information
If there is an existing TD Ticket,
Paste Requisition Summary Information in the ticket.
Change ticket status to In Progress
Add Task Template – inventory Check-in Process
If new ticket is needed:
Open Outlook and find email received from SDezBuy
Click Forward Email
Update Recipient to itops@usd.edu to create TD ticket
Rename subject to Purchase Req [Req #] [Item] [Supplier]
e.g. Purchase Req 175195665 Jabra Headset Amazon
In email add "Assign to XXXX"
Paste Requisition Summary information into body of email
If punchout, then send email
If quote, attach quote so it is attached to the TD ticket.
Order processed in Banner
Order received, enter in to be receipted in Banner
Add to Inventory, if applicable

cause:
To ensure the reliability, security, and performance of our email system, we are implementing sending limits for emails.
Here’s why this change is essential:
Preventing Spam and Abuse: Setting limits helps protect our domain reputation by reducing the risk of unauthorized use or accidental spam-like activity. This prevents USD email from being blocked by services like GMAIL.
Ensuring Deliverability: High email volumes can trigger spam filters, causing delays or rejections. Limits help maintain efficient and successful email delivery.
Enhancing Security: Restricting large-scale email sends minimizes exposure to phishing attacks and misuse of accounts if they are compromised.
Fair Resource Use: Limits ensure equitable access to resources, preventing email system slowdowns for everyone.
The limit of, 500 recipients per message, is designed to support your communication needs while protecting the email ecosystem. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation in keeping our email system secure and efficient.
description: How to send emails to a large number of recipients.
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance.
fullText:

I am no longer able to send out a newsletter

Subject of email received: High-severity alert: User restricted from sending email
Environment
USD Email
Outlook
Cause
To ensure the reliability, security, and performance of our email system, we are implementing sending limits for emails.
Here’s why this change is essential:
Preventing Spam and Abuse: Setting limits helps protect our domain reputation by reducing the risk of unauthorized use or accidental spam-like activity. This prevents USD email from being blocked by services like GMAIL.
Ensuring Deliverability: High email volumes can trigger spam filters, causing delays or rejections. Limits help maintain efficient and successful email delivery.
Enhancing Security: Restricting large-scale email sends minimizes exposure to phishing attacks and misuse of accounts if they are compromised.
Fair Resource Use: Limits ensure equitable access to resources, preventing email system slowdowns for everyone.
The limit of, 500 recipients per message, is designed to support your communication needs while protecting the email ecosystem. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation in keeping our email system secure and efficient.
Resolution
Exceeding the current protection settings will block outbound mail for the sender
If you need to send to more than 500 recipients please request a LISTSERV list.
Request Marketing to facilitate an email to faculty and staff, current students and/or prospective students
Complete the form at Email Marketing & Internal Communications Support Request

description: How to fix email undeliverable messages when the message says the address information is outdated.
environment:

Outlook

Office 365
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
Getting undeliverable message when trying to send e-mail message to someone
Error: Your email program is using outdated address information
Error: Status code: 550 5.1.11
Environment
Exchange
Outlook
Outlook on the web
Office 365
Cause
Cached email address is no longer correct
Resolution
Identify the recipient who didn't receive your message
Check the To or CC information located in the Original Message Headers section below
Names followed by a set of characters that start with IMCEAEX or imceaex didn't receive your message
Click New mail (in Outlook) or New Email (in Outlook on the web)
Begin typing the recipient's name or email address in the To box
The recipient's name appears in the drop-down list
Select the recipient from the list
Press the Delete key to delete the Auto-Complete List entry
Type the recipient's full email address in the To box
Send the message
For more information, see Microsoft's support document on how to fix email delivery issues for error code 550 5.1.1 through 5.1.20 in Office 365

cause:
User has not been assigned to the appropriate permissions group in Cognos
OR
You are running the report from a stale link in your Recents links
OR
The link that was sent to you includes a perspective=authoring clause and you do not have report author access
description: Provide information to the Help Desk to request the correct permissions
fullText:
Issue/Question
Unable to run Reports
A cognos report is not working.
Error: You do not have access to this report content or the content has moved.
Error: Unable to find the connection ODS in the content store
Error: Data source adapter error: java.sql.SQLException: ORA-01427: single-row subquery returns more than one row
Run report behind the scene to excel and I never received email with the report
A link was sent to me, I have access, but the prompts do not appear, it takes me to a login page.
Environment
Cognos
Cause
User has not been assigned to the appropriate permissions group in Cognos
OR
You are running the report from a stale link in your Recents links
OR
The link that was sent to you includes a perspective=authoring clause and you do not have report author access
Resolution
If you are running the report from a link in Recents, hover over the blue link to the report to find out the path to the report (for example, the "SAS115 GL Level 6 report")
If the path contains 'Obsolete' or 'Archive', then you are running an old version of the report
To correct this, follow the path to the folder BEFORE the Archive or Obsolete folder
For instance, if the path to the report is: Team content > Banner > USD > Common Departmental Reports > SAS 115 > Obsolete, navigate to the Team content >Banner > USD > Common Departmental Reports > SAS 115 folder
Execute the "SAS115 GL Level 6 report" report from that folder
Your Recents will now contain a link to the "SAS115 GL Level 6 report" in the correct location
If you need further assistance, follow the instructions in 2, below
If you are running from a link you were sent, login to Cognos without using the link, then navigate to where the report lives and run it directly from the folder
Please contact the service desk with the following information:
Name of Cognos Report
Location of Cognos Report
Error Message received
User ID
Phone number

cause: Files were deleted
description: Restore missing files from the OneDrive Recycle Bin
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
Files are missing from my OneDrive account
My files disappeared from their folders in OneDrive
Files show up on my Onedrive website, but not on my computer
Environment
Onedrive
Cause
Files were deleted
Resolution
Note: When a file has been deleted in OneDrive it can be recovered from the recycle bins for up to 93 days
Verify you are Signed Into Onedrive with your USD account
Go to C: Users\your_username\OneDrive for Business-Unsynced Changes
Right Click File(s)
Select Move to OneDrive
Go to www.office.com/onedrive
Sign in with your USD username and password
Click Recycle bin
Select the missing files
Click Restore
If the missing files are not in the Recycle bin click Second-stage recycle bin.
Select the missing files
Click Restore
Note: If the missing file(s) are not in the recycle bin or the second-stage recycle bin, the files cannot be recovered

footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance

How to do a video conference call in a classroom
How to use the classroom panel for a video conference
How to do a presentation in video conference mode
How to connect to a video conference in a conference room
Environment
Classroom
Video Conference
Conference room
Cause
Video conferencing equipment must be initialized in the room to allow remote sites to connect
Resolution
Tap the screen on the Crestron touch panel in the room to activate
Tap the Video Conference Mode button
Note: The display screens will come on, or the projector screen will come down and projector will turn on - wait for the progress bar on the Crestron touch panel to finish
If the video conference meeting\class is set up to Auto-dial proceed to step 10
On the lower right of the touch panel, tap Call Setup
If you are connecting to persistent meeting or endpoint
Tap Phonebook
Select address from Directory
Tap Dial Selection
If you are connecting with a meeting address:
Enter the meeting address provided by scheduler or requester (the numbers listed before @usd.edu)
Tap Default below Call Type
Tap Call
Once connected, tap Close once
Tap Main Camera or Aux Camera depending on which image should be shown at the remote site
Note: Use camera control buttons to pan/tilt/zoom cameras as needed
To share content to remote site
On the Crestron touch panel, select desired input
Note: Select Room PC if you are sharing from instructors screen, Doc Cam or Laptop Cable can also be used to present
Tap Content On
Tap End Class once finished
Confirm exit by tapping Yes

Restart DUO device

Open the Cisco AnyConnect VPN Client on your computer

Click Connect
Enter your user name and password
After your password type a comma and the passcode displayed on your phone (example xxxxxxxx,948233)
Click OK

description: How to conference in another person to an active phone call
footer: Please contact the helpdesk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
How do I start a 3-way conference call
Environment
Cisco VOIP (voice over internet protocol) 8851
Cause
Need to add a 3rd person to the call
Resolution
During an active call, press the soft key on the phone display screen
Press the Conference soft key
Active call will be placed on hold and a second line will be activated with dial tone
Dial the second person's phone number
Once the second person answers, press the Conference soft key again
All 3 people will now be on a conference call
Please contact the helpdesk if you need further assistance

Environment
Windows
7-Zip
Cause
New course stored in compressed folders on website that needed to be usable after download
.7z files need to use 7Zip
Resolution
To Unzip a Single Zip File or Folder
Open the zipped folder
Drag the file(s) or folder(s) from the zipped folder to a new location
To Unzip All the Contents of the Zipped Folder
Right-click on the folder
Select Extract All
Follow the on-screen instructions
Download and install 7-Zip from https://www.7-zip.org/ or ninite.com to expand .7z, .tar, and .gz files

description: How to get your FTP password reset
environment:
Secure File Transfer Protocol (SFTP)
SFTP client, i.e., FileZilla, WinSCP
PuTTy (solely used to reset password)
fullText:
Issue/Question
I have forgotten my FTP password.
I cannot log into FTP and I am receiving the following error
Error: You entered an invalid login name or password
I try connecting with FileZilla, it says connected, then shows the error below and is disconnected
Error: Connection closed by server with exitcode 255
Error: Connection has been unexpectedly closed. Server sent command exit status 255
Error: Cannot initialize SFTP protocol. Is the host running an SFTP server?
Environment
Secure File Transfer Protocol (SFTP)
SFTP client, i.e., FileZilla, WinSCP
PuTTy (solely used to reset password)
Resolution
If you know your current password, try reset it
Start the PuTTy application
Connect to ftp.prod.sdbor.edu
Enter your user ID and password and press Enter (if resetting, you will have received the credentials to use for initial setup)
When prompted to change password
Enter your Current Password and press Enter
Enter your New Password and press Enter
Enter your New Password a second time and press Enter
If you've entered the information correctly, the PuTTy window will disapear
You should now be able to sign in with Filezilla or WinSCP using the new password
If you are still having issues, contact the Service Desk with the following information:
Error message or attachment
FTP Username

description: Forwarding of phones to another number or cell phone
fullText:
Issue/Question
Needs assistance in forwarding phone
I need my calls to go to someone else if I don't answer
Environment
Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP)
Resolution
Note: USD is currently switching to a different VOIP system. The steps will vary based on if your phone has been updated
Call forwarding can be initiated in multiple ways
From the physical phone
Press the button under ….. until you see Forward
Select the option you want to change using down on middle circular button on phone
Press button under Select
Press the right side of circular button to turn option On
Press down on circular button and enter destination's phone number including area code (605-658-xxxx)
Press down on circular button and enter the number of rings you want your phone to ring before forwarding
Press the button under Set
Press Back arrow to Exit out of menu
Make a test call to ensure the forwarding was successful
Note: If forwarding to a long-distance number, any forwarded call may have applicable long distance fees billed to the voip number (605-357-XXXX)
If your phone has the Coyotes Mascot Head image
From the Webex web portal
Sign in to the Webex web portal
Click Settings
Click Calling
Toggle Call Forwarding. in the Call forwarding section
Check the preferred option
Forward all calls, Forward calls during busy lines, or Forward calls when not answered
Click Save
Once checked, a phone number can then be entered
Note: Add number without 9 or 9-1
Click Save
From Webex
Open Webex
Click Call settings in the bottom left corner
Click Open Call Preferences
Click add number
Once added, the option to forward to that number will be available
Review the other preferences if needed
Click Save
Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance

fullText:
Issue/Question
How to start using Zoom through USD
I was wondering if there is a cheat sheet or training doc on this new Zoom tool
Do you have a document on how to use Zoom for conference calls?
Is Zoom Webinar included in our license

Is there a way to set up a Zoom account through the University so we don't have to pay for it individually?
Environment
Zoom
Web Conferencing
Resolution
Note: Zoom Webinar is not included in the USD license
Note: Zoom invitation emails embed the password in the link. If you click on the link, it should not ask you to type in a password
Using Zoom outside of D2L
Go to https://usd.zoom.us/
Click Sign in
Choose Work or School account if prompted
Note: This will create your Zoom account
Use your USD login credentials when prompted to log in
Go to Meetings tab and schedule meeting
Note: Self-paced training is available Using Zoom outside of D2L
Note: Additional information is available through the Zoom Help Center
Using Zoom in D2L
Open your course
In the Navigation Bar Click Communication
Click Zoom
Note: Self-paced training is available Using Zoom in D2L
Using Zoom on Desktop Application
Download Zoom application
Install from downloaded file
Open Zoom application
Sign in
Click SSO
Enter USD as Company Domain
Click Continue
Sign in inside web browser window that it opens
Using Zoom on Mobile Device
If you are experiencing issues, update the Zoom client through your app store
Note: When using a Student Basic account, if the meeting exceeds 2 attendees, up to 100 attendees there is a 40 minute time limit. If using a faculty or Licensed account the maximum number of meeting attendees is 300 with no time limit.
Zoom Outlook Plugin Information
Please visit Zoom's support site to get information on how to set up the Zoom Outlook Plugin

description: What to do if the mic in your classroom is not working
fullText:
Issue/Question
The wireless microphone is not working in a classroom
The Microphone has feedback noise
The Wireless Microphone was broken
The students can't hear in Zoom when using the wireless mic and bodypack
Environment
Smart Classroom
Zoom
Microphones
Cause
Multiple causes
Resolution
Check the Mic Level adjustment page on XPanel or touch panel
Note: The Mic level adjustment page may not be available in all rooms with microphones
Verify
Microphone is not muted
Microphone volume is at an appropriate level
The body pack is turned on
The battery in body pack is not low
Replace the battery in the body pack
If more than one microphone in the room, select the appropriate microphone to adjust
If accessible, check if the sound amplifier is powered on in the equipment rack
If it is off, attempt to power it on
In Zoom verify that the microphone setting is set to the Synaptics Line In or QSC USB-IO and not the Logitech Webcam
If it does not power on or is already on please Report Smart Classroom Issue
Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance

description: Unable to make calls to a specific number and hearing an error message
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
Unable to complete a call to a specific number
Hearing an error message: All Circuits Are Busy
Error: Your call cannot be complete as dialed. Please check your number and dial again.
Environment
Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP)
Cause
Multiple causes
Resolution
Attempt to call using a non-VoIP phone or cellular phone
If the call still does not go through, the issue is with party being called
Ensure the number is being properly dialed
For long distance calls, be sure to dial 9, then 1, then the area code, then the seven digit telephone number
For local calls, dial 9 and then the seven digit telephone number

description: D2L (Desire2Learn) is USD's online learning system where you access your courses, assignments, grades, quizzes, class materials, and communicate with instructors. This article describes how to login to D2L.

How do I log into D2L?

Desire2Learn(D2L) (aka Brightspace)

Note for Students: Student access to D2L (USD's online learning system) is not available until the student has completed registration

Log in directly to D2L
or Access using D2L Quick Link at Coyote One Stop
Click on Quick Links, then Desire2Learn (D2L)
Log in to D2L using
Username: Full USD email address (First.Last@coyotes.usd.edu)
Note: If you attend another Board of Regents school full time, your login will be that school's email address
Password: USD password
Note: See D2L Authentication Error before resetting your password
If you need to reset your password, follow the Article Resetting USD Account Password

Environment
Smart Classroom equipped with DVD/VCR
Resolution
Bring a test DVD and VHS Tape
Turn on the Crestron system
Test playing the DVD/VHS and using the Crestron TouchPanel to control the functions
Test the Power Button
Test the Menu functions
Test Play/Pause
Eject the DVD/VHS
Turn off the Crestron system
Note: If everything works properly no further troubleshooting is required. If a step fails there may be an issue with the DVD/VCR or the Crestron system

Dip switch on the side of document camera in the wrong position
The power connector is not plugged in all the way

Verify that the document camera is powered on
Verify that the power connector is not unplugged from the document camera
Verify that the video cable did not come unplugged from the document camera

cause: Need to live stream to Facebook Live or Youtube
description: How to set up a Live Stream using WebCheckout equipment
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
How do I live stream to Facebook Live or Youtube?
Environment
Livestreaming
Open Broadcaster Software (OBS)
Cause
Need to live stream to Facebook Live or Youtube
Resolution
Install Open Broadcaster Software (OBS)
Select Yes to the Auto-Configuration Wizard
Select Optimize for streaming, recording is secondary
Click Next
Select the Streaming Service you will be using from the Service: dropdown
On the streaming service site, setup your livestream:
YouTube Livestream Setup instructions
Facebook Livestream Setup Instructions
Enter the Stream Key provided by your desired streaming service
Click Next
Click the under Sources
Select Video Capture Device
Create a descriptive name for your device (ex.video camera)
Click OK
Select USB Capture+ HDMI under the device dropdown
Click OK
Click the under Sources
Select Audio Input Capture
Click OK
Choose the Microphone you are using in the dropdown
If you are using a USB Microphone select AT2020 USB Microphone
If you are using a microphone attached to your camera select HDMI (USB Capture HDMI+ Computer)
If you are using a 1/8" line in on the USB Capture Card select Mic (USB Capture HDMI+ Mic)
Click Start Streaming
Note: If your streaming provider is set to automatically go live this will cause you to be broadcasting automatically. Please only click this once you are sure you have it set to be able to preview a feed or you are ready to go live.
If a recording is desired click Start Recording
On your Facebook or YouTube Page, preview the feed, and if it looks good click Go Live
When finished, click End Event or End Live Video on your YouTube or Facebook video
Click Stop Streaming in OBS

description: Troubleshooting steps to take when a laptop screen will not display on a projector in a classroom or conference room that does not have a touch panel or XPanel.
environment:
Classroom
Conference room

Equipment Checkout
Projector
Laptop
fullText:
Issue/Question
When connecting a laptop to the projector or TV it will not display the laptop onto the screen
Environment
Classroom
Conference room
No XPanel and no touch panel in the room
Equipment Checkout
Projector
Laptop
Cause
Multiple Causes
Resolution
Verify that the projector is on and in a ready state
Verify that the projector is on the correct video source and using the correct cable
Check the end of the cable that connects to the laptop to verify there are no bent or broken pins
Check to make sure laptop cable is not disconnected from the projector
If available try a different laptop or video source to narrow down if it is the projector or the cable
If using an adapter try re-seating the adapter or try a different one
If using a Windows laptop use the key + P to bring up the Project menu and verify that is set to Duplicate
If using a Mac go to the Display Preferences and verify that it sees the second display and that it is set to Mirror Displays
If still not working please Contact the Service Desk with the following information
Building and room number
If immediate assistance is required

description: Used to access the university Financial Aid Self Service Portal
fullText:
Question
How do I access financial aid?
Products or Services Involved
Banner Financial Aid
Banner Student
South Dakota System Navigation Access Portal (SNAP)
Luminis Portal
Instructions
Info:
If you have applied to more than one of the SD Board of Regents Universities, you may receive more than one email. You will only need to use one of these emails to log into the system. Once you log into the system, you will be able to see your financial aid information for all Universities.
Financial Aid Self Service is only accessible once you have been awarded financial aid. The Financial Aid Department will send you an e-mail when you have been awarded.
Current Students
Log into Financial Aid Self Service
Select the Aid Year from the drop-down box in the upper right corner
Following are the tabs you can view
Home
Aid Offer
Financial Aid History
Resources
Notifications
Satisfactory Academic Progress
College Financing Plan
New or Readmitted Students, not a current student or current employee
Click Student Portal (this is a different portal than current students above)
Enter your Student ID in User ID, then click Forgot Password
Locating Student or Faculty ID
Note: Your Student ID is in an email sent to the email address you specified on your FAFSA application.
Note: If you receive error: Authorization Failure - Security Question is not set up and are a current/past student or employee of a South Dakota University system, you will need to log in through the Current Students procedures
You will be presented with a security question. Enter your response to the question in the Answer box, then submit
After correctly answering the security question, the next screen will allow you to reset your Password.
Enter the same value in the boxes labeled New Password and Re-enter new Password.
Note: Your new password must be at least ten characters long and contain both letters and numbers
Then click on the Reset Password button.
Once logged in, select Click Here under Financial Aid
Need More Help?
If you need assistance, please contact the Financial Aid Office
E-mail financial.aid@usd.edu
Phone (605) 658-6250

Error: Event Inactive
Error: Offline
Environment
Blackboard
Event Reader
iPad
MRD5
iValidate
Resolution
Note: See Coyote Card Reader Not Working for all other Card Readers
Confirm iPad and MRD5 are powered on and charged
Press and hold the power button on the MRD5 until it beeps and lights up
Press and hold the power button on the iPad to turn it on
Enter PIN to unlock iPad
iPad battery percentage is displayed in the top right corner
Open iValidate App
Select Start
Enter PIN
Select OK
Select an Event
MRD5 will beep to signal it is connected
Note: If an error message appears, skip to step 2
When MRD5 has connected, battery percentage is displayed under Enter/swipe card
Skip to step 3
Confirm MRD5 is paired with iPad
Open Settings
Select Bluetooth
Confirm Bluetooth is toggled on
Note: If the MRD5 is unpaired in Bluetooth Settings it will automatically pair again once an Event is selected in the iValidate App.
Open iValidate App
Select Start
Enter PIN
Select OK
Select an Event
MRD5 will beep to signal it is connected
Note: If an error message appears, confirm the MRD5 is powered on and select Try again
Contact the Service Desk for assistance if the error message persist
Confirm iValidate App is Online and not in demo mode
Confirm iPad is connected to Wi-Fi
Open Settings
Select Wi-Fi
Confirm Wi-Fi is toggled on
Tap next to eduroam
Confirm Auto-Join is toggled on
Confirm Private Wi-Fi Address is toggled off
Note: Private Wi-Fi Address must be off and the Event Reader must be connected to Eduroam for iValidate to upload transactions. If the Event Reader does not automatically connect to Eduroam, please Contact the Service Desk for further assistance
Note: Event Reader will continue to function and will store transactions on the device until reconnected to Eduroam
Open iValidate
Select Start
Enter PIN
Select OK
Note: If Online is displayed in the bottom left corner of the screen then the event reader is working correctly
Tap Offline and select Yes. Switch to online when prompted
If Demo Profile is displayed at the top of the screen please contact the Service Desk with the following information
If the Event Reader is still not working correctly, please contact the Service Desk with the following information
Name
Phone Number
Asset tag (NI#) of Event Reader
Location of the device

description: This article discusses how to troubleshoot a projector that will power on and then stop working after being on for a few minutes.
environment:

Portable projector
Classroom

footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
The projector turns on and will work for a few minutes and then will stop working
The projector stopped working after approximately 60 seconds of use
Projector sometimes will not display a top quarter of the screen
Projector image flashes on and off
Environment
Projector
Portable projector
Classroom
Conference room
Cause
Multiple causes
Resolution
For projectors that are hung from the ceiling or wall contact the Service Desk
Note: Please do not attempt to troubleshoot
For portable projectors
Check the status LEDs on the projector
Refer to the manual by searching online for the projector model
If status LED indicates a heat warning.
Unplug power from the projector and let the projector sit for at least 20 minutes
Make sure that there is nothing obstructing the airflow around the projector
If possible move the projector to a cooler location in the room
Check the air vents on the projector
Check the air filter is not plugged with lint or other debris
Check Auto Power Off settings in the projector menu
Change the setting to Off if turned on.

description: Setting up speed dials for a Cisco phone by using the self-care portal
fullText:
Issue/Question
Adding speed dials to my Cisco Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) phone
How to add speed dial numbers to PUBLIC AREA VoIP phones that have an outgoing call code
Hot button needed on phone
Environment
VoIP
Self-Care
8851
Resolution
Note: USD is currently switching to a different VOIP system. The steps will vary based on if your phone has been updated
From the web (If your phone has the SD logo image)
Login to https://voip.usd.edu/ucmuser/ using your USD username and password
Select Phone Settings > Speed Dial Numbers
Select Add New Speed Dial
Fill out the phone number, description, and speed dial number
Note: If setting a speed dial to another voip number, just enter the seven digits (example: 6586000)
Note: If you are setting a non-voip number as your speed-dial, be sure to add a 9 in front of the number (96705555) or for long-distance 9-1 and the area code(916052225555)
Click Save
If one or more of the speed dial options do not appear on the phone within a few minutes, they can be added manually with the following steps
Press and hold (for 3 seconds) one of the buttons on either side the phone display that do not have an option displayed next to it
Enter the Speed Dial Name with the keypad
Press the bottom of the outside ring in the center of the phone
Enter the Speed Dial Number
Press the button beneath Apply
From the phone
1. Press and hold one of the side buttons where you want your speed dial to appear
2. Press 2 Speed Dial
3. Use number pad to enter the letters for the Label (the name).
4. Use the round button’s bottom dot to move the cursor to Number.
5. Enter the phone number:
For another VOIP number: enter 7 digits (example: 6586000)
For a non‑VOIP or long‑distance number: enter area code + number (example: 6052225555)
6. Press the button under Save
Note: If your phone has the Coyotes Mascot Head image, this can only be done from the phone not the Webex portal
Note: For Public Area phones or VoIP phones not assigned to an individual contact the Service Desk with the following information:
The extensions for the shared phones the speed-dial will be configured on
The phone number and a label for each speed-dial number
The order you want the speed dial buttons listed if you have a preference
Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance

Environment
ImageNow
Perceptive Content
Cause
ImageNow has not been upgraded
Chrome updated
Resolution
Company Portal by Intune is the replacement for Software Center
Perform a Windows Search for Company Portal
Click Apps in the upper-left
Click Perceptive Content
Click Install
If you are still having problems
Open Chrome
Click the three dots in the top right corner of the window
Click Settings
Click About Chrome
Confirm Chrome is up to date
Right-click your desktop
Click New
Click Shortcut
Paste "C:\Program Files (x86)\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe" --disable-features=AccessibilityRestrictiveIA2AXModes --force-renderer-accessibility=complete into Type the location of the item
Click Next
Click Finish
Close Chrome
Open Chrome from new shortcut
Try linking again
Note: If using Firefox, Secure DNS must be disabled and Cross-Site Tracking must be enabled
Open Firefox
Click the 3 lines in the top right corner of the window
Click Settings
Click Privacy & Security
Confirm Browser Privacy is set to Custom
Un-check Cookies
Scroll down to Enable DNS over HTTPS using:
Select Off

I need to be added as an active faculty in Banner
Error: This page is not enabled for current user role
Environment
Banner 9
Banner Student
Cause
Faculty status is pulled from Banner
Access to Self Service is automatically set up for faculty, students and advisors based on their role.
Resolution
Log in to Snap
Select Finance Tab
Click Banner PROD Application Navigator
Search for the SIAINST screen
Search by ID in the ID field
If a record is not found for the faculty member, contact the Registrar’s Office to have a faculty record created
If a record is found then
Verify Faculty is
Verify Status is Active
Contact the Registrar’s Office to have this updated if someone in your department is not able to update the screen
Run the Banner Security Name Search Report in Cognos to check on active job
Enter the Last Name and First Name
Select the appropriate record (should have a GOAEACC ID if faculty)
If there is no PositionNumber/PositionDesc/TimesheetOrg/EClassCode/JobEffectiveDate/DerivedEndEffectiveDate/JobChangeDate then they do not have an active job and will not get a Faculty role in Coyote Connections
The department will need to make sure to get an EPAF thru to HR to get an active job for the person so they flow through correctly to Coyote Connections
Note: Faculty/Advisor access to Self Service is set up based on their assignment to Faculty and/or Advisor role - no Banner Access request needed

description: How to create a query for any browse screen in the system
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
Create Report/Query Using a Browse Window
Environment
TMA
Resolution
Log into TMA
Click on Browse tab on any TMA screen
example: Transaction > Work Order > Single Task Work Order
Click Add
In Save Query As: Enter the name of your query
if only you will be using this query, leave radio button Private on
if others need to use this query, click Public or Public/No Edit
In left column, highlight field you want
Enter length you want on the report
Click right arrows
If you have fields in the right column you do not want, highlight and then click the left arrows to remove from query
Click Add Criteria
Column Name dropdown pick field
Operator dropdown pick your criteria
Value - enter appropriate value for your criteria
Last field enter appropriate and/or criteria
Click Update
Repeat steps 9-14 until all your criteria has been entered
Click Find to see if you get what you are after if not repeat steps above until you do
Click Save in upper window this saves the query
You can now find query in dropdown

fullText:
Issue/Question
How do I get Microsoft Teams?
How can I add Microsoft Teams on the Computer?
Environment
Windows OS
macOS
Office 365
Cause
Office 365 Pro Plus gives access to the most recent versions of Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and other titles depending on platform. Under this program, current Faculty, Staff and Students may install the software on up to five devices/computers.
These are full desktop applications, not web or cloud apps. The software will remain active and usable for as long as you are current Faculty, Staff, or Student. Based on Microsoft’s licensing requirements, it's not offered to past students who have graduated or leave USD.
Resolution
Student Instructions
Go to Office365.com
Enter your USD email address
Click Enter your password
Click School or Work Account
Click Teams
If it's not in the list click Explorer all your apps
Faculty/Staff Instructions
Go to https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-teams/download-app
Click Download Microsoft Teams for Windows
Open the downloaded file
Enter your USD email address
Enter your password

description: Set automatic reply on mailbox in Outlook
environment:
Exchange
Outlook 2019, 2016, 2013, 2010 and Outlook for Office 365
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
Set up Out of Office message in Outlook
Environment
Exchange
Outlook 2019, 2016, 2013, 2010 and Outlook for Office 365
Cause
Resolution
Click the File tab, and then click the Info tab in the menu
Click Automatic Replies (Out of Office)
In the Automatic Replies dialog box, select the Send Automatic Replies check box
If you want to specify a set time and date range, select the Only send during this time range check box
Set the Start time, and then set the End time
In the Inside my organization tab, type the message that you want to send within your organization, and in the Outside my organization tab, type the message that you want to send outside your organization
Click Ok
If you selected the Only send during this time range option in step 4, the Automatic Replies (Out of Office) feature will continue to run until the date and time set for the End Time in step 5 is reached
Note: Otherwise, the Automatic Replies (Out of Office) will continue to run until you repeat step 1 and select the Do not send automatic replies option

description: Troubleshooting a grade not being applied to a quiz or exam in D2L
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
Students are reporting that they submitted a D2L quiz yesterday but the score is not in Grades.
Grades also missing in my grade book.
The quiz settings prior to release were for automatic export and all other students have their scores. I have tried to manually grade these students quizzes but it has not changed anything.
Environment
Desire2Learn(D2L)
Cause
This issue appears to have been caused during the switch over from Colleague to Banner integration
Resolution
Login to D2L
Select Course
Select Assessments
Select Grades
Click under the specified quiz
Note: There should not be a Letter Grade next to the question mark
Click Attempt Drop Down menu
Change from Completion Summary to Attempt 1
Click Save
Refresh the page and verify Letter Grade is now next to
If the above does not work, check restrictions
Select the quiz from the Grades page
Click Restrictions
Uncheck the boxes next to the Date Available and Date End
