description: How Faculty can view class lists or waitlist.
environment:
Banner Student
Faculty
SSB
Self Service Banner
SDBOR Portal/SNAP Home
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
I want to see a student listing for a section, with student pictures
I’m unable to see a class roster for the summer
I would like to check current enrollment for a Fall19 course
How do I see my waitlist?
Environment
Banner Student
Faculty
SSB
Self Service Banner
SDBOR Portal/SNAP Home
Resolution
Log in to Experience
Select FACULTY/ADVISORS from the left-side list
On the right side of the screen, locate the Faculty Main Menu box
Under the Faculty Main Menu heading, click the Faculty Main Menu link
On the Faculty Services screen, click the Class List link
The next screen will display the list of your courses with the following columns
Subject (actually shows subject, course number, section number)
Course Title
CRN
Enrollment Count
Status
Duration (start-end dates)
Term
On the line containing the section you want to see students for, click on the Subject (i.e., PHYS 155, U15) to display a list of students - IT DOES NOT APPEAR TO BE A LINK, but it will display the student list
The Summary Class List is displayed as below
Course Information header section
Picture of the student - (if you hover over a student's name, a larger picture of the student will be displayed)
Note: If student pictures are not showing it is typically due to ad blockers, review information from the ad blocker you use to whitelist this site
Student Name
ID
Registration Status
Student Level
Registered Credit hours
Other fields
The screen contains a tab at the top for the Wait List
To see more details about the students Click Detail Class List at the bottom of the screen
Note: This is for viewing the class roster for your own course sections, you cannot view class rosters for sections you are not the instructor for
Note: If you are a dean/chair/director with sufficient access, you can run the Course Enrollment report in Cognos (Team content > Banner > USD > Academic Affairs > Academic Dean/Chair Reports) to generate a listing of enrollment in the course(s) in your area

description: How a greeting administrator can change the greeting on a main line autoattendant or voicemail
environment:
Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP)
Voicemail
Greeting Administration
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
We have a greeting for our mainline and it needs to be changed
Environment
Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP)
Voicemail
Greeting Administration
Resolution
Make sure you are listed as a Greeting Administrator for the line
If you are not, have the department chair request permissions for you by contacting the Service Desk
Make sure you know your personal extension's voicemail pin
If you need to reset your PIN Resetting Phone Voicemail PIN
From a VoIP phone dial the Greeting Administrator number
USD Main Campus: 1002018
CCSF: 1002016
You will hear Enter your ID followed by pound
Enter your personal phone number followed by # (example: 658-9876-#)
You will hear Enter your PIN followed by pound
Enter your personal voicemail PIN followed by pound (example: 12345-#)
You will hear Enter the extension of the call handler, followed by pound
Enter the main line phone number followed by # (example: 658-6000-#)
You should now be able to change the greeting (Option 2 changes the Standard Greeting)

MacOS
Microsoft Word
Windows

Close and restart Word and EndNote

Search for the name of the list under List Name
Click on the name of the list in the table
Click in the upper right
Click Subscribe or Unsubscribe
Verify List Name and Name fields are correct
Click Subscribe button

description: Steps for restoring department head access in D2L
fullText:
Issue/Question
I no longer have access to the courses in my department and I am the department chair/head
Environment
Desire2Learn (D2L)
Cause
With the start of 2019 Summer Semester, our courses are now being imported from Banner-Student and the department field is not being imported yet. This should be fixed by the end of June 2019
Resolution
Please send the following instructions to your department faculty members:
Login to D2L
Navigate to your Course Home Page
Select Resources > Classlist
Select Add Participant > Add Existing User
Search for your department heads name or ID number
Select the check box next to their name
Select Univ Instructor for the role
Select the section – Note: if you have a combined course, you will need to do this for each section
Repeat steps 1-7 for each course offering

description: How can I silence the ringer on my Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) phone
fullText:
Issue/Question
How can I adjust the ringer on my Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) phone
Environment
VoIP
Cisco 8851 VoIP phone
Resolution
Press the minus or plus button repeatedly until the desired volume level is reached
To turn the ringer off, press the minus button repeatedly until silent
Ringtones can also be disabled with the following steps:
Press Settings
Press 4 for User preferences
Press 5 for Ringtone
Select Ext 1 with the center Circle navigation button
Press 1 for No ringtone
Repeat steps for other Extensions if needed
If you wish to silence the ringer for a single line of a phone with multiple lines, please contact the Service Desk with the following information:
Which line(s) you wish to silence

description: How to use the Zoom cloud recording option
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
How does Zoom Cloud Recording work?
How long will my Zoom Recordings stay active in the Cloud?
Recordings are not capturing the shared screen when recording to the cloud.
Environment
Zoom Meeting
Resolution
Enabling Cloud Recording
Sign in to Zoom
Click Sign In
Sign in with your USD credentials
Click Settings
Click Recording
Verify that Cloud Recording setting is enabled
Select any preferences you would like
Check Automatic Recording if you want recording to start by default
Note: Automatic Recording should only be enabled if necessary as USD's Zoom contract has limited recording storage
Starting a Recording
Start a meeting as the Host
Click the Record button in the Zoom toolbar
Select Record to the Cloud
To stop recording, click Pause/Stop Recording or End Meeting
Note: See Recording with Zoom in the Classroom for additional instruction on using Zoom in a classroom
Accessing Recordings
Sign in to Zoom
Click Sign In
Sign in with your USD credentials
Click Recordings
Find the desired recording and select Share or Download
For more information see Zoom's documentation on Cloud Recording
Note: Zoom will not delete any recordings. Deleting recordings is the responsibility of the account that did the recording. At this time, USD did not set any time limits by default.

description: Policies for Guest User Accounts Library guest access
fullText:
Problem
What are the guest user account policies
I would like to have a guest account
I need an account for the library computers
Solution
Tips:
Guest users are allowed computer access for library research, academic purposes, and other computer work. Guests shall not use computers for video games or other purposes which are not academically productive.
Guest users are subject to the Acceptable Use Policy as well as the Acceptable Use of Information Technology Systems policies set forth in the South Dakota Board of Regents Policy Manual, 7:1.5-7.
Guest users must ask Service Desk to create their accounts
Guest users are allowed an initial access period of 2 hours
If the guest needs more time, the Service Desk may give the guest 2 more hours of access if the library is not busy or if there is no “waiting line” for computers.
Students, faculty, and staff who need computer access should be considered before allowing more time for guest users.
Guest Printing is available
If your guest account was created today, you will not be able to print until the next business day
If your guest account was created more than 24 hours ago, go to the Service Desk
Pay for the amount you want to add plus taxes
Note: Check or Credit Card only, we do not take cash payments
Log into a Library computer using guest account
Print to USD-Print
Login at multifunction device using their guest account username and password
Release print jobs
Children are welcome to the University Libraries; however, we do not assume responsibility for the safety of children left unattended and do not provide a monitoring service.
Children under the age of 12 must be accompanied at all times by a guest account-bearing adult who is responsible for supervising the child’s behavior, including the child’s use of the internet.
Children 12-15 years of age may have guest accounts created if they are accompanied by a parent or guardian at sign up.
Parents or legal guardians of minor children must assume responsibility for their children’s use of the internet via the computers. Children ages 16 and up may have their own guest account created and do not require adult supervision.
Need More Help?
Please contact the Service Desk to create or enable your guest user account. Provide the following information
First name
Last name
Phone number
Email address

USD Print

fullText:
Issue/Question
How do I email my students through Banner
Is there a way to automatically create one email list for the classes I have cross-listed
Environment
Self Service Banner (SSB)
SNAP
Resolution
Note: The preferred method to email the class list is using D2L or Coyote Connections
Note: 9-27-19 The EMAILING CLASS feature was turned off, see note above.
Log into Experience
Click Faculty Main Menu
Click Faculty/Advisors
Click next to the class you wish to email
Click Email class at the bottom of the class list
Note: Outlook will put commas between the names, these will need to be changed to semi-colons
Copy all email addresses listed in the To field of the email
Open Word
Paste the copied list into a blank document
On the Home tab choose Replace Or press Ctrl+H
In the Find what box enter ,
In the Replace with box enter ;
Select Replace All
Copy all email address listed in Word
Paste into the To field of the email
Follow the articles below to set Outlook as your default mail application
Change Default email on MAC to Microsoft Outlook
Change Default email in Windows

description: How to relocate OneDrive location to free up space on the C: Drive (system drive).
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
I am running out of space on my C Drive because of OneDrive
How do I move OneDrive location to save disk space on C: drive
Environment
Windows
Onedrive
Cause
Desktop C-Drive runs out of space
Resolution
Right click the OneDrive taskbar icon and select Settings
Click Account
Click Choose Folders
Remove the checkmark from any folders you don't need on this computer
Click OK
Click the Unlink OneDrive
Launch File Explorer or + E
Locate current OneDrive location
Click Move to button on the Home tab.
Select Choose location
Select the new location
Click Move
Once the windows finished moving the file, log in to OneDrive

description: How to fix the Zoom camera issue
fullText:
Issue/Question
When I enter a Zoom Meeting, the image jumps up and down on the screen
When I connect to Zoom there are lines through my camera display
When I connect to Zoom I have a crossed out camera icon despite the camera being enabled in Zoom
Camera quality is not very good during Zoom meeting
Environment
Zoom
Resolution
For camera quality check Zoom Video settings
Click the ^ by the Stop Video button on the bottom bar
Click Video Settings....
Place a check mark in the box next to HD
If lighting is low in the room, try placing a check mark in the box next to Adjust for low light
Please contact the Service Desk with the following information:

Location of issue

fullText:
Issue/Question
How do I access the digital books that I bought before May 2019 with the Barnes and Noble bookstore?
Environment
Yuzu Barnes & Noble
Cause
The University of South Dakota has a new online bookstore provider
Resolution
EBooks bought from Barnes & Noble that are not in your Vitalsource library in D2L can be accessed online at www.yuzu.com
When signing in, use the email address and password that was used when your eBook was purchased
If the password needs to be reset, please use the reset password option located on the login page
A link will be sent to your email address
Note: to access your eBook offline, the Yuzu reader app will need to be downloaded to a mobile device such as a tablet or smartphone, the app is available for free in both the App Store (iOS) and Google Play Store (Android), the ability to download the book directly to your computer is currently not available

description: Ticket status and definitions used to describe the current status of a ticket.
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
What does each ticket status mean?
Environment
TeamDynamix (TD)
Cause
Correct ticket status is important to reflect actual status of the ticket and communicate that to the customer
Resolution
New - The ticket has been entered and assigned to the team who will provide a solution
In Process - Work has started on your request
On Hold - Something is holding up work, technician to provide you specifics
Awaiting Response - ITS has contacted you to obtain more information. Check your email for more information.
Scheduled - Work is scheduled to occur on a specific date
Cancelled - Cancelled by your request
Resolved - ITS has resolved your issue and is waiting on your confirmation
Closed - You have confirmed your issue is resolved or did not respond to confirm resolution

fullText:
Issue/Question
Will I be able to use a Chromebook for work at USD using the Google Apps?
Will Zoom work with a Chromebook?
Environment
Google Chromebooks
Cause
There are some limitations when doing distance learning especially when presenting and sharing your screen. They also do not multitask as effectively as Windows and Mac PC's. Chromebooks do not support some of the testing applications and may not meet the requirements for proctored exams and are therefore not recommended at this time.
Resolution
You can use a Chromebook at USD but some software may not be available for the Chrome Operating System (OS)
Note: You can use the Library computers or checkout a computer from the ITS Service Desk if needed. These are available on a First Come First Served basis
You can use Zoom by following these instructions
See instructions for accessing Microsoft Office on a Chromebook
Please contact the instructor(s) of your course(s) to see if you need a Windows or Mac computer
Note: ITS provides limited on-site support for Chromebooks and the Chrome OS, to include connecting to the USD wireless network (eduroam), web access of Office 365, and Zoom web conferencing. Some software may not work on Chromebooks.

cause:
Acquiring (regardless of cost) non-standard technology which may not comply with state/federal laws or University policy or may involve risk to the University
Acquiring (regardless of cost) new technology which involves confidential or restricted data
Integrating applications into cloud apps like Teams or Zoom
description: When acquiring new, non-standard technology a Technology Risk Assessment may be required.
footer: Click the Software Request button on this page to submit your request
fullText:
Issue/Question
What is a Technology Risk Assessment? Do I need to request a Technology Risk Assessment?
Environment
SDezBuy
New Software and/or Hardware
Cause
Acquiring (regardless of cost) non-standard technology which may not comply with state/federal laws or University policy or may involve risk to the University
Acquiring (regardless of cost) new technology which involves confidential or restricted data
Integrating applications into cloud apps like Teams or Zoom
Resolution
Any technology solution, regardless of cost, must conform to University policy to protect restricted or confidential information
Technology Risk Assessments are required when:
Acquiring non-standard technology or
Integrating a cloud app with Teams or Zoom
When using or purchasing new technology start with a Project Estimate Request
Technology Risk Assessment may require multiple reviews which can be performed concurrently
Questions and Answers
When acquiring software or hardware that is not part of an existing University standard, consider these questions:
Are you integrating a cloud application with Zoom or Teams?
Cloud applications are evaluated by Information Technology Services (ITS) using the Microsoft Cloud App Security (MCAS) Cloud App Catalog.
Are you acquiring a cloud application?
Cloud applications are software that does not run in the University datacenter. The University uses the Higher Education Community Vendor Assessment Tool (HECVAT) to evaluate the security of cloud applications that store sensitive data including student records, protected health information, cardholder data, and non-public personal information.
Are you acquiring desktop software or server software?
The University uses a standard form to evaluate commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) software.
Are you acquiring software with accessibility requirements?
Section 508 requires website content to be accessible to people with disabilities. Academic software used in the delivery of coursework is likely to have accessibility requirements.
Are you acquiring an application that will require enterprise integration?
Software applications often integrate with Banner for accurate student or employee information. Many applications may also support single sign-on (SSO) making it safer and easier for students, faculty, and staff to access resources using University credentials.
Are you acquiring an application that will store, process, or transmit any of the following types of information?
Student Records
Student Records are protected by the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA), and some software vendors must include the appropriate language in their contract indicating their compliance.
Payments
Credit card information, also known as cardholder data, is protected by the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI-DSS).
Protected Health Information (PHI)
PHI is protected by the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), and software applications may be required to comply. .
Non-public personal information (NPI)
NPI is personally identifiable financial information and is protected by the Gramm Leach Bliley Act (GLBA). This type of information is most often associated with financial aid records at a University.
Click the Software Request button on this page to submit your request

description: How to obtain a Mac Address for a device
environment:
Microsoft Windows
Apple MacOS
Google Android
Apple iOS
Chrome OS
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
I need to get my MAC (Media Access Control) address
Environment
Microsoft Windows
Apple MacOS
Google Android
Apple iOS
Chrome OS
Resolution
Note: MAC address will be in this format A1:B2:C3:D4:E5:F6, with or without symbols separating the characters
Microsoft Windows
Press
Type Command Prompt
Click on Command Prompt
Type getmac /v
The Connection Name and Physical Address for the Wireless Adapter should be listed
Note: The MAC Address is listed under Physical Address
Apple macOS
Click
Select System Preferences
Click Network
Select Wi-Fi from the list
Click Advanced
Select the Hardware tab
The MAC Address should be listed
Google Chromebook
Open Chrome
In the address bar, type chrome://system
Press ENTER
Look for ifconfig and click Expand...
For the wired MAC address, look for the eth0 section
For the wireless MAC address, look for the wlan0 section
Google Android
Open Android Settings
Select About Phone
Select Status
The MAC Address should be listed under Wi-Fi MAC address
Apple iOS
Open Settings
Select General
Select About
The MAC Address should be listed under Wi-Fi Address
Other Devices
The address may be located in Settings under Wireless or Network
If you cannot locate the address under settings
Start Mobile Hotspot on an Android phone
Connect the device to the Hotspot network using the SSID and Password of the Hotspot
Once the device connects, the phone should show a connected device and list the MAC address

cause: I want to know what Banner screens are in the Groups I have been assigned in Banner
description: Use this report in Cognos to list the Screens for Banner Security Groups
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
What Banner Security Groups exist, and which screens are in each group?
Environment
Banner
Cognos
Cause
I want to know what Banner screens are in the Groups I have been assigned in Banner
Resolution
Log into Cognos
Run Banner Security Groups Classes Screens report
There are two tabs in the spreadsheet
Details of groups - gives a detailed listing of all the screens in the group along with whether the access is UPDATE or INQUIRY
Details of counts - gives a listing of just the group names and the number of screens in the group
Screens can be searched for in the first tab, yielding the groups the screens are in
This can be used with the second tab to determine how many screens are in each group

cause: The Blonder Tongue Video distribution units are not receiving video input on the selected channels.
description: Verify that signal is being output to the HDMI and HD-SDI inputs on the Blonder Tongue units.
environment:
SCSC
Concourse, Lobby, or Concessions Displays
fullText:
Issue/Question
The Sanford Coyote Sports Center (SCSC) concourse TVs are displaying color bars or a black screen.
Sanford Coyote Sports Center menus are not updating in Reach
Sanford Coyote Sports Center Show Control computer not displaying on TVs
Environment
SCSC
Concourse, Lobby, or Concessions Displays
Cause
The Blonder Tongue Video distribution units are not receiving video input on the selected channels.
Resolution
Locate the Two Blonder Tongue Video Distribution units in the SCSC Midco Production Booth
Note: These units are in the rack nearest the entrance to the Production Booth
Examine the front of the units to discover which channels currently have video input
Green lights indicate video signal is being received on the selected input
Note: 1 and 3 on each unit are the HDMI inputs. 2 and 4 are the HD-SDI inputs. The Show control computer is fed on number 2 (HD-SDI Input 1 on the back of the top blonder tongue unit. The top lights indicate the audio input status, these will often be red. The bottom lights indicate the video status. These should be green.
Red lights indicate that there is no video signal on the selected input
Confirm the TVs in the Concourse are on the correct channel
The Reach Players are on channels 90-1, 92-1, 94-1, and 96-1 and are inputs 1 and 3 on the top Blonder Tongue and 1 and 3 on the bottom blonder tongue.
The Show Control computer feed is on channel 91-1 and is input 2 on the top Blonder Tongue unit. Channel 95-1 is the SDI input on the bottom Blonder Tongue unit and is not currently used.
Troubleshoot the red inputs to discover why there is no signal input
Verify the Four Digital Signage PCs on top of the Blonder Tongue unit are on
If menus are not updating, restart the computers
Verify that the Arena Production equipment is routed properly and is sending signal to the Blonder Tongue unit via the High-Definition Serial Digital Interface (HD SDI) cable
Reboot the Blonder Tongue Video Unit by unplugging it and plugging it back in.
If still not working please contact the Service Desk with the following information:
What channels aren't working
When they stopped working

The Show Control computer feed is on channel 91-1 and is input 2 on the top Blonder Tongue unit. Channel 95-1 is the SDI input on the bottom Blonder Tongue unit and is not currently used.
Troubleshoot the red inputs to discover why there is no signal input
Verify the Four Digital Signage PCs on top of the Blonder Tongue unit are on
If menus are not updating, restart the computers
Verify that the Arena Production equipment is routed properly and is sending signal to the Blonder Tongue unit via the High-Definition Serial Digital Interface (HD SDI) cable
Reboot the Blonder Tongue Video Unit by unplugging it and plugging it back in.
If still not working please contact the Service Desk with the following information:
What channels aren't working
When they stopped working

description: Duo Security is USD's multi-factor authentication (MFA) solution
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
What is Duo Security
Environment
USD Accounts
Duo
Resolution
USD is committed to helping students, faculty and staff protect themselves online from serious threats such as losing a paycheck, a financial aid refund or even your own identity. To improve our security posture, we are incorporating Duo Security as a two-factor authentication solution into our existing IT infrastructure.
You can enroll in Duo at this time by visiting Signing Up for Duo MFA
What is Duo Security
Duo Security is a company that provides a cloud-based software service that utilizes two-factor authentication to ensure secure access to services and data.
What is two-factor authentication
Two-factor authentication provides a second layer of security to any type of login, requiring extra information or a physical device to log in, in addition to your password. By requiring two different channels of authentication, we can protect user logins from remote attacks that may exploit stolen usernames and passwords.
The factors may include:
Something you know: A unique username and password
Something you have: A smartphone with an app to approve authentication requests
Something you are: Biometrics – such as your fingerprint or a retina scan
Why do we need two-factor authentication
Login credentials are more valuable than ever and are increasingly easy to compromise. More than 90 percent of breaches today involve compromised usernames and passwords.
Two-factor authentication enhances the security of your account by using a secondary device to verify your identity. This prevents anyone but you from accessing your account, even if they know your password.
How will Duo change my login experience
When logging in to an application that is protected by Duo, you will still enter your username and password. After inputting your login information, Duo requires you to complete a method of second-factor authentication. You can set the computer to remember you for 30 days so you won't be required to authorize through Duo every time.
Duo does not replace or require you to change your username and password. Think of Duo as a layer of security added to your pre-existing login method.

Patch Policy Exception Request
How do I prevent my computer from being upgraded to a newer operating system?
My computer is attached to lab equipment and must run a specific version of Windows.
Our department has a few systems (for instrument control and operation) that are running on Windows 7 OS. It seems security updates for Windows 7 may come to an end in Jan 2020.
Is there any policy ITS has (or like to adapt) for usage of Windows 7 computers post Jan 2020 and what would be the charges incur, if any, if the department decided to retain Windows 7 systems.
I have a system that needs to run Windows 8 because it is connected to a device that requires Windows 8 specifically. Windows 8 End of Life was January 2023.

University owned computers
Windows OS

The University's policy is to maintain current and supported operating systems and software security patches ensuring the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of University information systems.

Note: Starting in FY2024 there will be a service charge associated with these devices

Include the following details
Asset tag of computer
Name of computer if different from Asset tag
Reason software can not be removed or updated
Estimated cost of replacing with alternative
Date the software is no longer needed
Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance

description: MFA helps keep your USD account secure by preventing unauthorized access. This article provides information on how to set up various options for Duo which is use for multifactor authentication.
fullText:
Question
How do I sign up for Duo?
How do I configure Duo?
Products or Services Involved
Duo Multi-Factor Authentication
Instructions
Tips:
Duo Multi-factor Authentication is used to authenticate your account and needs to be set up for you to use university resources. It can be set up on a phone, tablet or via a security key procured from the ITS Service Desk.
You will need to complete the Duo setup in one sitting. If you start it and quit, you will need to contact the Service Desk for assistance.
Instructions are best followed from a computer.
Mobile Phone
Note: Phone must be connected to wi-fi or have a cell signal to complete Duo setup
On your phone
Install Duo Mobile app from your phone's app store
On your computer
Open https://outlook.office.com/
Sign on with USD credentials
Click Get Started
Click Duo Mobile
Enter your phone number
Click Continue
Click Yes, it's correct if the phone # is correct
Click Next
Open the Duo Mobile app on your phone
With your phone, Scan the barcode on the computer screen
Note: If you are doing this on your phone, click the link under the barcode
Click Continue
Instructions to Enable Duo Restore
Verify Duo Mobile App Version
Tablet
Install Duo Mobile app from your tablet's app store
Open https://outlook.office.com/
Sign on with USD credentials
Click Get Started
Click Duo Mobile
Click I have a tablet
Click Next
Open the Duo Mobile app
Tap the + button
Scan the barcode on the computer screen
Click Continue
Yubico Security Key
Note: Yubico keys will not work with the VPN or remote.usd.edu
Note: Yubico keys do not work with Internet Explorer browser. They will work with Safari, Chrome, and Firefox
Open https://outlook.office.com/
Sign on with USD credentials
Click Security Key
Click Continue
Insert your key into the computer
Tap the metal contact on the security key
Click Continue
Need More Help?
If you need further assistance, please contact the Service Desk

title: Setting up Duo MFA (Multifactor Authentication)

answer:
USD does not support text messages for Duo MFA because the SIM Swap attack allows attackers to gain access to your account
USD supports several options for Duo MFA:
Duo mobile app on any Android or iOS Device, including tablets
Duo Push is the recommended method
Mobile Passcodes are useful when your mobile device is not connected to a network
Follow Signing Up for Duo to configure your device
WebAuthn with Touch ID
Note: Requires Chrome browser and MacBook with Touch ID
Hardware tokens
Duo Hardware Tokens available for purchase at the Service Desk
Other One-Time Password (OTP) Hardware Tokens
Universal two-factor (U2F) Security Keys
Security Keys that support U2F (not Yubico)
Purchase a Hardware Token or Security Key from Service Desk

cause: Understand how much USD Print Fund printing quota each student receives
description: How much USD Print Fund printing quota is distributed to students?
environment:
USD Print Fund printing
Computer labs
Student
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
How much USD Print Fund quota do I get?
Is there a charge for printing in the labs?
Environment
USD Print Fund printing
Computer labs
Student
Cause
Understand how much USD Print Fund printing quota each student receives
Resolution
Note: USD Print Fund quota is provided to Students only. Faculty, staff, and affiliates do not receive these funds, they would use a department accounts/index or Coyote Cash to print
Each student receives $24 in USD Print Fund printing quota for a regular Fall/Spring academic year
Note: If only taking one semester, such as Spring or Summer only, each student receives $12 in USD Print Fund printing quota
$24 of USD Print Fund printing quota covers 400 black and white pages
Printing in the computer labs costs $0.06 per page for black and white printing or copying and $0.34 per page for color for standard 8.5 x 11 paper
Print Funds are non transferable and can only be used for printing

Experience.usd.edu (Formerly SNAP)
E-Print

The report has not yet been run for the month desired

Wait for notification that the report has been run and routed to E-Print for this month
If the report is not where you expect it to be, access E-Print again
Note the Repository you are entering in the dropdown list
If it states USD - Finance and you did NOT find the document, then select Finance from the list the click the Enter button
If prompted, enter your credentials again
The list of reports is displayed with a dropdown in the lower center of the screen where you can search for the document desired (FGRODTA)
The document you selected will be displayed at the top of the list, if it exists
You may then use the drill icon to search for the Organization or range of Organizations you wish to view
If the document does not exist, it may not have been run yet

FGRODTA Report Not Generating
Environment
Experience.usd.edu (Formerly SNAP)
E-Print
resolution:
Wait for notification that the report has been run and routed to E-Print for this month
If the report is not where you expect it to be, access E-Print again
Note the Repository you are entering in the dropdown list
If it states USD - Finance and you did NOT find the document, then select Finance from the list the click the Enter button
If prompted, enter your credentials again
The list of reports is displayed with a dropdown in the lower center of the screen where you can search for the document desired (FGRODTA)
The document you selected will be displayed at the top of the list, if it exists
You may then use the drill icon to search for the Organization or range of Organizations you wish to view
If the document does not exist, it may not have been run yet

cause: Need to run a Cognos report
description: How to run a Cognos Report
fullText:
Issue/Question
How do I find/run a Cognos report?
Environment
Cognos Reporting
USD Data Cookbook
Cause
Need to run a Cognos report
Resolution
Note: Cognos uses your USD credentials for authentication
Option 1 - Use DataCookbook to find and run your report
Log in to USD DataCookbook with your USD credentials
Accept the cookies/etc
You will land on the Home page
Type a word or words that you want to search for in the Search the Data Cookbook prompt (just below the "Home" text in the red navigation bar)
Click the blue Go button to search
The resulting Find Data page shows your query results (if NO results were found, choose a different search string and search again)
REPORTS are listed under the heading of Specifications in the output (middle column)
Mousing over the report names (briefly letting your mouse rest on the link WITHOUT clicking) will show the PURPOSE and DESCRIPTION of the report
Click on the report name link for the report you would like to run
An expanded listing of the report including PURPOSE, DESCRIPTION, etc will be displayed
Find the Access Details section
Click on the report link to open the Cognos report
You may need to authenticate to run the report
Supply parameters, if needed, to run your report
Click the Submit or Run Report button to produce the report
Option 2 - Direct login to Cognos
Log in to Cognos11
Click on Team Content
Click on Banner
Click on USD
Navigate to the folder where your report is located, then click on the report to run it
Supply parameters, if needed, to run your report
Click the Submit or Run Report button to produce the report
Option 3 - Search Cognos
Log in to Cognos11
Click the Search icon
Enter a string to search for (i.e., Rooms)
A list of possible terms may be listed - if one of those items matches what you want, click it, otherwise press Enter to search
A list of possible report matches willl be displayed, report name on top, in blue (if you have access) and the path below it
Check the path before clicking (i.e., Team content > Banner > ... is a possible location, while Team content > Colleague is an Obsolete location)
Attempt to view the report by clicking on the report name
Supply parameters, if needed, to run your report
Click the Submit or Run Report button to produce the report
NOTE: A LOT of reports/things may be listed that have nothing to do with what you want
Option 4 - Use Cognos Recents
Log in to Cognos11
Click the Open Menu icon at the left end of the dark blue bar at the top of the screen
Select the Recent > option
A list of recent reports will be displayed
Choose the item you want to run
The report prompts (if any) will be displayed
NOTE: If you receive a message that you do not have access to the report, you are most likely using an out of date link OR the report has been moved to an archive folder OR has been renamed - navigate to the folder you were expecting the report to be in and run it from there
Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance

description: Onedrive and Word saving process
fullText:
Issue/Question
If I open the MS Word program, then click new document, the file save date is still my user folders. Every other program, it is my One Drive. After the first existing file is saved, the location switches to the one drive. How do I get the location to point to one drive for new files?
Environment
Microsoft (MS) Word
Resolution
The first time you save to Onedrive on your computer, it will save to the computer first and then upload the document to Onedrive. If you then open the document from Onedrive, it will automatically sync it to Onedrive when you save

How do I access my Ebooks?
How do I access the online books I bought at the USD Bookstore?
Where do I find First Day Access material?
How do I use the eLibrary?
Sentinel U Error: The access code that was provided is not associated with a valid contract. Please verify your code and try again or contact your institution if you feel you have reached this message in error.

usd.textbookx.com
Akademos
SentinelU
VitalSource Bookshelf
VitalSource Course Dashboard
Instructions
USD Online Bookstore digital course material access
First Day Access (FDA) digital course material must be accessed through D2L. Please refer to article Accessing First Day Access Materials
Login to D2L
Select your course
Select USD Resources in the red banner at the top of the page
Select USD Bookstore & Course Dashboard
Select the FDA digital content to access
If the digital content is not accessible through the Course Dashboard, the content will be linked in your instructor's D2L course, typically under the Content tab.

Sign in with your USD credentials

Select VitalSource Bookshelf My Library
Select eBook to read or for a courseware product, select to reveal Access Code to copy for use on the publisher site
Note: For course ware, products, the instructor must either provide a publisher course link in their D2L course or a course code to use on the publisher site. Once the instructor's publisher course is accessed, select to redeem your purchased access code.
If you are no longer enrolled at USD, to access your active VitalSource Bookshelf subscriptions
Create a non-USD VitalSource Bookshelf account
Contact VitalSource support to merge your active subscriptions to your non-USD VitalSource Bookshelf account
Learn more about VitalSource lifetime or perpetual license
If you bought the ebooks before May 2019, follow Accessing Barnes and Noble eBooks

fullText:

How do I enter a registration override for a student?
Environment
Self Service
Cause
The entry the professor puts on the student record DOES NOT REGISTER the student for the class but gives them permission to do so. The student must still register for the class online.
Resolution
Note: A registration override is like your signature on a drop/add form. It is a permission entry that a professor places on a student’s record in Self-Service that allows that student to register online for a CRN for which they would normally be ineligible
Examples:
Prerequisites not met
Co-req
Seat reserved for a specific major
Instructor approval required
Program restriction
Special approval
Time conflict filed of student
Dpartment restrictions and student attribute
Steps to Override
Note: An instructor is not able to override a closed section in self-service only instructor permission for a course
Log into Experience
Below Faculty Registration Tools Click Registration Overrides
Select Term
Click Submit
Type Student ID or First and last name
Click Submit
Note: In order to use the name query, the student MUST BE either an advise, already registered in a class or on the waitlist
Override
Click select type of Override you are granting
Course
Click select the course the Override is for
Note: You may add additional overrides for this student on this screen by repeating these steps on the second and third lines
Click Submit
If you have entered an override on a student’s record which needs to be removed, or the class is section is full contact the Registrar

Click Install

End Task on any open instances of Excel or Office

Follow the window prompts, press Enter/Go on the keyboard
From the Start menu, click Bloomberg
Click API Environment Diagnostics
Click Start
Click Yes to proceed
Click OK

Wait for repair to complete
From the Start menu, click Bloomberg

Click Options
Click Add-ins
From the Manage drop-down menu select Excel Add-ins

Click Browse
Browse to C:\blp\API\Office Tools
Select BloombergUl.xla
Click Open

Restart Excel

Cause

If Outlook is currently open on your machine, close it
Open Control Panel
Click Start
Type Control Panel

Click Mail

Click Options>>
Click New
Enter a Profile Name
Click OK
Enter the email address of the Shared Mailbox and press Enter
Authenticate with your USD credentials
Note: change the username to your username
Click Done when configuration finishes
Make sure the new profile you set up is selected and click OK
Note: the mailbox should open in Outlook
Go to Rules > Manage Rules and Alerts
From here you can create a new rule or modify existing rules
Note: once you are done you can close Outlook and open again as your default profile

description: How to create a batch file for a shared drive on a laptop

I have not been able to connect to the shared drive across campus on my HP Elitebook laptop.

Environment
Notepad
Windows
Resolution
Note: To map to the network share you need to be connected to VPN if working remotely
Open Notepad
Type net use X: (or preferred drive letter)
Press Spacebar once
Type \\usd.local\network _sharename (ie: \\usd.local\storage\student_services)
Click File
Select Save As
Choose Desktop
Type Network Share.bat
Click Save
Double click the file you just created
Open File Explorer to see if you are now connected to network drive
Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance

description: Instructions on usage of the Meet Me numbers. Maximum number of users is 10.
environment:
Cisco Voip Phones
Meet Me Numbers
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
How do I use Meet Me numbers?
Environment
Cisco Voip Phones
Meet Me Numbers
Cause
Resolution
Contact department secretary for Meet Me Number reservation (maximum number of participants is 10)
If you are hosting the meeting you must use the Meet Me button on your phone to start the conference
Pick up your headset or handset (depending on the phone)
Select the softkey MeetMe on your Cisco VoIP phone
You will hear two beeps > Enter your MeetMe Number
Check the display on the phone for Connection message, there are no audio confirmations that conference has been joined
Other participants should now be able to join the conference
If you are participating, dial the Meet Me Number itself without pressing the Meet Me button
Note: If all parties get a busy signal, no one has set it up as the host and someone will need to dial the number using the Meet Me button

Enter the model number of the printer giving the error
Scroll down to locate the drum model number
Order a replacement drum by following Creating a Cart in SDezBuy

Follow the installation instructions that come with the drum

description: How to search documents in ImageNow
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
How do I search in ImageNow
Environment
ImageNow
Perceptive Content
Resolution
Note: A quick search applies a single condition to the documents in the current view and returns the documents that satisfy that condition. You define the condition in the Quick Search tab, which includes the property list, operator list, and value box
Login to ImageNow
Click the drop down arrow beside Documents
In ImageNow Explorer
Click Views
Define your search conditions on the Quick Search Tab
Click Property List
Select Index Key
Student ID
Last Name, First Name M
DOB
Document Type
Click Operator List
Select an Operator that is used in comparison
is equal to
is greater than
Value Box
Select or type a value tp be compared to the documents property or field
Click Go
To search with multiple conditions
On the Search tab,
Click Add
In the Add Condition dialog box,
In the Constrain By list,
Click the kind of constraint for the lists you need in the Type, Field, and Operator boxes.
In the Type list,
Click Normal, Variable, LearnMode, or Prompted.
In the Field list,
Click the document field that is the basis of the comparison
Note If you search on the Notes field, ImageNow can search on only the first 50 characters of the field.
In the Operator list,
Select an operator,
Such as is equal to or is greater than that is used in the comparison.
In the Value box,
Enter or select the target value to be compared to the document field, using the selected operator.
Note If you selected Prompted as the type, the Message box replaces the Value box.
Click OK.
Repeat the previous steps in this procedure for any additional condition rows.
Note Each new row beings with AND by default. To change AND to OR, click AND.
Click Go

footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:

Environment
25Live
Cause
Event is in the wrong cabinent
Resolution
In 25Live, find the event by going to the "Go to Search" button
Go to the "Events" search
Click on "Advanced"
Click on the "Add Criteria" and choose "Contact"
Leave the "Any Role" option selected, click on the "Edit" button
Search for the name of the requestor of the event, click on the checkbox next to their name and click "Done"
Click on the "Search" button if it doesn't automatically start
Scroll to the event that you assigned the space for and click on the name of the event to open the details
Check the "Cabinet" information on the "Event Info" section of the event.
If the cabinet is one you don't have access to, please follow your scheduling procedures.

description: Installation instructions for network printer setup without print servers.
fullText:
Issue/Question
How do I install a network printer on a remote site that does not have access to a print server.
Environment
Windows
Resolution
Note: Installing a printer direct to IP is only used in certain cases. Verify that you cannot communicate with the main print server at USD Vermillion before proceeding.
Those cases include but may not be limited to
no local printer server at the site (RC Med, SDSD, etc)
certain special printers that may only function correctly when setup directly via IP.
Installing Instructions
Right-click
Click Search
Type Printers & Scanners
Click on the result
Click Add a printer or scanner
Click The printer that I want isn't listed
Check Add a local printer or network printer with manual settings
Click Next
Check Create a new port
Select Standard TCP/IP Port from the drop down menu
Click Next
Type the IPV4 address of the printer found in the configuration or displayed in the window on the printer
Click Next
Click OK
Select correct printer model driver from the list
Note: If you have a disk, click have disk, if not, run Windows update or download correct driver from the manufacturer's website
Name the printer something you will recognize
Click Next
Select Do not share this printer
Click Next
Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance

cause: Safe Links is a security feature of Microsoft's Advanced Threat Protection (ATP) that proactively protects the University from malicious links in email messages and Office documents
description: Safe Links is a security feature that proactively protects the University from malicious links in email messages and Office documents
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
Why do the links in my email look strange?
Is it safe to click links that have have safelinks.protection.outlook.com?
Environment
Email
Safe Links
Cause
Safe Links is a security feature of Microsoft's Advanced Threat Protection (ATP) that proactively protects the University from malicious links in email messages and Office documents
Resolution
Safe Links rewrites links in email following the pattern https://...safelinks.protection.outlook.com...
You may notice the link has changed in the email message, or you may notice it only when you hover over the link
Safe Links analyzes a link when you click to prevent malicious websites that try to steal your password or install ransomware

VitalSource
Verba Collect

Cause
Inclusive access materials are required
Resolution
To learn about the First Day Access/Inclusive Access (FDA) program contact adoptions@vitalsource.com.
Instructors adopting First-Day Access (FDA) materials need to reach out to the publisher and work with them to secure the ISBN for the specific course materials
Note: The instructor must confirm FDA materials each semester with the publisher.
When Adopting course materials in the USD Online Bookstore, the Instructor must log in to Verba Collect each semester to mark the course as FDA by the FDA term deadline
Log in to Verba Collect
Add the ISBN of the material that you want for your course by the deadline.
Select Required
A FDA popup will open
Select, "I'm in"
Submit the course adoption
Note: Marking the course as FDA in the online bookstore notifies the online bookstore to set up First Day Access on your course. After the deadline, you must also contact adoptions@vitalsource.com and notify them of your FDA adoption request.
Instructors will need to work with the publisher to incorporate the course material link into Desire2Learn(D2L).
Notes:
If you are teaching multiple sections of a course and are combining the D2L course shells, you must reach out to success@vitalsource.com as these need to be handled differently to function correctly.
For questions about how to set up the link within D2L, please contact your publisher representative
For bookstore questions, please contact adoptions@vitalsource.com
For other questions about D2L please contact the Center for Teaching and Learning

When Adopting course materials in the USD Online Bookstore, the Instructor must log in to Verba Collect each semester to mark the course as FDA by the FDA term deadline
Log in to Verba Collect
Add the ISBN of the material that you want for your course by the deadline.
Select Required
A FDA popup will open
Select, "I'm in"
Submit the course adoption
Note: Marking the course as FDA in the online bookstore notifies the online bookstore to set up First Day Access on your course. After the deadline, you must also contact adoptions@vitalsource.com and notify them of your FDA adoption request.
Instructors will need to work with the publisher to incorporate the course material link into Desire2Learn(D2L).
Notes:
If you are teaching multiple sections of a course and are combining the D2L course shells, you must reach out to success@vitalsource.com as these need to be handled differently to function correctly.
For questions about how to set up the link within D2L, please contact your publisher representative
For bookstore questions, please contact adoptions@vitalsource.com
For other questions about D2L please contact the Center for Teaching and Learning

description: Creating a new account on a personal computer after user is unable to log into their computer
fullText:
Issue/Question
I am not able to log into my computer. I was able to a short time ago.
Environment
Windows
InTune
Resolution
At the User Log in Screen, boot into Safe Mode by holding down SHIFT, then click power button, choose Restart
Click Troubleshoot
Click Advanced Options
Click Startup Settings
Click Restart
Press 5 for Enable Safe Mode With Networking
The computer will now boot into a newly created Admin account
Press + X
Click Computer Management
Select Local Users and Groups
Right-click Users
Choose New User
Enter a user name and password
Uncheck user must change password at next logon
Click OK
Double click the new account
Click Member Of tab
Click Add
In the box that says Enter the object name to select, type Administrators
Click Check Names
Click OK
Close out of the windows
Restart the computer
Log into the newly created account
Open the C drive
Open Users
The users files can be located in their previous user name
Copy the folders from the previous user folder to the new user folder

description: Summary of how to whitelist valid addresses or domains in Outlook in order for email to bypass the Junk E-Mail folder
environment:
Microsoft 365
Outlook on the Web
Microsoft Outlook
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
How to allow specific email senders to bypass the Junk E-Mail folder in Outlook
Environment
Microsoft 365
Outlook on the Web
Microsoft Outlook
Cause
Valid messages are being filtered to the Junk E-Mail folder in Outlook
Resolution
CAUTION - allowing messages to bypass filtering will in some cases leave you unprotected against phishing, malware, and ransomware attacks
To allow list a domain in Outlook, you can add it to the Safe Senders list. Here are the steps:
For Outlook on the Web:
Open Outlook on the web and go to Settings ()
Select Mail > Junk email
Under Safe senders and domains, click + Add
Enter the sender or domain you want to allow (e.g., example.com)
Click Save
For Classic Outlook Desktop App:
Open Outlook and go to the Home tab
Click on Junk in the Delete group, then select Junk E-mail Options
Go to the Safe Senders tab
Click Add and enter the sender or domain you want to allow (e.g., example.com)
Click OK and then Apply
For New Outlook Desktop App:
Open Outlook and go to Settings ()
Select Mail > Junk email
Under Safe senders and domains, click + Add safe sender
Enter the domain or email address you want to allow
Click Save
For Outlook Mobile App:
Open the Outlook app and go to Settings
Select the account you want to configure
Tap on Mail > Junk email
Under Safe senders and domains, add the sender or domain you want to allow

Environment
Computer Lab
Office Printer

Remove toner
Check paper path where toner was and make sure it is clear
Place toner back in printer
Run a test job to see if it is still noisy
Remove all paper trays
Make sure paper trays are not filled with too much paper
Put paper trays back in place
Run a test job to see if it is still noisy
If still noisy, please contact the Service Desk with the following information:
Location of printer
Make and Model of printer

cause: The goal of Knowledge Centered Service is to reuse, improve, and create knowledge as a by-product of service fulfillment. Knowledge Centered Service is a set of principles, practices, and techniques for creating, maintaining, and leveraging knowledge in an interactive environment.
description: Knowledge Centered Service is a set of principles, practices, and techniques for creating, maintaining, and leveraging knowledge in an interactive environment.
fullText:
Issue/Question
What is the Scope and Benefits of KCS
Environment
Knowledge Centered Service
Cause
The goal of Knowledge Centered Service is to reuse, improve, and create knowledge as a by-product of service fulfillment. Knowledge Centered Service is a set of principles, practices, and techniques for creating, maintaining, and leveraging knowledge in an interactive environment.
Resolution
Knowledge Centered Service is based on the following characteristics of knowledge:
it is gained through experience and interaction
it is never perfect or 100% complete
it is constantly evolving because we never stop learning
confidence in knowledge is gained through use, experience, and interaction
We understand that knowledge is never perfect, and knowledge is dynamic
Knowledge Centered Service guidelines can be used to capture and refine knowledge in order to reduce the risks of having an incomplete and incorrect knowledge base
Experience from organizations that have a mature Knowledge Centered Service systems show the benefits appear in three time horizons:
Operational (3 – 9 months)
25-50% improvement in resolution times
Improve first call resolution and reduced escalations
Improved skills, job satisfaction, confidence, and reduction in stress
Tactical (9 – 18 months)
Improvement in user success with self service
Reduced training time for new workers
Strategic (18 months and beyond)
Business improvements
Enabling of analytics

description: FUPLOAD
environment:
Microsoft Excel FUPLOAD spreadsheet
Financial Services has a Microsoft Excel spreadsheet that is provided to departments to generate FUPLOAD files that Financial Services can then push into Banner Finance
There is a tab in the spreadsheet named sql_import that contains a direct link to a SQL Server database containing Indexes and the Fund/Org/Programs the index represents
This data is used in the JV tab of the spreadsheet to VLOOKUP the values for Fund Org Program to the proper slots in the spreadsheet
The data in the sql_import tab AUTOPOPULATES on OPENING the spreadsheet; if it fails, it will keep the current data in the spreadsheet as of the time it was sent or last updated
If the user is not in a certain Active Directory group, the data refresh will not work

description: Steps for logging into Adobe Creative Cloud on a computer that uses a shared device license
fullText:
Issue/Question
Steps for logging into Adobe Creative Cloud on a computer that uses a shared device license
Environment
Computer Lab
Classroom
Cause
Adobe shared device license installed
Resolution
Open Adobe Application
Type USD credentials (full email address)
Note: If the user already has an Adobe ID with that address there will be an option to select Personal Account or Company or School Account
Select Company or School Account to be directed to the USD SSO page
At the USD SSO page type in credentials
The Adobe application will launch
Users must sign out when they are finished
Click Adobe Profile Icon in upper right and choose Sign Out or Help - Sign out
Note: If the user does not sign out of Adobe, the system will stay signed in to that account, even if someone different logs into the computer

description: Pen not writing in the expected location
environment:

Pen
fullText:
Issue/Question
Pen not writing in same place on the screen that I am touching
Pen is not calibrated to monitor
Environment
Classroom with SMART Podium or SMART Board/Display
Pen
Cause
Alignment off
Screen Scaling not 100%
The computer display mode is set to Extended mode and the wrong display is selected for orientation
Resolution
When a computer connected to a SMART Podium display is set to Extended mode, the pen can only be used when using Presenter View in PowerPoint to write on the slide. The pen orientation typically will default to the extended display. The pen will need to be oriented to the SMART podium display each time the display is set to Extended mode. The computer will reset to Duplicate mode when the user logs off. If you want to use the pen to annotate over other documents, web pages or applications you must be in Duplicate mode.
When a computer connected to a SMART Board/Display is set to Extended mode you may need to re-orient the pen to the SMART Board/Display. If the writing shows up on the monitor that sits on the instructor desk then the orientation will need to be switched to the SMART Board/Display. See steps for Align the pen (Extended Display mode).
Align the pen (Duplicate Display mode)
Select in the System Tray next to Date and Time
Right-click on the Smart icon
Select Orient
Follow directions on the screen
Align the pen (Extended Display mode)
Select in the System Tray next to Date and Time
Right-click on the Smart icon
Select Orient
If you do not see the target on the SMART display, press the space bar on the keyboard to change target to the SMART display
Follow directions on the screen
Reset Screen Scaling
Right-click on desktop
Click Display settings
Under Scale and layout
Set to 100% (Recommended)

description: Connecting to eduroam (wifi) on various devices. USD's Wi-Fi for Students, Faculty & Staff
fullText:
Question
How do I connect to eduroam wireless network
Products or Services Involved
eduroam
Windows OS
macOS
Chrome OS
Android
iOS
Wi-Fi for Students, Faculty & Staff
Instructions
Tips:
Eduroam - USD's on campus wifi for USD students, faculty, or staff
You need to disconnect from SDVisitor before completing the steps below
Make certain to Disable MAC Randomization
If you have connected to eduroam before at another university and are unable to connect at USD, You will need to remove the eduroam profile from your computer
Personal routers affect the quality of wifi and can interfere with others using wifi on campus.
Windows OS
Click eduroam in the wireless network list
Click Connect
Type your full USD email address and password into the username/password fields, full first.last@usd.edu or full first.last@coyotes.usd.edu
Click OK
Click Connect
Note: If you get the error Cant connect to this network, try again. You may need to do this a few times
Click Continue
Your device will now be registered on the network
macOS
Note: Newer versions of macOS may time out while entering information. Do the steps below in the Wifi Settings window.
Click eduroam in your wireless network list
Type your full USD email address and password into the username/password fields, full first.last@usd.edu or full first.last@coyotes.usd.edu
Note: Using Copy/Paste to enter your information may assist with the time out issue
Click Join
Click Continue
Approve the Update Settings if the computer requests it
If you have a previous connection to eduroam from another school
Open Settings
Click Profiles
Remove eduroam profile
Note: Additional steps may be necessary. See Removing Eduroam Profile on macOS
Android/Chromebook
Note: Android settings can be found in various places depending on your device. Some may be found under Advanced Settings
Note: If you have problems with the following instructions, turn your phone to Airplane mode and turn wireless back on
Tap eduroam in your wireless list
The following information should be set
Note: Do not use Randomized MAC. Use Phone MAC
EAP Method - PEAP
Phase 2 authentication - MSCHAPV2
Certificate - Do not validate
Note: Onn devices choose trust on first use
Identity - Type your full USD email address and password into the username/password fields, full first.last@usd.edu or full first.last@coyotes.usd.edu
Password - USD password
If it asks for a domain
domain - usd.edu
Identity - full first.last@usd.edu or full first.last@coyotes.usd.edu
Tap Connect
Your device will now be registered on the network
Google Pixel and Other Newer Android phones on Android 11 (Specific)
Tap eduroam in your wireless list
The following information should be set
Note: Do not use Randomized MAC. Use Phone MAC
EAP Method - PEAP
Phase 2 authentication - MSCHAPV2
CA Certificate - Use system certificates
Online Certificates Status - Request Certificate Status
If it asks for a domain
domain - usd.edu
Identity - Type your full USD email address and password into the username/password fields, full first.last@usd.edu or full first.last@coyotes.usd.edu
Note: If you have an older style username please still use your full first.last email address
Password - USD password
Note: Anonymous - Delete this line if it auto populates so the line is blank
Tap Connect
Your device will now be registered on the network
If you set your device to airplane mode, you can turn off airplane mode
iOS
Note: If you have problems with the following instructions, turn your phone to Airplane mode and turn wireless back on
Tap Settings
Tap Wi-Fi
Tap eduroam
Type your full USD email address and password into the username/password fields, full first.last@usd.edu or full first.last@coyotes.usd.edu
Note: If you have an older style username please still use your full first.last email address
Tap Join
Tap Trust
Tap Continue
Note: If you have previously connected and you get the error Unable to join the network "eduroam" forget the network and try again
Your device will now be registered on the network
If you set your device to airplane mode you can turn off airplane mode
Need More Help?
View Problem Connecting to WIFI or Connection Dropping
Click the Report Wireless Issue button on this page to submit a support request

cause: Toner used up
description: Instructions for toner replacement.
fullText:
Issue/Question
Copier is out of toner.
Environment
Sharp BC-70C31 Multi-function Copier
Cause
Toner used up
Resolution
Note: A new toner cartridge should be shipped to your department automatically when the toner is low. Do not replace until toner is empty.
Open the front cover
Pull both sides and lower from top down
The empty toner cartridge is ejected forward to enable removal
Pull gently as toner may spill out
Take new toner cartridge from its package and shake it horizontally five or six times
Slowly insert the new toner cartridge on the level
Note: Ensure to install a toner cartridge of the same color as a toner cartridge of a different color cannot be installed
Press firmly until you hear a click
Lift both sides of the front cover and close
The machine will automatically enter an image adjustment mode
Do no open the front cover while this is occurring
Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance.

fullText:

How to use videoconference equipment to dial into Zoom meetings

Connecting Cisco room equipment to zoom

How do we connect to a WebEx meeting in our conference room?
Environment
Zoom
WebEx
SIP
Room with videoconference capability
Cause
Scheduled web conference meeting, need assistance to connect to meeting room
Resolution
Start Host Computer
Note: Host computer only needed if hosting the meeting.
The meeting host starts the meeting on a computer other than the room computer
In the Zoom window on the meeting host computer click next to Share Screen
Click to check Multiple participants can share simultaneously
Start Classroom or Conference Room
Tap the Crestron touch panel in the room
Tap Video Conference Mode
Note: Display screen(s) will come on, or projector screen will come down and projector will turn on - wait for progress bar on Crestron touch panel to finish
At lower right of touch panel, tap Call Setup
Tap Default for Call Type
Type meeting SIP address
Note: For Zoom, format will be meetingID.passcode@zoomcrc.com
Tap Call
When connected, tap Close once
Tap Main Camera or Aux Camera depending on which image should be shown at the remote site
Note: Use camera control buttons to pan/tilt/zoom cameras as needed
If Hosting Zoom Meeting
On host computer in the Zoom meeting click Participants
Locate classroom or conference room in Participant list
If room is muted, click to the right of the room name to unmute
Note: You must wait 30 seconds for room to unmute. There is no other way for the room to respond to the unmute request.
Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance

fullText:

I’m wondering about the AMP parking app for phones?
Environment
AMP parking
AIMS
Resolution
AMP Parking – Quick & Easy Mobile Parking
Download the app
Google Play Store
Apple App Store
Web option: aimsmobilepay.com
Step-by-step instructions
Download the free AMP Park app on your smartphone
Select the area where you are parking on the map
Select the amount of time you would like to purchase
Add your license plate number, state it was issued and vehicle make
Add your payment information (credit or debit card)
Start your parking time
Save your information
If you will use AMP Park regularly on campus, save your account information. You can add multiple license plates if you drive different vehicles.
One-time use
You can enter information for a single parking session without creating an account.
Extend your time remotely
If your class or meeting runs longer than expected, you can add time to your parking session from your smartphone. You will receive a notification when you are nearing the end of your paid parking time.
AMP Park tips
Cannot download the app? Pay at aimsmobilepay.com. Search for your parking area by entering "USD" into the location search.
Avoid a ticket: Do not leave your vehicle until your payment has been made.
Before submitting payment: Check that all required fields are filled out.
Finding metered spaces: Signs in metered areas include QR codes you can scan with your smartphone to download the app directly.
Please contact University Police if you need further assistance

description: Determine the send policy
fullText:
Issue/Question
What is the send policy on a listserv?
Environment
Listserv
Resolution
If you are not the list owner please contact the Service Desk with the following information:
Name of the list you sending to or experiencing and an issue with
If you are the list owner
Login into listserv
Select your list in the drop down
Review the send policy
Send= Public: Anyone, including spammers, can send mail or files to the list.
Send= Public,Confirm: Anyone can send to the list, but LISTSERV will request confirmation from the sender using the OK mechanism. If the sender responds with "ok", the message will be posted to the list.
Send= Private: Only people who are subscribed to the list may send mail or files to the list. This setting won't protect your list from someone forging (i.e., spoofing) a subscriber's email address, and so unwanted email can still get to the list.
Send= Private,Confirm: Only people who are subscribed to the list may post to the list. LISTSERV will request confirmation from subscribers via the OK mechanism. Non-subscribers will not be able to post to the list; LISTSERV will send them a rejection message. Use this setting to protect your list from senders of forged email.
Send= Editor,Hold,Confirm: LISTSERV initially sends all postings to the list editor(s) that are defined in the list's Editor keyword. LISTSERV holds messages for a period of time (usually seven days) until an editor approves them with the OK mechanism. LISTSERV will advise senders that their messages have been forwarded to the list moderator. Use this setting to protect your list from someone trying to forge email from the Editor's address.
Note: The Hold option is valid only with Send= Editor.
Send= Owner: Only the list owner may send to the list.

fullText:

Environment
Cisco MX30
Xpanel
Smart Classrooms

Contact Nursing Office Manager for room and MX300 reservation
Hook up network and power cables after placing machine
Setup microphones and control panel in room
Adjust camera by clicking on the camera icon on the panel and choosing selfview. Use arrows to move camera
If connecting to a Zoom meeting choose Dial on the panel and enter the SIP address from your invite

If you want to share content, connect to the VGA and sound cable and choose share on the panel.
If you are in a smart classroom you can connect the Blue HDMI cable to the laptop HDMI cable in the room and setup content output to the projector using Laptop HDMI Option in XPanel on the room PC.

description: How to connect to your work computer using Remote Desktop Protocol
environment:
USD Work Computer
Working Remotely
Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP)
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
How do I connect to my work station remotely?
How do I use Remote Desktop Protocol RDP?
How can I access resources on my work computer remotely?
Environment
USD Work Computer
Working Remotely
Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP)
Cause
Some resources are restricted and can only be accessed from your work station
Resolution
Connecting to Computer
Note: Cisco AnyConnect must be successfully authenticated to access office computer or you must be on the USD network
Find the Computer Name of the computer you wish to connect to
From your current computer, open the Windows Remote Desktop Connection app
Click Run or Search
Type MSTSC
Press Enter
Type in the Computer Name obtained in Step 1
Note: This can be the "NI" tag or IP address of the office computer
Note: The computer you are connecting to must be turned on
To connect multiple monitors if computer you are using and computer connecting to both have multiple monitors:
Click Show Options
Click Display
Click to check Use all my monitors for the remote session
Click Connect
Enter your USD Credentials
Note: If using a personal computer you may have to click More Choices and enter usdlocal\ in front of your USD username
Press Enter
Note: If asked to accept the certificate, check Don't ask me again for connections to this computer
Click Yes
To Disconnect
Right-Click on the icon on your Task Bar
Click Disconnect

cause: I want to be able to subdivide my Zoom meeting.
description: Enable the Breakout Room setting in Zoom account settings
fullText:
Issue/Question
How do I enable breakout rooms in Zoom?
Environment
Zoom
Cause
I want to be able to subdivide my Zoom meeting.
Resolution
Log in to Zoom
Click Sign In
Sign In with your USD credentials
Click Settings on the left side of the screen
Click In Meeting (Advanced)
Click the gray radio button next to Breakout Room
Note: The radio button will turn blue. If the radio button is already blue, Breakout Rooms are already enabled.
If you don't see this option it is possible you are not a licensed user. Faculty and Staff accounts are licensed by default, student accounts are not.
If you need to request a licensed account please contact the Service Desk with the following information:
Full Name
Reason a licensed account is needed
Note: A maximum of 200 participants may be pre-assigned to breakout rooms prior to the meeting start

fullText:
Issue/Question
How do I set up a home HotSpot?
Environment
Hotspot
Verizon Jetpack
Cause
Resolution
Note: These direction were designed using a Verizon Jetpack. Please review the documentation included with your hotspot packaging for any differences
Note: Hotspots on campus is prohibited and will interfere with quality of Wi-Fi
If the HotSpot is new
Insert SIM Card into HotSpot
Insert battery into HotSpot
Charge HotSpot by plugging into an outlet
Save all packaging and documentation from box
After HotSpot has been setup and is charged, turn on HotSpot by pressing On/Off button
Check if HotSpot has data, do this by pressing On/Off button until screen scrolls to data screen. You should see an indication that data is available
Go to laptop or other device that needs to be connected to the Internet and connect to the HotSpot
A password is needed, to get the password from the HotSpot, press the On/Off button on the HotSpot until the display shows the password
Enter password on your device

cause: To support employees when working remotely, this page covers the technology and information you need to create a successful remote work environment.
description: Use this information and downloads for the most essential services for successful work from home experience.
environment:
Working Remotely
Technology
Remote Work Environment
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
Is my computer ready to work from home?
Environment
Working Remotely
Technology
Remote Work Environment
Cause
To support employees when working remotely, this page covers the technology and information you need to create a successful remote work environment.
Resolution
ITS recommends using a University owned laptop to work remotely
Note: If using a USD laptop, you need to sign into the laptop while connected to the USD network before you can sign in off-site
Test it at home to verify you have access to everything needed
Recommended applications can be found at Teaching and Working Remotely
To protect your data and USD's network, you must have access to each of these security and productivity tools and services
Windows Security - Antivirus software is already configured on USD Windows computers
Duo Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
Setup access to Virtual Private Network (VPN)
We recommend a headset that can connect to your computer to reduce background noise and improve sound quality for meetings
Internet Speed
Test your internet connection from your remote location by going to www.speedtest.net
Click GO
3 Mbps upload and 10 Mbps download speeds are considered fast enough for typical work activities
Maximum bandwidth consumption of Sending and Receiving Video:
High Definition Video: 2.5 Mbps and 3.0 Mbps
High Quality Video: 1.0 Mbps and 1.5 Mbps
Standard Quality Video: 0.5 Mbps and 0.5 Mbps

fullText:
Issue/Question
How do I log into Lawrence on a Mac or Linux computer?
Environment
Lawrence HPC
BASH terminal
Cause
Need to utilize the Lawrence HPC resource
Resolution
Note: You can also find a tutorial on the USD Research Computing Group website.
Note: To request access, please submit the High Performance Computing request form
Mac Users only: Download XQuartz
Note: Administrator permissions for the computer may be required for this step
Note: This is only if you wish to run GUI applications (X11 forwarding)
Open a terminal
Once the command prompt appears, type ssh your.UserName@lawrence.usd.edu
Note: Your username is often your first (given) name, a period (.), and your last name (surname) with no spaces (e.g., ssh Charlie.Coyote@lawrence.usd.edu)
When the password prompt appears, type your password
Note: When passwords are typed in a bash shell, the cursor doesn't move or blink
Complete your Duo second authentication method
You must approve the Push on your mobile device
OR You must type in the six-digit passcode from the Duo token (ie. 123456) and press enter
If login is successful, a welcome message and new command prompt will appear
Note: if you mistyped your password, the system will send you back to step 4
