description: Change Zoom settings to ensure maximum security in your Zoom meetings.
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
How do I prevent people from sharing unwanted or objectionable content in my Zoom meetings?
How do I prevent Zoombombing?
Environment
Zoom
Cause
Other institutions have seen a rise in outside actors sharing racist, vulgar, or otherwise objectionable content in a Zoom meeting.
Resolution
General Tips/Guidelines
Don't share your Zoom meeting link in public places like social media or on your website
Only send the meeting password to people who will be attending
Update your Zoom app to include the latest security enhancements
Setup Your Zoom Account
Note: Some of these settings limit the interaction you can have with the people in your Zoom Meetings. If you have questions about what settings are right for you please Contact the Service Desk
Log in to Zoom
Click Sign In
Click Settings
Check Require a password when scheduling new meetings
Set Sharing to Host Only
Check Only authenticated users can join meetings
Uncheck Virtual Background
Uncheck Allow Annotation
Uncheck Allow Whiteboard
Uncheck Allow Removed Participants to Rejoin
Uncheck Allow Participants to Rename Themselves
Check Allow Waiting Room
Note: This will require you to admit users to your Zoom meeting from the Waiting Room
Check Mute Participants on Entry
Uncheck Allow Participants to send a message visible to all participants
Note: These settings will only affect future meetings, be sure to remake any meetings you had previously scheduled so the new settings are applied.
In the Zoom Meeting
Click Manage Participants
Click More
Uncheck Allow Participants to Unmute themselves
Note: You will need to allow individuals who have a question to unmute themselves. Alternatively, you can leave this setting unchecked and only use it if you are experiencing issues.
Familiarize yourself with Removing Participants
Note: If you remove a participant, you will need to end and restart the meeting it you want them to re-join
Next to the participant you want to remove click More
Click Remove
Familiarize yourself with Turning off Participants Video
Next to the participant whose video you want to disable click More
Click Stop Video
Lock your meeting once everyone has joined
Click Security in the Zoom Meeting bottom ribbon
Click Lock Meeting
Familarize yourself with the Security Button
You can use the button to lock the meeting, enable the waiting room, change who can share screen, chat, and rename themselves
Note: For more information on security settings available in Zoom see Zoom's instructions on securing your meeting

cause: Need a USD supported and HIPAA compliant tool for holding virtual appointments with patients
description: Tips for using Webex for telehealth
fullText:
Issue/Question
Can Webex be used for Telehealth?
Our clinic needs to meet with patients virtually, what can we use?
Environment
Cisco Webex
Cause
Need a USD supported and HIPAA compliant tool for holding virtual appointments with patients
Resolution
Cisco Webex is a HIPAA compliant solution for meeting with remote patients
Set your administrative staff to be able to schedule Webex appointments on your behalf https://help.webex.com/en-us/nub7z8c/Allow-Another-Host-to-Schedule-Meetings-or-Training-Sessions-on-Your-Behalf
Schedule patient appointment in your clinician scheduling system
Send patient appointment email and Webex tips https://www.webex.com/content/dam/webex/eopi/assets/healthcare/AdministrativePreparePatientsForTelehealtht.pdf
Schedule appointment in Webex adding the patient as an Attendee
Copy Webex details to clinician's calendar so they also have the Webex appointment information
Join the meeting at the set time
Alternately, a Space can be created https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/hk71r4/Webex-App-%7C-Create-a-space
Set up a permanent Webex meeting link https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/65gqjh/Set-up-a-permanent-Webex-meeting-link-for-instant-meetings
See https://www.webex.com/webexremotehealth.html for tips on using Webex for telehealth purposes
If you do not have access to usd.webex.com with your USD credentials Your supervisor will need to contact the Service Desk to request access

description: How to Enable Polling in personal Zoom account.
fullText:
Issue/Question
How do I enable Polling in Zoom?
Environment
Zoom
Cause
I would like to Poll students in Zoom meeting
Resolution
Note: The HOST is the only one able to create Polls.
Co-Hosts and Alternative-Hosts can start a poll that has been created by the Host.
Log in to Zoom
Click Sign in
Sign in with your USD credentials
Click Settings on the left side of the screen
Click in Meeting (Basic)
Click the gray radio button next to Polling
Note: The radio button will turn blue. If the radio button is already blue, Breakout Rooms are already enabled.
If you don't see this option it is possible you are not a licensed user. Faculty and Staff accounts are licensed by default, student accounts are not. If you need to request a licensed account please contact the Service Desk with the following information:
Full Name
Reason a licensed account is needed
Note: Zoom from D2L does have the ability to import a Poll from a .csv file. Zoom from Zoom app does not allow .csv import.

Endnote
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
Page Numbers showing as { PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT } in Word with Endnote installed.
Environment
Microsoft Word 365
Windows 10
Microsoft Office 365
Endnote
Cause
Word and Endnote conflict or Word format issue.
Resolution
Press Alt+F9 to show field codes
The page number field will show up as either { PAGE } or { PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT } in a grey highlight
Replace this with { PAGE \# 0# }
Press Alt+F9 again to return to field values

Issue/Question
Scanning Options using your Phone/Apps – Changing a Picture into a PDF Document
Environment
Banner
Xtender
Resolution
Scanning Options using your Phone
Depending on the type of phone you have, below are a few options that will enable you to take a picture of your document and turn it into a PDF
Note: Search and obtain these free apps on your phone, in the App Store
Android available Apps
Microsoft Office Lens (no ads)
Simple Scanner
Document Scanner – PDF Creator
Apple available Apps
Microsoft Office Lens (no ads)
Photos to PDF Image converter
Once your document is saved as a PDF
Email it to yourself
Save the PDF to your desktop or another drive on your computer

While in Banner Document, Click ADD
Click New Page
Click Import File
Click Append
Browse to the PDF you saved in step #2b of Scanning Options using your Phone
Click Open
You can now view the document in Xtender
Click New Document Icon, the piece of paper with an orange star
Enter the document number and type of document
Click Save
To see detailed instructions with screenshots open the Scanning Options file on the right side of the page

I responded to an email. Is there a way to recall it quickly?
Environment
Outlook 365
Cause
Mistakenly sent an email
Resolution
Open Outlook application
Click on Sent Items
Double click on the message you want to recall
Go to the Message tab
In the Move group click on More Move Actions
Click on Recall This Message
A popup will appear
Select the appropriate options and click OK
Note: Recalling an email message will only be successful if the following conditions are met:
The recipient has a USD email address (It will not work if the message was sent to someone outside the University)
The message must still be unread and in the recipient's Inbox

Click Next

Click Install apps
Click Microsoft 365 apps
Click Install Office

Run the file that is downloaded

description: How to View Shared Envelopes in DocuSign
fullText:
Issue/Question
How can I see my shared envelopes in DocuSign?
Environment
DocuSign
Resolution
Note: USD has SSO (single sign on) implemented for DocuSign. Shared mailboxes, such as HR@usd.edu can now be used in DocuSign by sharing envelopes. With shared envelopes, users on the same account can view and take action on shared envelopes. Team members and delegates can help each other with management tasks, such as sending reminders or correcting recipient information. The shared access to these shared mailboxes will be assigned to the appropriate users of the shared email address.
To view your shared envelopes:
Log into DocuSign
Click Manage
On left side, click Shared Envelopes
If you have access to others' envelopes, the Shared Envelopes window opens, listing all the user names of the people whose envelopes are shared with you
Select a user and click Select
You will now see the Inbox view showing all received documents that have been shared
Note: When viewing shared envelopes, you remain in the shared user's view as you navigate around the application
To return to your own envelopes:
Click Return to my Envelopes link in the banner at the top of the page
To add a user to Shared Envelopes:
If a user needs to be added to your Shared Envelopes, you will need to contact the Service Desk with the following information:
Your name and email address
Name and email of user to be shared

Click Next
Specify where to store the digital ID
Click Next
Fill out the needed information
Note: Leave the pre-filled areas as is

Create a password
Confirm password
Click Finish

description: Outlines the steps needed to get data from PsychData to Qualtrics
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
Is it possible to copy surveys from PsychData to Qualtrics
Environment
Qualtrics
PsychData
Cause
USD chose Qualtrics to replace all other survey software on campus
Resolution
Note: Surveys cannot be copied over but it is possible to use the following work around to import the data into a manually created Qualtrics survey that mirrors PsychData's survey, then import the data into Qualtrics
Log into Qualtrics
Create a Survey in Qualtrics
Download Survey Data from Qualtrics
Download PsychData Survey Data
Make a copy of the Qualtrics data spreadsheet that was downloaded
Copy the columns from the PsychData spreadsheet into the appropriate columns on the Qualtrics spreadsheet (use the copy so the original can be referenced)
Note: the PsychData data has to match format of the the sample data pulled from Qualtrics, make sure to remove the sample data in the Qualtrics spreadsheet
If the PsychData survey does not have data for some Qualtrics column fields, leave those blank and do not map them when doing the import
If the PsychData values and the new values do not match when importing, it is possible to map the field and map the individual items during the import
Make sure dates are in a date format on the excel spreadsheet, if they are text, which is what they seem to export as, by default, out of PsychData
Create a new column and use the Value Function (=Value(A3)) to convert date and time to Excel Date time
Create a new column formatted as a Custom with format MM/DD/YYYY H:MM
Copy column created in step 1 above and paste as values into the column created in number 2 above
Copy column from step 3 and paste into original date column being converted
Repeat 1-4 for each date field
Remove columns added to get date converted
Save the file with a name that ends with .csv -- such as, mynewfile.csv
Import Data to the Qualtrics Survey

sections.heading: Cause
sections.text: USD chose Qualtrics to replace all other survey software on campus

sections.heading: Resolution
sections.text:
Note: Surveys cannot be copied over but it is possible to use the following work around to import the data into a manually created Qualtrics survey that mirrors PsychData's survey, then import the data into Qualtrics
Log into Qualtrics
Create a Survey in Qualtrics
Download Survey Data from Qualtrics
Download PsychData Survey Data
Make a copy of the Qualtrics data spreadsheet that was downloaded
Copy the columns from the PsychData spreadsheet into the appropriate columns on the Qualtrics spreadsheet (use the copy so the original can be referenced)
Note: the PsychData data has to match format of the the sample data pulled from Qualtrics, make sure to remove the sample data in the Qualtrics spreadsheet
If the PsychData survey does not have data for some Qualtrics column fields, leave those blank and do not map them when doing the import
If the PsychData values and the new values do not match when importing, it is possible to map the field and map the individual items during the import
Make sure dates are in a date format on the excel spreadsheet, if they are text, which is what they seem to export as, by default, out of PsychData
Create a new column and use the Value Function (=Value(A3)) to convert date and time to Excel Date time
Create a new column formatted as a Custom with format MM/DD/YYYY H:MM
Copy column created in step 1 above and paste as values into the column created in number 2 above
Copy column from step 3 and paste into original date column being converted
Repeat 1-4 for each date field
Remove columns added to get date converted
Save the file with a name that ends with .csv -- such as, mynewfile.csv
Import Data to the Qualtrics Survey

title: Copying Data from PsychData to Qualtrics Manually Created Survey

Issue/Question
Need to import data file into a Qualtrics survey from Psychdata
Environment
Qualtrics
Excel
Cause
USD chose Qualtrics to replace all other survey software on campus
Resolution
Logon to Qualtrics
Click Project
Click Survey that data is to be imported into
Click Data & Analysis
Click Export & Import
Click Import Data
Click Browse and select the.csv file created from the PsychData data
Note: This can be in CSV, TSV, or TXT format
Select the proper delimiter, which should be comma for data coming from PsychData
Note: Select proper delimiter if coming from another survey software
Click Upload
Configure the Import dialog box pops up
Click More Options at the bottom of the screen
Type a value into the Responses start at row number field, so it will ignore headings above that row, and only look at data rows
Select central time zone
Select proper date/time format for your file, example MM/DD/YYYY H:MM - this must match or it will not import
Now go through each field
Map the data to the correct field or mark it as Ignore column if you have no data for that field
Click Import
For more information see: Qualtrics Data and Analysis Tab > Data > Import Responses
Please contact the Service Desk for further assistance

description: How to handle email messages that have a warning stating the sender is suspicious
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
Why does this email message have a warning at the top?
mary@example.com appears similar to someone who previously sent you email, but may not be that person.
Environment
Outlook
Security Tip
Cause
The sender's name matched a name in your mailbox, but the email address is different
Attackers create an email address that contains a USD employee name, then send an email to that employee's subordinates asking for a quick response or text message
Employees mistakenly send an email to a University address using their personal account
Resolution
Don't reply to the message
If there's a phone number, do not call or message that number
Confirm the sender is who they claim to be
Confirm the email address is known to you
If there is a phone number in the message, confirm is it known to you
If you determine the message is not legitimate, follow the Reporting Suspicious or Malicious Email
If you determine the message is legitimate
Use normal channels, such as a University email address, to contact the sender
Inform them they are using a personal email account to contact a University email address

description: How to create a DocuSign template of templates for electronic signature
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
I need a template of templates created in DocuSign for electronic signature
Environment
DocuSign
Resolution
Log into the DocuSign TEST Environment
Enter your USD email address
Select the blue Use Company log in button
Select your first Template in chronological order
Note: Templates to be grouped should be created prior to creating a template of templates
Click Use
Within the Select Templates dialog box select and add the templates needed
Click Add Selected
Then drag and drop the templates in the order needed
Templates need to have the same Role Name, Role Action and Routing Order for the signer or signers across all templates
https://support.docusign.com/en/articles/How-to-use-multiple-templates
To finish your template, click ACTIONS -> SAVE AND CLOSE
The rename your template you will need to modify/rename after creation from the My Templates section
Your template is saved and ready to use

description: How to Schedule a Webex Meeting
fullText:
Issue/Question
How can I schedule a Webex meeting?
Environment
Webex
Resolution
Go to usd.webex.com
Click Sign (upper right corner)
Click Schedule
Enter a topic for your meeting in the Meeting topic: field
Enter a password for the meeting in the Password: field
Choose the date and time the meeting will occur from their respective drop-down menus
Enter the email addresses of the attendees you would like to invite in Attendees field
Note: Click Show Advances Options to set Audio Connections Options, Agenda or Scheduling Options
Click Schedule Meeting button
Schedule a Meeting in Microsoft Outlook
Click Home ribbon in Microsoft Outlook
Click Schedule Meeting
In the drop-down list, choose from the following:
Schedule Webex Meeting–Webex meetings are the standard meeting choice
Schedule Personal Room Meeting–Personal Rooms are your own virtual conference room. It’s always available and you don’t have to book it
Schedule Personal Conference Meeting–Personal Conference meetings are for meetings using telephony service provider (TSP) audio.ease
Select To and choose who you want to invite to your meeting
Add Meeting title and Location
Choose the Start time and End time for your meeting
Enter any other necessary information in the email invitation and click Send
Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance

description: How to transfer a VoIP call
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
How to transfer a call to another person
Environment
Cisco VoIP
Cause
When you transfer a call, you can stay on the original call until the other person answers. This way, you can talk privately with the other person before you remove yourself from the call. If you don't want to talk, transfer the call before the other person answers.
Resolution
From a call that is not on hold, press Transfer
Enter the other person's phone number
(Optional) Wait until you hear the line ring or until the other person answers the call
Press Transfer again

cause: You can put an active call on hold and then resume the call when you're ready. When you place a video call on hold, video transmission is blocked until you resume the call.
description: How to place a VoIP call on Hold
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
How can I place a call on hold
Environment
Cisco VoIP
Cause
You can put an active call on hold and then resume the call when you're ready. When you place a video call on hold, video transmission is blocked until you resume the call.
Resolution
Press Hold
To resume a call from hold, press Hold again
When you've left a call on hold too long, you'll be notified with these cues:
Single ring, repeating at intervals
Flashing amber line button
Flashing message indicator on the handset
Visual notification on the phone screen

cause: For each day in a given census week, this report shows how many students are entering and leaving a building as recorded by each events start and end time.
description: Directions on how to run the Building Activity Change Times Report in 25Live
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
How do I run the Building Activity Change Times Report in 25Live?
Environment
25Live
Cause
For each day in a given census week, this report shows how many students are entering and leaving a building as recorded by each events start and end time.
Resolution
Log into 25Live Pro
Note: This report is not available in Simplified
Click in the upper right-hand corner
Click Reports
Click Location Reports in the horizontal navigation
Click Select an item
Click Building Activity Change Times
Fill out these fields:
Census Date: Change this to the week you are interested in reviewing
Location Search: Pick an option from the drop down box
USD has a couple public searches for classrooms, you can use one of those if you don’t have a search saved yourself.
Use X25 Building and Floor: No
Sum Bound Head Counts: No
Report Delivery Options: View this report now
Report Format Options: format you are interested in viewing
Click Run Report
This report will open a new tab in your browser and will download a file for you to review.
Note:If nothing happens, confirm you do not have pop up blocking turned on.
issue: How do I run the Building Activity Change Times Report in 25Live?

cause:
Microsoft 365 Anti-spam Policy
Microsoft 365 uses Spam Confidence Level (SCL) and Bulk Complaint Level (BCL) to rate incoming email messages. Some messages may deliver to your Junk folder when the SCL or BCL reaches a threshold value.
Microsoft 365 Anti-phishing Policy
Microsoft 365 uses Mailbox Intelligence to compare the sender for incoming email to senders with whom you've interacted previously. Messages may deliver to your Junk folder and add a Security Tip when a sender's name matches a previous sender's name, but the email address is different. Microsoft 365 also provides anti-spoofing protection to protect you from fraudulent messages. For example, if you configure an external survey to send an email as you, Microsoft 365 may deliver that message to Junk.
Outlook Junk E-mail Options
Outlook attempts to identify messages that are likely junk and move them to the Junk folder. You can Change the level of protection in the Junk Email Filter, or you can Allow Senders to Bypass Junk E-mail Folder.

Cause
Chrome has wrong settings that prevent video from playing
The wrong link was used in D2L
The wrong link was selected to share with others
Possible typo when posting link
Resolution
Sometimes Chrome needs to be reset.
Open Chrome
Click the three dots in the upper right corner of Chrome window
Choose Settings
Click Advanced
Click Reset and clean up
Click Restore settings to their original defaults
Click Reset settings
If there is an error message on the video window, "The media could not be loaded, either because the server or network failed or because the format is not supported."
Copy URL at the very bottom of the D2L page and paste that into a new tab or window.
Instructors:
There are at least two ways to get the links for a Zoom recording to verify they are correct.
Email will be sent to you when recording is finished, processed and ready.
When a recording is done, by default you will receive an email with two links
Use the Shareable Link for your Zoom Recordings in D2L or emails
usd.zoom.us/recordings/detail?meeting####.... is only for the original host to view and edit
usd.zoom.us/rec/share/####..... is for sharing with anyone
Look up any/all of your recordings under your Zoom Account
Sign into your USD Zoom account at usd.zoom.us
Under your profile - click Recordings
Click Topic that you would like to review recording
Click Copy sharable link button
Paste into Email or D2L
Instructors - there have been times when D2L and links to videos do not play well together. If you have problems with students accessing videos, you can change the properties of the "Link" in D2L by selecting "Edit Link" and clicking on the "Open as External Resource."

cause:
Factors affecting quality of Wi-Fi
Distance & Interference
Most areas on campus and the residential halls have wireless network coverage. If when moving closer to a Wi-Fi access point you note improved speed or connectivity, Distance from an access point may be playing a role in the quality of Wi-Fi for you.
Another major factor in quality of Wi-Fi is Interference. Interference occurs when devices operate on the same radio frequency as your connecting device and a Wi-Fi access point. This interference will negatively impact the quality of Wi-Fi and can result in slow internet, frequent drops, or the inability to connect at all. Two Wi-Fi frequencies are available on campus, 2.4Ghz and 5Ghz. If you have a device that can connect at 5Ghz this is recommended. The 5Ghz frequency is less likely to be interfered with by other wireless devices. 5Ghz is the primary frequency for residential halls. In other areas of campus, we have a mix of 2.4Ghz and 5Ghz. Most interference occurs in the 2.4Ghz range as it is preferred by more basic wireless devices.
Some common devices that cause interference in both the 2.4Ghz and 5Ghz frequencies are listed below.
2.4Ghz - Wireless Standards b/g/n
Rogue APs (non-university access points and routers)
Hot Spots provided by cellular carriers.
Microwaves (while running)
Wireless Game Controllers
Wireless Printers
Wireless Peripherals (headsets, speakers, remotes, etc)
Cordless Phones
Bluetooth Devices
5Ghz - Wireless Standards a/n/ac/ax
Rogue APs (non-university access points and routers)
Hot Spots provided by cellular carriers.
Cordless Phones
Radar

Follow the How to Disable Wi-Fi Direct on Roku Devices if you are not actively using that feature

Please contact the Service Desk and Housing so the unauthorized devices can be removed

footer:
Note: If your make or model is not listed please reference your user manual or vendors website
Hewlett Packard (HP)
Most HP Models:
Use the menu to navigate to:
Setup
Network
Wireless Radio (on some models, this is towards the bottom of the scrollable menu)
Turn the Wireless Radio OFF
HP Photosmart d110:
Press the button on the bottom front of the printer to turn the light out and service off
Note: You may need to hold the button for 5 seconds to turn the light out
If this is not successful, use the menu to navigate to:
Settings
Wireless
Wireless settings
Disable Wireless
OK
HP Laserjet p1102w:
Press and hold the button on the left-hand button panel for 5 seconds to turn the light out and service off
HP Photosmart c4780:
From the front panel, choose Scan
Scroll up or down to select Networking
Turn off Wireless
If the wireless indicator persists:
Shut the printer down
Then, hold the wireless and cancel buttons together while powering the printer back on
Wait for all the lights to flash together and then let the buttons go
Epson models:
Press the Setup button
Select Wi-Fi/Network Settings
Select Wi-Fi Setup
Select Wi-Fi Setup Wizard
Select Disable Wi-Fi
For most Canon models:
Press and hold the RESUME/CANCEL button
Release the button when the POWER lamp flashes 12 times
Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance

cause: Roku WiFi-Direct operates on the same frequency as USD's Wi-Fi. Roku uses WiFi-Direct to connect some remotes, which utilize and broadcast on the same channel that it receives internet from. The result is that there will be interference, even on 5 GHz, causing other devices to either drop the signal intermittently or fail to connect, or lower bandwidth. Additionally, some Roku models have a feature called interference mitigation enabled by default. This technology disrupts traffic to nearby Wi-Fi access points to attempt to improve local signal. These features can affect performance of USD's wireless network for everyone.
description: How to disable Wi-Fi Direct on Roku Devices

Note: If your make or model is not listed please reference your user manual or vendors website
Roku 2:

Select Disable Device Connect

Select System

Select Device connect
Choose Disable Device Connect
You are finished

Environment
Wi-Fi
Network
Dorms
eduroam

Disable Randomization on Android
Open Settings app
Select Network and Internet
Select WiFi
Tap the next to the eduroam wifi connection
Select Advanced
Select Privacy
Select Use device MAC
Disable Private Address Apple iOS 14 or higher
Open Settings
Tap Wi-Fi
Tap button next to eduroam network
Tap Private Address to turn to Fixed
Disable Private Address Apple watch
Open Settings
Tap Wi-Fi
Tap eduroam network
Tap
Tap Private Address to turn it to Fixed
Mac OS
Click system settings
Click Wifi
Click eduroam
Click Details
Click Private Address to turn it to Fixed
Disable Private Address Windows 10
Select the Start button in the bottom left corner of the screen
Select the gear icon to go to Settings
Select Network and Internet
Select Wifi
Set Use random hardware addresses to Off
Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance

description: Schedule a meeting using Microsoft FindTime in Outlook
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
How do I schedule a meeting using Scheduling Poll in Outlook?
Environment
Microsoft Office 365
Microsoft Outlook
Resolution
Scheduling Poll in Outlook allows you to send meeting options to a group of people who can then select their meeting preference. Outlook will automatically select the most preferred time slot and schedule the appointment for everyone.
Create a new email or select an email to reply to
Required meeting attendees must be in the To field and optional attendees in the Cc field
In the Message tab select New Scheduling Poll
Fill in meeting settings
Select a few meeting times to be voted on
Click Next
Enter the meeting location
Click Manage Poll settings and toggle the ON/OFF options
Click Create Poll
Click Send to send the invites and start the voting process
Once a time has been selected Outlook will automatically send a calendar invite
To add a Zoom meeting open the calendar item and click Schedule a Meeting
Note: This feature requires the Zoom Outlook Plugin
Select your meeting options and click Save
Click Save and Close or Send Update
Note: To see times outside normal business hours toggle the Meeting hours button off

description: We recommend using Microsoft Teams over standard SharePoint sites for most use cases. Recently Microsoft has been pushing users towards Microsoft Teams and are they are rapidly expanding its capabilities. The core capabilities in Microsoft Teams include business messaging, calling, video meetings...
fullText:
Issue/Question
My research lab is using SharePoint as a file hub for our study. We wondering about backing up information stored on the site. Is that something individual users should be doing, or is that something that is automatically backed up through USD somehow? If the latter, how would we go about retrieving backed up files if needed? Relatedly, we were wondering about backing up files on USD computers (using USD login credentials) in general. How can that be done or how do you suggest going about it?
Environment
Windows
Microsoft SharePoint
Microsoft Teams
Resolution
We recommend using Microsoft Teams over standard SharePoint sites for most use cases. Recently Microsoft has been pushing users towards Microsoft Teams and are they are rapidly expanding its capabilities. The core capabilities in Microsoft Teams include business messaging, calling, video meetings, and file sharing.
Information video: https://support.office.com/en-us/article/video-...
Getting started is easy and you don't even need someone from IT. Team Site creation is simple:
Go to https://teams.microsoft.com
Sign in with your USD Email Address
Select Work or School account
Sign in with your USD Email and Password
Click Join or Create a team at bottom of screen
Select Create Team to create a new team
Enter a name and add a short description
By default, your team is Private, meaning you'll have to add the people or groups you want on the team
Note: Select Public if you want anyone in the organization to be able to find and join the team
Add Members
Note: You can add people, groups, or even entire contact groups
Note: If you need to add people from outside your organization, use their email address to invite them as guests
When you're done adding members, select Add and then Close
Here are some other training videos for teams: https://support.office.com/en-us/article/micros...
Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance

Is that something individual users should be doing, or is that something that is automatically backed up through USD somehow? If the latter, how would we go about retrieving backed up files if needed? Relatedly, we were wondering about backing up files on USD computers (using USD login credentials) in general. How can that be done or how do you suggest going about it?

sections.heading: Environment
sections.text:
Windows
Microsoft SharePoint
Microsoft Teams

sections.heading: Resolution
sections.text:
We recommend using Microsoft Teams over standard SharePoint sites for most use cases. Recently Microsoft has been pushing users towards Microsoft Teams and are they are rapidly expanding its capabilities. The core capabilities in Microsoft Teams include business messaging, calling, video meetings, and file sharing.
Information video: https://support.office.com/en-us/article/video-...
Getting started is easy and you don't even need someone from IT. Team Site creation is simple:
Go to https://teams.microsoft.com
Sign in with your USD Email Address
Select Work or School account
Sign in with your USD Email and Password
Click Join or Create a team at bottom of screen
Select Create Team to create a new team
Enter a name and add a short description
By default, your team is Private, meaning you'll have to add the people or groups you want on the team
Note: Select Public if you want anyone in the organization to be able to find and join the team
Add Members
Note: You can add people, groups, or even entire contact groups
Note: If you need to add people from outside your organization, use their email address to invite them as guests
When you're done adding members, select Add and then Close
Here are some other training videos for teams: https://support.office.com/en-us/article/micros...
Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance

title: SharePoint Backup

cause: Zoom by default is trying to make the audio consistent. That is not optimal during a video or with music. These setting should help.
description: Optimal settings for Zoom to play video/music to participants
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
Audio quality is not good playing music or YouTube over Zoom
How can I improve audio quality for videos/music over Zoom
Environment
Zoom
YouTube
Music
Video
Audio
Cause
Zoom by default is trying to make the audio consistent. That is not optimal during a video or with music. These setting should help.
Resolution
Use Zoom App on Desktop or Laptop
Connect using Ethernet cable and not WiFi
Use a good Microphone and Speakers (not webcam or laptop)
Close other programs that are not used during class/meeting
Open Zoom App
Click Home icon on top of window
Click near top right of Zoom App window
Click Audio (third from top along left side)
Make sure the speaker is set to your best option
Test speakers
Make sure the microphone is to your best option
Test Microphone
Under microphone Uncheck Automatically adjust microphone volume
Re-adjust levels manually on speaker and microphone above
Click Advanced at bottom of Audio
show in-meeting to enable Original Sound from microphone
Uncheck Disable echo cancellation
high fidelity music mode
use stereo audio
Click X in upper right of windows to close settings
Start Zoom meeting
Note: To Share the Audio that is coming from you computer you MUST share computer sound at bottom of share screen

How do I delete all of my Zoom Recordings
I have several Zoom Recordings that I would like to Delete
Environment
Zoom
Recordings
Cloud Recordings
Cause
My Recordings on Zoom need to be deleted
Resolution
Go to USD-Zoom web portal
Click Sign In
Under Profile along the left click Recordings
Deleting cloud recordings by meeting ID
Next to the search box, select Search by ID
Enter the meeting ID in the search box
Click Search
Click More then Delete in the last column
Click Yes to confirm and move recordings to the trash
Deleting all cloud recordings in a search results
Enter the desired date range and search criteria
Click Search
Click located in the header row of the table
Click Delete Selected
Click Yes to confirm and move recordings to the trash
Deleting all cloud recordings
Adjust the date range and status, then click Search
From: Leave blank
To: Select today's date
Status drop-down menu: Select All Status
Click Delete Selected
Click Yes to confirm and move recordings to the trash
To Delete or Recover files from the trash
Click the Trash
Select the files
Click Delete or Recover
Note: Files in the trash don't count towards your cloud-recording storage limit and will be permanently deleted after 30 days.

Copy the link address ending in reachcalendar.ics
Open Google Calendar
Under Other calendars, select Add by URL from the dropdown menu
Paste .ics link

environment:

Respondus Lockdown Browser
Chromebook (Chrome OS)
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
What are the known issues or limitations of using Respondus Lockdown Browser on a Chromebook?
Environment
Desire2Learn (D2L)
Respondus Lockdown Browser
Chromebook (Chrome OS)
Cause
This is a Beta release and does not have full functionality compared to Windows or Apple installations
Resolution
Limitations and/or known issues with LockDown Browser for Chromebook:
Quiz passwords (specified via the "optional password" field in the LockDown Browser Dashboard) aren’t currently supported
The Early Exit feature in LockDown Browser isn’t currently supported
LockDown Browser’s Calculator and Spreadsheet features aren’t currently supported
The extended keyboard function (for adding symbols and special characters) isn’t currently available
(Canvas) When using New Quizzes, students currently encounter a warning that the browser can’t open this page (this can be ignored)
LockDown Browser’s Help Center is currently unavailable
Allow access to specific external web domains option is currently not supported
(Brightspace) Pop-ups need to be enabled in Chrome for the server otherwise the student gets stuck on the Start Quiz page
Software is allowing students to take a quiz with Respondus Lockdown Monitor without recording the tester
Note: Linux and Chrome OS are not supported!
While core functions of our online courses will work on most mobile devices & smartphones, other functions will not. If using mobile devices—smartphones (e.g., an iPhone™), tablets (e.g., an iPad™), Chromebooks, You MUST have access to another computer. This is outlined in Technology Requirements section of the USD Online & Off-Campus Education Online student Handbook

In Titanium, under System Configuration, click Miscellaneous

Time Change 2025: 2 am Sunday, November 2
Time Change 2026: 2 am Sunday, November 1
Time Change 2027: 2 am Sunday, November 7

Time Change 2025: 2am Sunday, March 9

Time Change 2028: 2am Sunday, March 12
Click Save
This must be done for each instance/clinic

description: MAC Address Instructions for Smart Devices Network
fullText:
Question
How do I find my MAC Address to register my smart device?
Products or Services Involved
Smart Devices Network
Instructions
The list below contains the devices supported on the USD Network for the Smart Devices Network
First and foremost, you will need to find your MAC Address. Please refer to the following steps to find your MAC Address. Once finding your MAC Address, please register your device following Connecting a Smart Device to the Wireless
Note: The Mac Address should be 6 sets of 2 characters separated by colons (XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX). If any of the sets is only 1 character, put a zero before that character
Amazon Fire TV/Stick
New Setup
After you choose your language, you will end up at the Connect to your network page
Scroll all of the way to the right and click on MAC Address
Example: F8:54:B8:E1:D9:A5
Bringing to Campus from prior use
Go to Settings -> My Fire TV/Device -> About -> Network.
The MAC Address you will want is labeled MAC Address(Wi-Fi)
Roku Devices
New Setup
Select Language
Select Country
Select Set up for home use
Highlight Scan again to see all networks
The right side of the screen will show Your wireless MAC address: XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX
Bringing to Campus from prior use
Go to Settings -> Network -> About
The MAC Address you will want is labeled Wireless MAC Address
Amazon Echo
MAC address can be found on the bottom of the original box the device came in
if the box is not available, check if the device is already listed in the Alexa app on your smartphone
If it is, select the Device > About > Mac Address
Amazon Echo Show
MAC address can be found on the bottom of the original box the device came in
if the box is not available, check if the device is already listed in the Alexa app on your smartphone
If it is, select the Device > About > Mac Address
During initial setup, on the Connect to Network screen:
Scroll down to the bottom under Device Information and the MAC Address will be listed

description: How to connect a smart device to USD's wireless network
fullText:
Question
How do I connect my smart device to the wireless?
How do I connect my Smart TV to Wi-Fi?
Products or Services Involved
Smart Devices Wireless Network
Residence Halls
Instructions
Supported Devices
Roku
Smart TV (if a wired port is unavailable)
Roku TV
Android TV
FireTV
Echo Dot
Echo Show
Nintendo Switch - Version 1 HAC-001
Known Unsupported Devices
Some devices only work on 2.4GHZ networks. These devices will not work on smartdevices wireless SSID
We do not support the following devices on the wireless network: Xbox 360, Xbox One, Xbox Series S and X, Playstations 1-5. The supported method of connecting these devices is via ethernet cable. See article Registering Gaming Systems to connect these devices
Devices that require communication between your phone and the device
Google Home Hub
Google Home Mini
Google Nest
Google Chromecast
Apple Homepod
Friendship Lamps
Hatch Alarm
Roku Smart LED Light Strip
Any other device not listed on the Support Devices list has not been tested and is considered unsupported
Known Unsupported Uses
Any use that requires a direct connection through the local network from one device to another
Screen Mirroring
Roku App Remote Mode
Tips:
The Smart Devices wireless network is available in Residence Halls
If your device has a wired network port built-in or has the option to add one, you should connect your device using that method instead
You must be connected to eduroam or USD's wired network to perform the steps below
Register your Device
Go to smartdevices.usd.edu
Note: You must be connected to eduroam or USD's wired network
Log in using your USD credentials first.last
Note: Enter username and not full email address
Click Add
Enter your Device's Name
Note: DO NOT include an apostrophe in your device name. ie - Charlie's Device
In Device ID enter your device's MAC or Wi-Fi address. It consists of 6 alphanumeric number pairs separated by colons such as AA:BB:CC:11:22:33.
Note: Please refer to Finding MAC Address for Smart Devices Registration of commonly used devices
Click Submit
Get WiFi password
From the Smart Devices Registration page, Find Your WPA Wi-Fi key (PSK) to use on the "Smart Devices" SSID is {password}
Note: The PSK is case sensitive and includes the punctuation mark at the end
Connect your Device
Connect your device to Smart Devices wireless network name
Enter wireless password from step 2
Finishing setting up your device as instructed by manufacturer
If you are unable to connect View registered Devices

One possible cause for this is that the person who scheduled the report/job needs to renew their ADFS credentials in Cognos after they have changed their USD password
Note: As of April 2021, all schedules on INTERFACE/APPLICATION FEED reports/jobs are running under the USD Cognos Service ID, so this should only be an issue if THAT password is changed

Note: YOU MUST PERFORM A CREDENTIAL RENEWAL IN COGNOS EVERY TIME YOU CHANGE YOUR USD PASSWORD

description: Cognos scheduled reports/jobs depend on background credentials in Cognos Changing ADFS password requires you to MANUALLY renew your credentials in Cognos to run background tasks
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
Expected Cognos scheduled report did not show up as expected
Report output expected on RIS FTP server is not found or does not have the correct updated date
Report output expected in a local share is not there or has the wrong date
Environment
Cognos
ADFS
Cause
One possible cause for this is that the person who scheduled the report/job needs to renew their ADFS credentials in Cognos after they have changed their USD password
Note: As of April 2021, all schedules on INTERFACE/APPLICATION FEED reports/jobs are running under the USD Cognos Service ID, so this should only be an issue if THAT password is changed
(Credential renewal is a MANUAL process, no known automation possible, YET)
Note: YOU MUST PERFORM A CREDENTIAL RENEWAL IN COGNOS EVERY TIME YOU CHANGE YOUR USD PASSWORD
If the file on the local share has the wrong date, but the copy on the FTP directory is correct, it is possible that the scheduled job in Cognos fired after the Secure FTP process ran (scheduled incorrectly or was delayed for some reason)
If the files were not updated on the FTP server, it is possible that there was a problem with the Storage Area Network (SAN) - only RIS could tell if that were the case
Resolution
If issue is due to needing to renew ADFS credentials
Log in to Cognos as you normally do
In the upper right part of the window is a Person icon - click this
Click the My Preferences link
Click the Personal tab
Click the Advanced link
Click the Renew option to the right of the Credentials line
Enter your domain ID in the User ID: field -- usdlocal\yourdomainID
Enter your domain password in the Password field and again in the verify password field
Click OK
The scheduled job will not fail because of credentials the next time
If YOU did not schedule the report/job, contact Service Desk with the name of the report that was expected
If issue is because timing of report is off from when FTP process runs
Log in to Cognos as you normally do
Click the report entry context menu
Click Properties
Click the Schedule tab
Click Edit
Specify the schedule options
Under Period
Click Time field and change to what is needed
Click Save

Environment
USD-Key

issue: How do I restart Flex LM on USD-KEY for Topspin?

sections.heading: Issue/Question
sections.text: How do I restart Flex LM on USD-KEY for Topspin?

sections.heading: Environment
sections.text: USD-Key

sections.heading: Cause
sections.text: Topspin's FLEX LM service does not start as normal due to the lack of command line arguments in the service.

staffOnly.text:
Operations Team:
Connect to USD-KEY
Open a Command Prompt as Administrator
Navigate to C:\flexlm\Bruker
Look for processes listening on 0.0.0.0:1700 using netstat -aon. Note the PID.
Kill existing processes by typing taskkill /F /PID pid_value
Start lmgrd.exe using lmgrd.exe -z. This new window must remain open or the licensing will not work.
Navigate to C:\flexlm\Bruker in File Explorer
Open lmtools.exe
Select TOPSPIN_Flex_LM
Click Server Status
Click Perform Status Inquiry
The licenses in use and issued should now be present.

description: Using the Coyote Card Mobile app
fullText:
Question
How do I use the Coyote Card from my iPhone or Apple Watch?
Can I use Coyote Card Mobile if my phone's battery is dead?
Products or Services Involved
Coyote Card
iPhone SE, iPhone 6s or later with iOS 12 or later
Apple Watch Series 1 or later with Watch OS 5 or later
Apple ID signed into iCloud
Android Version 6.0 or later
eAccounts Mobile App
Samsung Galaxy phone
Galaxy S Series – S10 or later
Galaxy Note Series – Note10 or later
Galaxy Z Series – All Z Flip and Fold devices
Galaxy A Series – A53, A71 or later
Galaxy Xcover-Pro2
Samsung Galaxy 6 watch
Instructions
Tips:
To display your Coyote Card Mobile ID, open Apple Wallet and select your Coyote Card from your saved cards
Coyote Card Mobile does not replace your physical Coyote Card. A Coyote Card is still required, it must be carried at all times and upon request must be shown or surrendered to USD Officials. USD Testing Center requires your physical Coyote Card ID or other government issued ID.
See Installing Coyote Card Mobile to install mobile app
All Devices
When tapping your device
Door readers
Successful will flash green
Failed will flash red
No response, your device is not being recognized. Try tapping in a different location on the device
Note: Your device may require a pin or password after a certain amount of time for security purposes
Tapping for Coyote Cash or Flex payment
Successful will flash green
Failed will flash red
No response, your device is not being recognized. Try tapping in a different location on the device
Note: Your device may require a pin or password after a certain amount of time for security purposes
Phone cases with RFID Protection will block NFC Chip from being read, This includes MagSafe cases
If your Coyote Card is in an adhesive wallet or wallet attached to your phone, the card may be read instead of the phone
Note: Antenna location may vary by device but is most often found at the top of the phone by the camera. You may have to adjust the orientation of the phone to the reader for the mobile credential to be recognized
Apple Wallet
Turn on Apple device
Tap device against reader
Note: If you have an iPhone XS, XS Max, and XR models, Express Mode with power reserve is available for up to five hours after the device’s battery needs to be charged. iPhone 8 and earlier do not offer this feature
Google Wallet
Note: You do not need to unlock your phone, The screen must be awake to use Coyote Card
Tap power button to wake screen
Tap phone against reader
Note: You will not be able to use Coyote Card Mobile if your phone battery is dead
Samsung Wallet
Note: For eligible Samsung Galaxy phones, yes. Users can make up to 15 transactions within 24 hours after their phone powers off due to low battery
Tap your phone against the reader to use your Mobile ID, there is no need to turn on your screen or unlock your phone
To display your Mobile ID
Open the Quick Access tab in the Samsung Wallet app
Select your Mobile ID from your saved cards
Need More Help?
If you need further assistance, please contact Coyote Card office

description: How to make an event request in 25Live
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
Booking an event in 25Live
Making an event request on campus
Booking a room on campus
Environment
25Live
Resolution
Please:
Use Google Chrome or Firefox. Internet Explorer is NOT RECOMMENDED
Log in using USD credentials
25Live is going to be the point of truth for almost all spaces on campus, the group or person whose event is published on the 25Live Calendar has priority
If there is any conflict, please contact the person who confirmed your event
Log into 25Live using USD credentials
Click Create an Event
On any other page besides the home dashboard, click Event Form in the upper right hand side of the screen
Enter Event Name
Enter Calendar Title (published to USD calendar)
Enter Event Type
Enter Requesting Department or Organization
Enter Expected Attendance
Enter Event Description
If wanting event published on Public Calendar, event must include description of what event is, and who is invited
Add Date
Add Start Time and End Time
Add a Location to your event request, in the Locations section
Note: Confirm Hide Conflicts and Enforce Headcount are not checked
In the Search Locations box, enter in search criteria either building name, room number, building initials, or virtual
or
Click next to Saved Searches
Select USD-All Locations or USD Meeting Rooms or USD Classrooms depending on the type of room you are looking for
Review list of available locations
If event is virtual, please select U*VIRTE as your location
If event is off campus, please select U*Off*Campus as your location
Click Request next to desired location
Request Resources needed for event
If adding event to Public Calendar
Provide Event URL if available
Click Yes to Add Event to Public Calendar
Will be required to provide Event Contact Phone, Contact Email, Name of Event Contactand Event URL
can put “N/A” of no event URL is available
Add additional information in Comments
Check I Agree
Click Submit
Note: After your event request has been submitted, the room scheduler will be in contact with additional information or questions

description: Enabling Live Automatic Transcriptions in Zoom
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
How do I enable Live Automatic Transcriptions in Zoom?
Environment
Zoom
Cause
User must enable Live Transcriptions for their account and start for meetings they wish to use it in
Resolution
These are the steps to enable Live Automatic Transcriptions for your account
Log into Zoom at usd.zoom.us
Click Sign-In
Once in Zoom click on Settings (Under Profile along the left side)
Scroll down to the In Meeting (Advanced) section
Click Closed Captioning which is the 4th item under above section
Click on the slider to turn on Live Captioning for your account
A window will pop open that says Enable "Closed captioning"
Click "Enable" to close that window
Click Enable live transcription service to shows transcript on the side-panel in-meeting
After enabled: These are the steps the host does to start Live Automatic Transcriptions for any meeting
Start your Zoom meeting
In the Zoom in meeting controls you should see a CC button now that says Live Transcript
Click that CC Button and select the bottom choice - Enable Auto-Transcript

Environment
Outlook
Resolution
Outlook for Windows
Click New Email
Click Options
Click Encrypt
Choose Encrypt-Only or Do Not Forward
Note: Do Not Forward prevents forwarding messages and attachments as well as encrypting the contents
Outlook for MacOS
Click New Message
Click Draft menu
Click Encrypt

Note: Do Not Forward prevents forwarding messages and attachments as well as encrypting the contents
Encrypting Email Attachments
Follow the process above to encrypt an email message
Word, Excel, PowerPoint, or PDF attachments to the message will also be encrypted
Other file types, such as TXT or CSV, are not encrypted
Reading Encrypted Messages
USD recipients and can read encrypted emails using Outlook Web, Outlook Mobile, or the Outlook App
Note: Encrypted messages are denoted by and one of the following messages
Encrypt - This message is encrypted. Recipients can't remove encryption
Do Not Forward - Recipients can't forward, print, or copy content
External users
Note: Instructions are included as part of the message they receive
Recipients at Outlook.com, Yahoo! Mail, and Gmail can read the message using their credentials
Other types of recipients can authenticate using a one-time passcode
SECUREMAIL Email Subject (Alternate Method)
Email messages can be encrypted by adding the keyword SECUREMAIL to the subject line of the email you would like to protect (encrypt)
This method is still supported for backward compatibility
Receiving and reading encrypted email
USD users will not need to do anything and can read encrypted emails by default using Outlook Web, Outlook Mobile, or the Outlook App
External users:
Can read an encrypted email by authenticating with Outlook.com, Yahoo! Mail, and Gmail accounts
If they do not have an above account they can authenticate using a PIN number
Note: instructions for end users reading encrypted messages is provided in the email when received

Environment
Cisco 8851 VOIP phone
Cisco 730 Headset
Windows
Cause
Resolution
Turn headset on Note: The power button is on the L(eft) speaker
Wear the headset on to listen to commands
Hold the Power button up for ~2 seconds Note: This will put the headset into Bluetooth pairing mode, if you hold it too long it will reset bluetooth connections
To connect to a PC that does not have Bluetooth, plug the included Bluetooth USB reciever into your machine Note: Advised to turn Bluetooth off of devices that the headset may also be connected to
A Connected message will sound when connected
If the receiver won't connect follow the I Can't Get the USB Adapter to Pair to My Cisco Headset 730 section of the Cisco Headset 730 User Guide
To Connect to a Cisco 8851, follow the Pairing a Bluetooth Device with a Cisco 8851 Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) Phone

description: Automatically record in Zoom and copy to course for Panopto Video library in D2L and delete Zoom recording.
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
How can I setup Zoom recordings to automatically move to a specific class in the D2L Panopto video library?
How can I setup Zoom so that everything will copy automatically to Panopto in D2L class and enable tech fellows to edit captions.
How to automate Zoom video recordings to transfer to Panopto archiving so that I do not have to manually?
Environment
Zoom
Panopto
D2L
Recording
Library
Resolution
You need to have Opted-In to have your Zoom Recordings automatically move to Panopto
Each D2L course needs to have Panopto External Learning Tool added/enabled. See Adding Panopto to D2L.
Schedule the Zoom meetings for the course in D2L. Copy the meeting ID for the scheduled Zoom meetings.
Note: Each course that you would like to record in D2L should have a unique Zoom meeting ID
Example:
Set ECON 201 class to a Zoom meeting id # (11111111 for ECON 201)
Set BADM 450 class to a Zoom meeting id # (2222222 for BADM 450)
Sign in to Panopto
Click the circle with your initials at the top right
Select User Settings
Click Add New under Meeting Import Settings - Automatic Import to add your classes and/or meetings
Enter the Meeting ID for the course, select the course folder in the drop down menu, and click Save
Example: Meeting ID Folder Name
1111111 2021 Fall - ECON 201
2222222 2021 Fall - BADM 450
Only students in ECON 201 can see the ECON 201 recordings and only students in BADM 450 can see the BADM 450 recordings, based on D2L class permissions.
You can elevate access by granting creator or publisher role in the class in Panopto
Note: Elevated users can edit captions
Note: Once this is set up, Zoom recordings will automatically copy to Panopto within the D2L class folder. Tech fellows could potentially edit captions, and teachers would just do initial setup.

Verify if there is a camera hanging from the ceiling or mounted to the wall
If there is a camera in the room, verify Zoom video settings
If there is no camera in the room, see step 11
In the Zoom meeting window, go to the bottom menu bar
If you don't see the bar, hover the mouse over the bottom of the window

No video, click the little up arrow beside the camera button
Verify that the camera is selected
Note: Depending on the room, the room camera name should have the name of the building and room number in the name
If there is no camera listed, see step 11

Building name
Room number

description: Editing pages using Evoq
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
How do I edit a page using Evoq?
Environment
Evoq
Resolution
Open a web browser window
Go to the website you want to edit, adding /login to the end of the URL
Log in using your credentials
Navigate to the page that needs editing
In the lower left hand corner of the page, click on the Edit button - it looks like a pencil in a circle
Click on the section that needs to be edited
For simple updates, such as text changes, make changes in the simple editing tool.
For more extensive updates, click on the Advanced Editor tool - the last button on the right in the navigation menu
When done making extensive updates in the Advanced Editor tool, click on the Close button
When all changes have been made, click on the Publish button in the lower right hand side of the screen

description: Adding an image to a webpage using the Evoq CMS
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
How to add a image to a webpage using the Evoq CMS
Environment
Evoq
Resolution
Log into Evoq by going to the webpage adding /login to the end of the URL
Navigate to the page that need to be updated
Turn on the edit mode for the page
Click on the area that needs to be edited and then click on the Advanced Editor button (last button in the navigation menu)
Navigate to the area to add the image, click on the Image button (in the navigation menu, middle row, first button in the last section of buttons)
In the Image Properties pop up window, click on the Browse Server
Use the navigation tools to find the image to be added, when image has been found, click on the image to select it
Under Choose your URL type: leave the selection as Relative URL
In the Image Properties update these fields
On the Image Info tab, complete the Alternative Text field
On the Advanced tab, complete the Advisory Title field
Click Okay
Edit location of image on the editor
After all changes have been made on the page, click the Close button
After all changes are made on the page, click on the Publish button

fullText:
Issue/Question
I’m trying to run a course report for Fall 2021, and it’s only showing up through Summer 2019 as an option. Cognos folder missing.
When trying to run Banner Security Name Search Report_v2 or any of the other reports in Public Folders ‎> Banner ‎> USD ‎> Admin & IT ‎> USD ITS ‎> Banner Security Reports, I receive the following error.
QE-DEF-0285 The logon failed. CAF-WRN-2082 An error has occurred. Please contact your administrator.
Environment
Cognos
Cause
User has never logged on to Cognos and selected ADFS which would have transferred security over
Once sdbor.edu option went away, their security reverted back to what it was when ADFS was first setup
User was using Cognos 10 link instead of 11

Confirm you are using Cognos 11
Note: https://cognos11.sdbor.edu
Have you ever logged on to Cognos and selected ADFS before the Banner Migration?
If not click the in upper right corner
Click My preferences
Click Personal tab
Click Advanced
Click Renew next to Credentials
If the problem persists, please contact the Service Desk with the information above:

cause: I just ran a process, or a process ran on a schedule, and now I want to see the output of the process
description: How to access the output of processes you have run in Banner Admin using GJIREVO
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
How do I view the output of a process I ran in Banner?
Environment
Banner Admin
Cause
I just ran a process, or a process ran on a schedule, and now I want to see the output of the process
Resolution
Note: You can only display output from processes YOU have run
Log in to Banner Admin, if you are not already in Banner
In the main Banner window, type GJIREVO in the search box
The result Saved Output Review (GJIREVO) will be shown
Either click on the GJIREVO result, or press Enter to proceed to the next screen
The Saved Output Review GJIREVO screen will be displayed
In the Process field, type the name of the process you wish to display the output for
Click the ellipses ... on the Number: field
Select which output you want to display (.LIS files are the report output, .LOG files show messages about the job run, and errors encountered)
The output will be displayed on the screen
To save the output to a file you can work with
Click the Tools button in the upper right of the screen
Click the Show Document (Save and Print File) option
Click the Yes button on the message box in the upper right [You have selected to Show file xxx in a browser. Do you wish to continue?]
The results will be displayed in a browser window
Right-click in this window
Click the Save As option
Choose a location for the file by navigating to the desired folder, then click on it
Type a name to save the file as in the File name: prompt, if desired, or leave the default name
Click the Text Document (*.txt) option
Click the Save button
The file you named is now saved as a .txt document in the location you chose and is available to use

cause: I want to review/delete the output of a previously run report in Banner
description: How to delete report output using the GJIREVO screen for processes you have run
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
I have reviewed output from a Banner report and now I want to delete that output
Environment
Banner Admin
Cause
I want to review/delete the output of a previously run report in Banner
Resolution
Follow the article Using GJIREVO to View Banner Report Output to the point where you've displayed the output (step 9)
Press Shift-F6 (Delete Output)
Click Yes in the message box in the upper right [Are you sure you want to delete xxxxx from the database?]
The output file you selected will be deleted
If more files to be deleted, simply press the F9 key to show the Processes You Have Saved dialog box
Select the next file to review then repeat step 2, as appropriate
Repeat for each file you wish to delete
Close out the GJIREVO screen when you have completed your review/deletions

description: Ordering student ID, faculty staff ID or coyote ID.
fullText:
Question
How do I get my Coyote Card?
How do I submit my photo for my Coyote Card?
How do I submit my photo for my student ID?
How do I submit my photo for my faculty or staff ID?
Products or Services Involved
Coyote Card
Coyote Card Mobile
Instructions
Notes:
Coyote Card and Coyote Card Mobile require the use of a photo as part of identification
Only JPEG, JPG and PNG image type
IDs are free when:
it is the first ID ever for students
change from undergraduate to graduate student
legal name changes
Photos must meet the following requirements to be used:
A colored photo that has been taken within the last 30 days
White background
Taken in full-face view directly facing the camera
Include your shoulders and head
No hats
Neutral or happy facial expression with both eyes open
Government ID and Photo (ID card) images are required
Only JPG and PNG image types are allowed
Note: You can also install Coyote Card Mobile, You will need to have an image on file to use Coyote Card Mobile
On Campus: Go to Coyote Card Office
USD Vermillion Campus: I D Weeks Library Room 104
USD Sioux Falls Campus: FADM Room 133, (if closed ask Help Desk Room 135)
Online: Click the ID Request button on this page to request an ID
Note: This button will only be visible if you are signed in
Replacement: Follow Requesting Replacement Card
Note: Replacement IDs are $20, even if the card stopped tapping, the card is worn or broken
Note: When moving from undergrad to graduate you need to update your picture and get a new coyote card free of charge
Need More Help?
If you need further assistance, please Coyote Card Office

Zoom
Panopto
Sudo-webinar
Webcast
Resolution
Note: Viewers are watching a live stream, Registration must be done outside of Zoom and a link must be sent to the viewers
Panopto - this can be done any time prior to meeting
Open Panopto at http://usd.hosted.panopto.com
If you are not setup as a Creator in Panopto
Email ceddn@usd.edu
Ask for a department folder for this event
Identify the host for the meeting

Enter Webcast information
Name
Folder
Description

Start Zoom meeting

description: Steps for enabling Duo Mobile Restore Feature allowing you to recover your account if your mobile device is replaced
fullText:
Question
How do I enable Duo Restore on my Mobile Device?
Instructions
Android Device
Open Duo Mobile App
Tap overflow menu (three vertical dots) in the top right corner of the main accounts list
Tap Settings
Tap Duo Restore
Turn on Duo Restore by tapping Backup accounts with Google Drive
Select a Google account to store your backup
Optionally enable third-party account restore by tapping Automatically reconnect third-party accounts
Enter and confirm a recovery password that has 10-128 characters
iOS Device
Back up your device to iCloud
Note: iCloud Keychain must be enabled. Nightly iCloud backups will include Duo Restore information. Encrypted iTunes backups will also work
Need More Help?
If you need further assistance, please contact the Service Desk

description: This article discusses what to do if the technology in the Law School courtroom is not working.
environment:
Law School courtroom
Law School
Classroom
fullText:
Issue/Question
The technology in the Law School courtroom is not working
Environment
Law School courtroom
Law School
Classroom
Cause
The technology in the courtroom is not working
Resolution
Verify that the power strip at the podium has not come unplugged or turned off
Verify that the power cable for the QSC NV-32-H that is on the shelf of the podium is not unplugged from the power strip or the power brick
Try plugging in a different HDMI device into the HDMI cable that is plugged into the laptop
If the touch panel is not powered on, verify that the network cable has not come unplugged under the judge's bench
If possible, try the laptop in the AV control room
Turn on the laptop if not already on
Log in to the laptop
Select Control Room Laptop on the touch panel
Verify if the laptop is displaying on the projector screen
Still need assistance, please contact the Service Desk with the following information:
Building name
Room number
A detailed description of the issue
Provide any error messages if applicable

fullText:

How can someone else schedule or update Zoom meetings for me?

Zoom
Outlook Calendar
Cause
Assign or delegate a user or multiple users in your account to schedule meetings on your behalf.

Open Zoom app
Sign on with single sign-on
Click gear icon in the upper right hand corner to access settings
Click Profile Icon
Click Edit My Profile
Click Settings
Click Other

Click Assign

cause: The table was previously owned by the ODSMGR schema; with the migration to Exadata storage, a new schema was created ZZ_SDGRP
description: The ODSMGR schema has been replaced by ZZ_SDGRP
environment:
Banner ODS
Query tool or Cognos SQL query
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
I am attempting to run a query against Banner ODS and it returns with an error
Error: ORA-00942: table or view does not exist
Environment
Banner ODS
Query tool or Cognos SQL query
Cause
The table was previously owned by the ODSMGR schema; with the migration to Exadata storage, a new schema was created ZZ_SDGRP
Resolution
Qualify the table with the new schema name
Use ZZ_SDGRP.ZZ_PAYROLL_DISTRIB_NOPREDICATE instead of the Old schema-table name (ODSMGR.ZZ_PAYROLL_DISTRIB_NOPREDICATE)

Minimum Hardware and Software requirements
All computers must meet the minimum requirements to receive ITS assistance connecting to the USD network. If purchasing a new computer, ITS recommends exceeding those minimum requirements for optimum performance. We recommend systems that meet or exceed the following specifications.
Some academic programs will require a laptop or tablet computer. To ensure you have a computer that will meet your academic needs, please review
Medical School Computer Requirements
Nursing Computer Requirements
Note: Requirements may change at any time. Please refer to this page before making any computer purchases.

Recommended
Windows 11
macOS 26 (Tahoe)
Minimum
Windows 11
macOS 15 (Sequoia
Current version of Chrome OS can be used with limited support.
Linux is Not Supported
Windows 11 in S Mode is not supported
CPU
Intel Core i-Series
AMD Ryzen series
Apple M series
Memory
8+ GB
Wireless
802.11 ac 2.4/5Ghz or higher
Must support WPA2‑Enterprise or WPA3‑Enterprise
Ethernet Adapter
100/1000 Base-T
WebCam
1080p or higher
MacBook Neo
MacBook devices using Apple Silicon are supported and will work on campus, including access to the eduroam wireless network
Chromebooks
There are some limitations when doing distance learning especially when presenting and sharing your screen. They also do not multitask as effectively as Windows and Mac PC's. Chromebooks do not support some of the testing applications and may not meet the requirements for proctored exams and are therefore not recommended at this time. See Questions Regarding Chromebooks

I am an incoming student and have some questions regarding the computer requirements.
What are the system requirements I should have when purchasing a laptop for school?
What are the requirements for bringing my own computer to USD?
What does USD recommend?
What is minimum recommended computer

sections.heading: Answer
sections.text:
Interested in a computer supported by USD?
Purchase a new laptop at a discounted price, See Specification and price at USD Laptop Purchase
Add to Student Bill payment option available
Support offered by USD Certified technicians
If your computer is in for repair a loaner computer will be provided
Interested in purcahsing? Click the Purchase from USD button on this page
Minimum Hardware and Software requirements
All computers must meet the minimum requirements to receive ITS assistance connecting to the USD network. If purchasing a new computer, ITS recommends exceeding those minimum requirements for optimum performance. We recommend systems that meet or exceed the following specifications.
Some academic programs will require a laptop or tablet computer. To ensure you have a computer that will meet your academic needs, please review
Medical School Computer Requirements
Nursing Computer Requirements
Note: Requirements may change at any time. Please refer to this page before making any computer purchases.
Operating System
Recommended
Windows 11
macOS 26 (Tahoe)
Minimum
Windows 11
macOS 15 (Sequoia
Current version of Chrome OS can be used with limited support.
Linux is Not Supported
Windows 11 in S Mode is not supported
CPU
Intel Core i-Series
AMD Ryzen series
Apple M series
Memory
8+ GB
Wireless
802.11 ac 2.4/5Ghz or higher
Must support WPA2‑Enterprise or WPA3‑Enterprise
Ethernet Adapter
100/1000 Base-T
WebCam
1080p or higher
MacBook Neo
MacBook devices using Apple Silicon are supported and will work on campus, including access to the eduroam wireless network
Chromebooks
There are some limitations when doing distance learning especially when presenting and sharing your screen. They also do not multitask as effectively as Windows and Mac PC's. Chromebooks do not support some of the testing applications and may not meet the requirements for proctored exams and are therefore not recommended at this time. See Questions Regarding Chromebooks

footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
Duo is displaying a gray box instead of a prompt
The Duo prompt does not load in iOS or macOS
Environment
Duo Mobile
iOS
macOS
Cause
Multiple causes
Content restrictions are enabled on the device
JavaScript not enabled in Safari
Resolution
Resolving Duo display issues in iOS or macOS
iOS 12 or newer:
Navigate to Settings
Click Screen Time
Click Content & Privacy Restrictions
Click Content Restrictions
Click Web Content
Uncheck Limit Adult Websites to completely disable content restrictions
Note: If you do not want to fully disable content restrictions, you can allow duosecurity.com within the Content Restrictions page
Restart your device
Resolving Duo prompt issues in Outlook for iOS
To resolve, enable JavaScript for Safari:
Navigate to Settings > Safari > Advanced
Toggle the JavaScript option on.

footer: Please contact Center for Teaching and Learning if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
How do I make an accessible PDF from Microsoft Word
Environment
Word
Adobe PDG
Accessibility
Cause
If you distribute PDF documents to students or post PDFs online, they must be made accessible before being posted so they work effectively with screen readers such as VoiceOver or Windows Narrator.
Resolution
Open word document
Click Review
Click Check Accessibility from the top ribbon
The Accessibility Assistant will open in the right column
View errors and warnings
Follow the steps to fix each error and warning displayed
Set Title in Document Properties
Click File>Document Properties
For Windows, type title in the text box under Info
For MAC, click on summary and add title in text box.
Save File as PDF
Click File>Save As
Click below title and select PDF
Do not save as Adobe PDF or Foxit PDF
Do not Print to PDF
Browse to where you would like the file saved
Click Save
How to Make an Accessible PDF from MS Word (3min video)

description: How to I return equipment I checked out
fullText:
Issue/Question
I wanted to reach out and ask where I should drop it off to return it.
Environment
Cheqroom
Equipment Checkout
Resolution
Return all checked out equipment to the USD Service Desk located in the I.D. Weeks Library room 104
Service Hours
Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM – 10:00 PM (Central Standard Time)
Saturday and Sunday: 10:00 AM – 10:00 PM (Central Standard Time)
You are responsible for the equipment while in your possession and may be charged the amount it will cost to replace the equipment if damaged or not returned
Equipment is to be returned at the scheduled return time
If it is 24 hours late Cheqroom privileges will be revoked for 30 days
The second late return results in a 60 day ban from Cheqroom
The third late return results in a 90 day ban from Cheqroom
If equipment is 5 business days late, it will be considered stolen property. Cheqroom privileges will be permanently revoked and UPD will be contacted to retrieve the items
Checking out equipment for friends or checking out the same items consecutively will result in Cheqroom privileges will be revoked for 30 days
Note: The full policy can be read at: 5.014 Equipment Checkout
Please contact the Service Desk if you have any questions

cause: No known cause, items in My Contents in Cognos are solely created, maintained, backed up by the user who owns them
description: Items missing from My Content in Cognos may not be recovered, but there are ways to avoid the loss
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
Logged onto Cognos and had no reports that I built in My Content
Environment
Cognos 11
Cause
No known cause, items in My Contents in Cognos are solely created, maintained, backed up by the user who owns them
Resolution
There is no resolution to items missing from My Content, even by system administrators
To avoid accidental loss of items, the report specification can be saved to an XML file and saved outside Cognos
Log in to Cognos
Navigate to the report speciification you'd like to save
Click on the three dots ... to the right of the item
Select the Edit report option
Select the Report option under the Report item in the Navigation menu at the top of the page
Click the Copy icon to copy the report specification to the clipboard
Open a text editor, such as Notepad
Paste the XML into the open file
Save the file to a location of your choice to keep it safe
An alternative, or additional measure that can be taken is to create a folder in Public Folders and copy the report to that folder
