issue: What is the difference between Mogli Intelligent Routing and Mogli Personal Gateway

sections.heading: Issue/Question
sections.text: What is the difference between Mogli Intelligent Routing and Mogli Personal Gateway

sections.heading: Environment
sections.text:
Mogli
Salesforce

sections.heading: Cause
sections.text: Confusion because of too many applications.

staffOnly.text:
Personal Gateway
Used to conduct 1 to 1 conversations with a recipient associated with the record.
End users know who to respond to.
Gateway messages are personalized conversations.
Gateway users can manage their own notifications from their own gateway.
Intelligent Routing (IR)
Intelligent routing disperses bulk text traffic across several phone numbers, for significantly faster and more reliable delivery. Mogli does the work for you and chooses the best phone number from the pool within the route to send the message, and remembers the number used for each recipient for future use. The phone numbers within the Intelligent Route are separate from the users' gateway phone numbers. The USD intelligent routes are made up of other 605 phone numbers.
Good for reminders and updates to a larger selection of users.
Can send messages to more than 100 recipients at a time.
Messaging is not as personalized.
Users are usually sharing the IR gateway for bulk sends, so a process to manage incoming notifications internally is necessary
Notification management can be handled in 1 of 3 ways:
One person is appointed as the receiver and is responsible for monitoring incoming messages over this gateway and responding to them.
The sender of the bulk message monitors for any immediate responses after their send and is responsible for responding.
A team of users share the responsibility through a report or list view (this is not as clean or efficient as the other 2 options but do-able).
If you don't want anyone monitoring incoming messages from Intelligent Routing at all, another option would be to put a sentence at the end of each bulk message letting the student know i.e. "This line is currently not monitored. For assistance, please email XXXX@usd.edu".

description: New leads in Salesforce can be created by a prospect texting the word 'COYOTE' to a gateway number.
fullText:
Issue/Question
Does Mogli create lead records?
Environment
Mogli
Salesforce
Cause
Collect new leads through phone number on email signatures, college applications, in-person/webinar recruitment events.
Resolution
Advertise the Mogli gateway on recruitment materials
Student texts the word COYOTE to any of the Mogli gateway numbers
Mogli form displays with the following questions
First Name
Last Name
Email
Opt-In preferences
A new lead is created in Salesforce from the completed form if they did not already exist.
Note: If the student does not text COYOTE, a text will appear but there will be no lead created. In that case, create a lead in Salesforce, attach the phone number to the lead and text the applicant to get name, email information.
Please contact the Service Desk if additional assistance is needed.

AMP parking

Download the app
Google Play Store
Apple App Store

Download the free AMP Park app on your smartphone
Select the area where you are parking on the map
Select the amount of time you would like to purchase
Add your license plate number, state it was issued and vehicle make
Add your payment information (credit or debit card)
Start your parking time
Save your information
If you will use AMP Park regularly on campus, save your account information. You can add multiple license plates if you drive different vehicles.
One-time use
You can enter information for a single parking session without creating an account.

description: Schedulers in 25Live will need to confirm events and locations. The article reviews the steps to do this.
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
Confirming events in 25Live by Schedulers
Environment
25Live
Resolution
Note: When confirming event requests in 25Live there are 2 things that are most important:
A location has been confirmed
The event itself is confirmed
The most common mistake is that an event is confirmed but the location hasn’t been also confirmed.
Log into 25Live Pro
Open event that is going to be confirmed
Note: there are more than one way to confirm a request – this article will only go over one
Review the Details screen – any changes that are needed can be made here (make sure the Edit Mode is On)
Click on the Occurrences tab – this will show all the event dates and which rooms are being requested
Go back to the Details tab
Click on Edit Event
The goal here is to confirm the location for this event
To get to the locations section, you can
Click on Locations in the left hand navigation bar
OR
Scroll through the event – if you do this option, you can update the event as you go
To add the location in the Locations area
The first time you go to the form confirm that Hide Conflicts and Enforce Headcount ARE NOT CHECKED
If they are, uncheck them and then click on the Search button. This will show you the requested location
When you see the location requested, click the green Reserve button
Continue scrolling to the bottom reviewing content
Change the Event State to Confirmed
Click Save

description: Marketing Schedulers confirming events requested to be added to the USD Calendar.
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
Confirming 25Live Event requested to be added to the USD Calendar
Environment
25Live
Resolution
These directions are only for the marketing security group schedulers.
First, create a search that will allow show any events that are asking to be promoted.
Log into 25Live Pro
Click Go to Search button
In the Select Object drop down, select Events
Click the toggle over to Advanced
Click Add Criteria button
Choose Custom Attribute
In drop down select Promote Event to Public Calendar – make sure the drop down indicates is True
Click Add Criteria button
Choose Custom Attribute
In drop down select Confirm Public Calendar Request – make sure the dropdown indicates does not exist
Note: Also make sure the drop down between these two criteria is “and”
Click on the Search button
Click on the Save As button – save it with a name that makes sense and also make sure Add to starred searches: is yes
Confirm promotion to USD Calendar
Click the event name
Review event information
Click the Add a Custom Attribute button
Select Confirm Public Calendar Request toggle to either yes or no
This is a Silent Save option, the event is now promoted to the USD Calendar

cause: Want to securely connect to HPC resources
description: The steps for users to generate SSH Keys and set up their use on the Lawrence HPC system
fullText:
Issue/Question
How do I make and setup SSH Keys for Lawrence?
Environment
MobaXTerm
Shell
Bash
Zsh
Cause
Want to securely connect to HPC resources
Resolution
Open a terminal on your local machine
Note: This can be MobaXTerm (Windows), or Bash/Zsh (Linux or Mac)
Type ssh-keygen and press enter
Note: This generates a keypair on your local machine
Press enter to accept the default path
Press enter to skip the passphrase
Press enter again to confirm
Type ssh-copy-id first.last@lawrence.usd.edu and press enter
Note: Use your own name instead of first.last
Note: This sets up the newly generated key for use on lawrence
Type your password and press enter
Complete the Duo second factor authentication
Type ssh first.last@lawrence.usd.edu to test your SSH Key

footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
How do I export a file from ImageNow
Environment
ImageNow
Webnow
Perceptive Content
Cause
User wants to export / save a file from ImageNow to upload to a different location
Resolution
Note: The goal of a digital document repository system like ImageNow/Perceptive Content is to create an electronic form and not print or email it out again but instead to provide access for those that need access to view the document electronically.
Select the file and click Open, or double click the file
Click Export
Click the Format drop down and choose either .tiff or .pdf format
Click Browse and choose where to save the file
Select which pages to export as some may be blank
Click Okay to finalize
Check file destination when done

Click Policies & rules
Click Threat policies

Email notice is sent to All Students Regarding Internet Copyright Infringement and Digital Millennium Copyright Infringement Notices. Please visit the University's Consumer Information web site for details.
As part of the Higher Education Opportunity Act (HEOA), the University of South Dakota is required to provide annual information regarding copyright infringement, the Digital Millennium Copyright Act (DMCA), and responsible use of university technology resources.
Copyright Infringement and File Sharing
Uploading, downloading, streaming, or sharing copyrighted content without permission from the copyright owner is illegal. This includes movies, television shows, music, games, software, ebooks, and other copyrighted materials.
Unauthorized distribution of copyrighted content can result in civil penalties, criminal prosecution, and financial liability. Organizations representing copyright owners regularly monitor internet activity and submit infringement notices to internet service providers and universities when unauthorized sharing is detected.
USD receives copyright infringement notices from time to time. When the university receives a notice associated with a student device or account, the university investigates and responds in accordance with university policy. First-time incidents may result in an educational notice, while repeated alleged violations may be referred to the Office of Student Rights and Responsibilities.
Please remember that you are responsible for activity originating from your devices while connected to the USD network, even if another person is using the device.
Prohibited Devices and Services: "Super Boxes," Residential Proxies, and Similar Services
The University of South Dakota prohibits the use of "super boxes," unauthorized IPTV streaming devices, residential proxy services, and similar technologies on the USD network.
Many so-called "super boxes" advertise free access to premium television channels, movies, sporting events, and subscription streaming services. These devices frequently provide access to copyrighted content without authorization and are commonly associated with copyright infringement. Connecting or using these devices on the USD network is not permitted.
Examples include:
"Super boxes" or IPTV streaming devices that provide unauthorized access to premium television, movies, sports, or subscription services.
Applications, websites, or services that distribute copyrighted content without authorization.
Residential proxy networks that pay users to share their internet connection with third parties.
Services that route internet traffic through personal devices for the benefit of unknown users.
Residential proxy services present additional security and privacy concerns. These services route internet traffic from other individuals through your device and network connection. Activity performed by others may appear to originate from your account or device, creating potential security, compliance, and legal risks.
Students are responsible for all activity originating from their devices while connected to the USD network. Use of prohibited devices or services may result in:
Copyright infringement notices being sent to the university.
Investigation by Information Technology Services.
Loss of network access privileges.
Referral to the Office of Student Rights and Responsibilities.
Additional disciplinary action as permitted by university policy.
If you are unsure whether a device, application, or service is permitted, do not connect it to the USD network until you have consulted Information Technology Services.
Legal Alternatives
Many legal options are available for obtaining digital content, including licensed streaming services, online music platforms, game stores, software publishers, and educational discounts.
Educause maintains a list of legal sources of online content: Legal Sources of Online Content | EDUCAUSE
Additional information about copyright law is available from:
USD Consumer Information
U.S. Copyright Office
U.S. Copyright Office FAQ
Thank you for helping maintain a secure, responsible, and legally compliant computing environment at the University of South Dakota.

description: Many P2P file sharing software applications are set to share files without your knowledge. This can lead to slowness issues, as well as put you at risk for Copyright Infringements.
fullText:
Issue/Question
What should I know about Peer-to-Peer (P2P) File-sharing Software?
How can I remove P2P File-sharing Software?
Environment
Peer-to-Peer (P2P) File-sharing Software
Cause
Many P2P file sharing software applications are set to share files without your knowledge. This can lead to slowness issues, as well as put you at risk for Copyright Infringements
Resolution
Note: Ultimate responsibility for your network usage falls on you
P2P file sharing software applications often install Spyware and/or viruses onto your PC when you sign up for their service
Another reason to be cautious of P2P is that the files you may be swapping and sharing (photos, music, videos or games) often contain Spyware and/or viruses
Whether or not you have legally downloaded data, you are still responsible for activities of your computer on the USD network
Educause provides a list of Legal Sources of Online Content as an alternative to unauthorized downloading
You can either remove the software or disable the file sharing portion of the software.
Note: Many P2P programs can NOT be disabled and must be removed.
Examples of P2P software
uTorrent
BitTorrent
BearShar
Limeware
Note: To disable P2P file sharing software applications please check the vendors website
Windows computers
Use the Programs window in the Control Panel to remove or uninstall these programs
Some peer-to-peer file-sharing programs have companion programs that are not automatically removed
If you have more than one program to remove, click No if prompted to reboot your computer.
Repeat these steps until you have removed all file sharing programs
Make sure you reboot the system when you are finished
Mac iOS
Double-click on the hard drive
Click Applications
Click the name of the software
Drag to the trash can
For more information, please see the Web site of the U.S. Copyright Office, especially their FAQ's

Microsoft Clipchamp

Microsoft Clipchamp is the recommended video editing application for Windows 11. Use Photos for simple trimming and Clipchamp for combining videos, adding captions, creating training videos, and other editing tasks.

Locate the MP4 file for the recording you would like to trim
Right click on the file
Click Open with >
Click Photos
Click Trim
Drag the left and right circles to where you would like to start and end the recording
Click Save as copy
Enter a name for the trimmed file
Additional Editing or Merging Recordings
Microsoft Clipchamp has replaced the video editing capability of Windows Photos App
Clipchamp may be installed through the Microsoft Store
See Microsoft instructions on using Clipchamp

description: Setting up scanned in Banner Xtender
environment:

Chrome
Microsoft Edge
Banner
fullText:
Issue/Question
How do I configure the scanner in the new Xtender
Environment
OpenText Xtender
Captiva Cloud Runtime
Chrome
Microsoft Edge
Banner
Cause
Xtender upgrade on 10/2/2021
Xtender now requires Captiva Cloud Runtime to be installed on your computer for scanning.
Your scanner needs to be selected again to scan directly to Xtender
Resolution
Install Captiva Cloud Runtime before configuring your scanner
Company Portal by Intune is the replacement for Software Center
Open Software Center
Click
Type Software Center
Click Software Center
Click Captiva Cloud Runtime 3.0
Click Install
Wait for install to complete
To verify the installation is successful, open https://127.0.0.1:49735/scanservice/v2/getstatus in Chrome or Edge
Successful installation will show StatusMessage: Success as shown here: {"SessionID":null,"Status":0,"StatusMessage":"Success","Version":"3.0.0.1320","StatusCode":3,"TokenID":null}
Restart your computer
IF this is a multiuser computer, you will need to add the user(s) that need to scan to the Local Computer group "Captiva Cloud Toolkit Users" in Computer Management - the Group should have been created by the plugin install - if not, it must be manually created
Configure your scanner
NOTE: Xtender will only work in Chrome or Edge browsers as of 10/02/21
NOTE: Was able to get scanning working in Xtender 6-26-2023
Open Firefox browser session
Type in URL https:\\127.0.0.1:49735
Error occurs, this is expected
Click on Advanced option
Click on Accept the risk and proceed
Configuring:
Access Xtender from Banner or Imaging Tools links at https://experience.usd.edu
Start a New Document or New Batch
Name the new document or batch
Click Scanner icon on the toolbar
If prompted to "Allow the web application to access the scanner," choose Allow
If not prompted, enter chrome://flags/#allow-insecure-localhost in the address bar
Change the status to Enabled
Note: Chrome may need to be restarted before the scanner is recognized by Xtender
If the scanner icon still appears greyed out, follow these steps
From the same page, click next to the URL at the at the top of the browser window
Click Site Settings
From the drop down menu next to Insecure content, select Allow
Close settings, and try loading Xtender again
Click your scanner under the ISIS heading
Click OK
Click the scanner icon under Scanner on the toolbar to begin scanning
If this is a shared use computer, please contact the Service Desk with the following information
Name
Phone number
Computer NI number

cause: Captiva stops working and needs to be re-enabled
description: Re-enabling Captiva plugin.
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
The scanner icon is greyed out in Xtender
Environment
Captiva
Web Xtender
Cause
Captiva stops working and needs to be re-enabled
Resolution
Go to https://127.0.0.1:49735/scanservice/v2/getstatus in Chrome
If you receive a Your connection is not private message
Click Advanced
Click Proceed to 127.0.0.1 (unsafe)
Successful installation will show StatusMessage: Success as shown here: {"SessionID":null,"Status":0,"StatusMessage":"Success","Version":"3.0.0.1320","StatusCode":3,"TokenID":null}
Close Chrome
Open Chrome
Go to Xtender through snap.usd.edu
Allow the connection when prompted
If still not prompted to Allow or Deny, go to chrome://flags/#allow-insecure-localhost
Select Enabled next to Allow invalid certificates for resources loaded from localhost.
Restart Chrome and try again
NOTE: If still not prompted and scanner is still greyed out, try to upload a document to the batch manually. Once the scan button turns blue, wait a moment, then click Scan. It should prompt to install drivers for the scanner.

Date and time of deposit
Amount of deposit
Name as it appears on the card used

description: Resolving audio issues on docked Lenovo laptop
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
There is no sound coming from my system
I cannot hear audio from my docked laptop
Environment
Laptop
Lenovo T590
Windows 10
Cause
Mute hotkey has been enabled on the docked laptop. Muting and unmuting audio in Windows has no effect while hotkey is enabled. Incorrect device chosen in sound settings
Resolution
Remove laptop from dock
Press mute hotkey on laptop to unmute device
Note: Specific key may vary by laptop model
Test audio
If sound is still not working right click on the sound icon by the clock
Choose Open Sound Settings
Change the output device and test until you hear sound
If this is a Lenovo laptop
Use a small paperclip to press the button in the tiny hole on the bottom of the laptop

fullText:
Issue/Question
I am unable to use my Flex or Coyote Cash when there is a balance
Why do I have a negative balance on my Flex or Coyote Cash
Environment
Coyote Card
Transact
Flex
Coyote Cash
Papercut
Cause
Negative balances occur when a Coyote Card reader is offline, the funds being deducted from your Coyote Card. Once the reader is back online your account will be charged
Resolution
Note: A negative Coyote Cash balance will prevent you from using your USD Print funds to print
Check your Account Balances for all accounts, Coyote Cash, Flex etc.
If any account is negative balance, you will not be able to use funds until you correct the negative balance
Note: Flex balances cannot be transferred to Coyote Cash
Add money to Coyote Card to bring your account back to 0 or positive balance
Negative balances not corrected within
15 days - if it is a Flex account that is negative, funds removed from Coyote Cash, if funds are available
30 days Any remaining negative balance will be billed to the card holder's university account or withheld from payroll
Balances beyond 30 days are subject to late charges
Under $100 due = $10 fee
$100 -$999 due = $30 fee
More than $1000 = $50 fee
If you have any further questions, please contact the Service Desk with the following information:
First and last name
ID number
Issue you are having

description: Making sure your personal laptop is ready for a board exam (NBME, CCSE, CBSE)
fullText:
Issue/Question
How do I prepare my computer prior to taking a National Board of Medical Examiners (NBME) exam
Environment
Windows
NBME exam
Resolution
Update your laptop
Ensure your laptop can connect to a wired network. Some laptops may need a USB RJ-45 network adapter.
Note: Network cables are provided for exams, Network adapters are not provided
Run NBME Workstation Certification on your laptop:
Go to NBME exam site
Click CONTINUE to download the Secure Browser
Click DOWNLOAD
Follow browser instructions to save and run the installation file
Note: Downloaded file name is PCSecureBrowser.exe
Note: Download a new copy for each exam, Do not use previous versions of the secure browser
Click TEST COMPATIBILITY under Workstation Certification
Click Examinee Personal Laptop Certification
Click I will be taking a web-based exam.
Click Launch Sample Exam
Follow prompts for exam instructions and sample exam
Note: Press Ctrl+Shift+Q to close the browser if needed
If advised, follow steps to bring your personal laptop to the Chief Proctor or Technical Support Staff
If you would like additional assistance, please contact the Service Desk

description: How to check out equipment to users.
fullText:
Issue/Question
How to check out equipment to customers in Cheqroom
Environment
Service Desk
Cheqroom
Resolution
If you are a student, faculty, or staff member wanting to check out equipment, please follow Equipment Checkout, Reserving Equipment, Checking out Hardware to reserve and check out equipment with Cheqroom
CHEQROOM ADMINS ONLY
Open the Cheqroom shortcut on the homescreen of the Service Desk iPad
Sign into Cheqroom using SSO
Note: If the previous user is automatically signed in you will need to close all browsers on the device and re-open the Cheqroom shortcut or a private/incognito browsing window to sign in
Select appropriate Workspace and Location in the top left panel
Locate the user's reservation
Select their reservation
Click Proceed to checkout in the upper right-hand corner
Verify the user's contact phone number
Put in today's date for the signed agreement
Note: The agreement must be signed at every checkout
Click Check out in the upper right hand corner
Click Actions
Select Generate PDF...
Select User Agreement
Note: Direct customer to the Checkout Rules on the desk before they sign
Scroll down and click the pencil icon
Have the user sign the iPad
Select Generate
Provide the user with the needed equipment
Have the user sign into the laptop
Windows - Sign in
Mac OS - Manually create a local account
Log into checkout mac with ITSAdmin account
Click Settings
Click Users and Groups
Click Add User
Enter the ITSAdmin password
Enter the user’s name
Press Tab
Change account name to first.last instead of firstlast
Have the user type in their password into the two fields
Click Create User
Log out of ITSAdmin account
Have the user log in with the created account
Checkout is now complete

Environment
Coyote Cash
Cause
Students, faculty and staff may request a Coyote Cash refund if they have a balance of $10.00 or more and are graduating, withdrawing, or leaving USD
Resolution
The only money that can be refunded is money added by the user, University-added funds cannot be withdrawn
Example: Print Funds cannot be refunded
The following paperwork needs to be completed to obtain a Coyote Cash refund:
Must have a balance of over $10
Coyote Cash refund form
Update your bank information in Self-Service Students
Note: If you have never received a payment from the University, please get in touch with Financial Affairs
Balances of unused Coyote Cash funds will be reconciled in accordance with USD policies
Please email forms to coyoteid@usd.edu or deliver to I D Weeks Library room 104
Please contact the Card Office if you have any questions

sections.text: Students, faculty and staff may request a Coyote Cash refund if they have a balance of $10.00 or more and are graduating, withdrawing, or leaving USD

sections.heading: Resolution
sections.text:
The only money that can be refunded is money added by the user, University-added funds cannot be withdrawn
Example: Print Funds cannot be refunded
The following paperwork needs to be completed to obtain a Coyote Cash refund:
Must have a balance of over $10
Coyote Cash refund form
Update your bank information in Self-Service Students
Note: If you have never received a payment from the University, please get in touch with Financial Affairs
Balances of unused Coyote Cash funds will be reconciled in accordance with USD policies
Please email forms to coyoteid@usd.edu or deliver to I D Weeks Library room 104
Please contact the Card Office if you have any questions

staffOnly.text: Follow Coyote Cash Refund Procedures

title: Requesting Refund of Coyote Cash when Graduating or withdrawing from USD

cause:

User tried to remove the #southdakota from the select email address within Qualtrics
description: Instructions on how to collaborate on Projects or Surveys using Qualtrics
fullText:
Issue/Question
Error Cannot Collaborate with Individuals Outside My Organization
Cannot find Collaborate link in Qualtrics after a survey was collaborated with me
I am having issues with Qualtrics. People are trying to share surveys with me to be a contributor, but I am not seeing them as shared on my account.
Environment
Qualtrics
Cause
User trying to collaborate with is in a different Qualtrics Brand
User tried to remove the #southdakota from the select email address within Qualtrics
Resolution
Look at the URL, the first part tells what brand the account is using ex: southdakota
Check URL of all individuals to determine if all are using the same brand
If all have the same brand then go to Collaborating Inside Your Organization
Note: Do not try to remove the #southdakota from the end of the email address you selected within Qualtrics, the notification link will not be sent, but the person will still be able to see the suveys shared with them when they logon to Qualtrics
If all collaborators are not in the same brand, then follow instructions on How to Collaborate Outside Your Organization
Please contact the Service Desk if you need further information

description: KnowBe4 can save and schedule reports to be sent periodically, so you don't have to remember to log in and check on the status of trainees
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:

Can I get an email notification when new employees complete initial HR training?
Environment
KnowBe4
Cause
Training managers need to be informed about the status of training campaigns in KnowBe4
Resolution
KnowBe4 has instructions for Saving and Sending Reports
For viewing the current status of a campaign, follow Viewing the Status of KnowBe4 Training Campaign
Creating a Saved Report for Periodic Reporting
Log into training.knowbe4.com as a training manager
Click Reports
Click Training Status by Campaign
Under Training Campaigns select the campaign
Under Date Range select the time frame for the report
Click View Report
Note: If nobody was assigned training, made progress on the training, or completed the training during the selected time frame, the report will be empty
Click Save Report
Enter a Saved Report Name
Click to save
Scheduling a Saved Report
Log into training.knowbe4.com as a training manager
Click Reports
Click Saved Reports
Find the report you want to schedule
In the Actions column click
Click Schedule
Set a name for the Scheduled Report
Optionally select a group to receive the report via email
Select a Frequency
Select a Start Time
Choose a Format
Click Submit

description: The Digital Accessibility Committee at USD is tasked to improve, foster, and promote an inclusive online environment for everyone through a comprehensive review and planning process aimed at providing equal access in all digital content across the institution.
footer: Please contact Center for Teaching and Learning for questions related to Accessibility
fullText:
Issue/Question
What is Digital Accessibility
Environment
Digital Accessibility
Resolution
USD is committed to providing an inclusive, accessible environment for everyone. That commitment includes ensuring accessible online content and resources. Digital Accessibility + Universal Design for Learning (UDL) is a design approach to making digital content more accessible to people of all abilities with an emphasis on providing equal access to content for individuals with disabilities. USD policy on digital accessibility
The Digital Accessibility Committee at USD is tasked to improve, foster, and promote an inclusive online environment for everyone through a comprehensive review and planning process aimed at providing equal access in all digital content across the institution
Please review the Digital Accessibility Resource Guide
Resources
Online Instructional Materials
Guidelines for Accessible Documents
Digital Accessibility Resource Guide
PDF Accessibility
Speech-to-Text Best Practices
Workshops and Training Courses
D2L Digital Accessibility Course (self paced and available to faculty and staff-email udl@usd.edu for access)
PDF Extreme Makeover Event (three-week event offered once each semester)
Individual CTL Workshops (offered virtually and in-person)
Digital Accessibility Fundamentals
Document Remediation Basics
Panorama for D2L
Adobe Acrobat Pro
Other training opportunities may be available
Email udl@usd.edu to arrange a training session for your department
Please email ctl@usd.edu to be added to our weekly newsletter list and/or our Digital Accessibility newsletter. All CTL events can be found on the USD calendar as well

description: Steps for others to make a guest deposit to someone else's account . Coyote Cash or Add-on Flex
fullText:
Question
How do I add money to my students' Coyote Card account?
Instructions
Browse to Coyote Card Online
Click Make a guest deposit
Type
Last/Family Name: Students' last name
Card Number: Student ID number
Note: This is not your credit card number
Click Contribute
On the Deposit Information Screen
Select the account you want to deposit funds
USD Coyote Cash
USD Add -On Flex
Enter the amount you want to deposit
Minimum deposit amount: 10.00 USD
Maximum deposit amount: 1,000.00 USD
Click Next
On the Blackboard Payment Gateway
Enter your Credit card information
Enter your billing information
Click Submit - You are NOT charged at this point, your account is verified and money held by your card holder
Note: If you are taken back to the Main screen you were NOT charged, Try a different Internet Browser, Incognito window or clear cache and cookies and start again
On the Confirm Deposit page
Note: You must click Make Deposit before you are charged
Review the information is correct
Beneficiary Information
Last Name
Student ID
Deposit information
Billing Information
Click Make Deposit
On the Receipt for Guest Deposit page, you will see the receipt of deposit
Print this page for your records ~or~
Add email address(s) and click Send Receipt
Need More Help?
If you need further assistance, please contact the Coyote Card Office

fullText:
Issue/Question
Trying to add the Jaggaer Add-in to Word
Error: Office store not available. Unfortunately, your organization has disabled access to the Office Store. Please contact your administrator to request access.
Environment
Jaggaer Contracts Plus
Microsoft Word
Cause
Office Add-ins managed by USD
Resolution
Jaggaer add-in will already show in the Word ribbon. Do not need to add it.
If it does not show follow instructions below
Open Word
Click File
Click Options
Click Customize Ribbon
On right pane click next to Home
Click Home
Click New Group
Click New Group (Custom)
Click Rename...
Type Jaggaer
Click OK
In left pane click the dropdown under Choose commands from:
Click All Commands
Go down to Show Taskpane
Left-click on the one with a red J
Click Add >>
Click OK
Jaggear add-in will appear in Home ribbon

Examsoft

Administer-level device permissions

CPU - Intel or M-Series processor

Not compatible with virtual operating systems such as Microsoft Virtual Machine, Parallels, VMWare

cause: University supervisors may initiate a Telework Plan and Agreement Form, permitting USD employees to enjoy a flexible work arrangement for some or all of their regular work schedule.
description: A how-to guide for complying with security requirements when teleworking
environment:
Home or remote office
University computers, laptops, and mobile devices
fullText:
Issue/Question
How can I comply with security requirements as a teleworker?
Environment
Home or remote office
University computers, laptops, and mobile devices
Cause
University supervisors may initiate a Telework Plan and Agreement Form, permitting USD employees to enjoy a flexible work arrangement for some or all of their regular work schedule.
Resolution
Please read the following procedures to ensure you understand the University of South Dakota’s IT Security Standards, then sign to indicate that you have read, understand, and will adhere to these best practices.
Only use university-issued equipment (e.g., university laptop) for telework, unless the CIO and Vice President approve an alternative arrangement
Note: Alternative arrangements must be reviewed by IT security
Do not take university desktop computers home without first notifying the Service Desk
Do not share university-issued equipment with unauthorized users (e.g., with family members)
Protect equipment from theft
Protect printed materials in your possession from unauthorized access
Adhere to the University Remote Access Policy when remotely logging into university systems
Adhere to the USD Information Security Responsibilities Policy
Store all university information on university-managed services (e.g., OneDrive, SharePoint, Teams) whenever possible
Note: If unsure whether a service is university-managed, contact the Service Desk
Do not use public machines or public networks to log into university systems containing restricted information (i.e., Banner)
Note: Shared computers (e.g., Library, Labs) on campus are not considered “public machines” in this context
Report malicious email messages using the Phish Alert Button (PAB)
Report all IT security breaches or equipment compromises immediately to the Service Desk
Complete USD assigned security awareness training at least annually
Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance

cause: Cognos reports default to HTML display, unless overridden the the report developer to display in another format
description: Cognos output is HTML by default, highlighting data and copying does nothing, the contents of the clipboard is the same as when you ran the report. Pasting will use the contents of the clipboard, NOT your Cognos output
footer: Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance
fullText:
Issue/Question
I ran a Cognos report and I see it on my screen and am attempting to copy a column of data from the report (list of Banner IDs) and paste them into Excel, but it does not paste the correct information to Excel
Environment
Cognos
Microsoft Excel
Cause
Cognos reports default to HTML display, unless overridden the the report developer to display in another format
Resolution
If the report submission screen does NOT have a line across the top stating "This report will be downloaded in Excel format", the output is HTML and will need to be run to Excel to copy the information
With the report output on your screen, click on the white right-facing triangle at the top of the report
Select the 'Run Excel' option
The report will then re-run and put the information into Excel format
The Excel output presentation method varies by browser
Edge will display a list of files with an "Open file" link that will open the Excel file
Chrome will display an icon of the file at the bottom left of the screen that you click on to open the Excel file
Firefox will display a 'file save' dialog where you choose where to save the file and what to name it, then you open that file
After opening the Excel file, you can select the data you want and copy/paste as desired
If the report is already outputting in Excel format, one of the options above will be displayed and you can open the Excel file and copy/paste as desired

cause:
rm: cannot remove ‘folder-without-write/file’: Permission denied
rmdir: failed to remove ‘folder-with-hidden/’: Directory not empty
description: How to diagnose and fix an error when trying to remove a file or folder.
fullText:
Issue/Question
I tried removing a file or folder and it doesn't work
Using rmdir on a folder fails
Removing a file or folder gives me an error message
Environment
Lawrence
HPC
linux
Cause
rm: cannot remove ‘folder-without-write/file’: Permission denied
rmdir: failed to remove ‘folder-with-hidden/’: Directory not empty
Resolution
Use long list to check the permissions
Pass the long, -l, flag (and others if you wish) to ls to make it list the permissions
$ ls -lFah folder-without-write/
total 1.5K
dr-xr-sr-x 2 bill.conn@usd.local jennewein_lab@usd.local 3 Jun 16 10:41 ./
drwxr-sr-x 4 bill.conn@usd.local jennewein_lab@usd.local 4 Jun 16 10:41 ../
-rw-r--r-- 1 bill.conn@usd.local jennewein_lab@usd.local 0 Jun 16 10:41 file
Use the chmod command to attempt to add write permissions to the folder
Note: if you get the error 'Operation not permitted', you need to ask the owner (or the Service Desk) to change the file
chmod +w folder-without-write/
You may now remove the file and folder
rm -rf folder-without-write/
Use long list to check for hidden files
Pass the long, -l, flag (and others if you wish) to ls to make it list the permissions
Note: Files and folders that start with a period ',' are normally 'hidden' during a normal list command
$ ls -lFah folder-with-hidden/
total 1.5K
drwxr-sr-x 3 bill.conn@usd.local jennewein_lab@usd.local 3 Jun 16 10:41 ./
drwxr-sr-x 3 bill.conn@usd.local jennewein_lab@usd.local 3 Jun 16 10:50 ../
drwxr-sr-x 2 bill.conn@usd.local jennewein_lab@usd.local 2 Jun 16 10:41 .git/
Remove the hidden files or hidden directories before removing the original directory
Note: You may need to remove several things before a directory becomes empty
rm -rf folder-with-hidden/.git
Remove the original directory
rmdir folder-with-hidden
Please contact the Service Desk with the following information:
Machine with the issue
Your username on the machine
The file or folder you are having a problem with

USD is committed to helping the Schools, Departments, Faculty, and Staff protect data from breach threats such as physical breaches, electronic breaches, and skimming. These breaches can occur due to human error, physical theft, ransomware, phishing, or even malicious insiders. To improve our security posture and meet complex compliance and regulatory requirements such as The South Dakota Breach Law, FERPA, GDPR, HIPAA we are requesting that ITS supported services be used to share data with external entities. Data sharing is authorized and governed through the current data governance process and it's data stewards.
Both Microsoft Teams and Microsoft Sharepoint are the most universally compliant file sharing and collaborative services that ITS supports. One of those two services should be chosen for file sharing and collaboration with external entities during accreditation activities, with approval from data stewards. Technical controls to protect data in these platforms include:
Restricting view permission on a per file basis
Making files view only
Making files viewable only in web browser and not available in desktop version of Office
Blocking of file downloads
Blocking of printing
Tagging of data as confidential
Alerting of suspicious use of files like bulk downloading
Alerting of use of files from suspicious location
Restricting access to the files or the whole site based on geo-location

description: Details on how to convert PDFs into Word files with Adobe Acrobat PRO
fullText:
Question
How can I convert PDF files into Word documents in a bulk or batch set?
Products or Services Involved
Adobe Acrobat Pro
Microsoft Word
Acrobat Actions
Instructions
Tips:
In some cases it may be easier to share Word files than PDF files
Adobe Acrobat Pro has the ability to convert large sets of PDFs into Word documents using it's Actions Feature
Create a new Convert to Word Action note: this requires Adobe Actobat Pro
From the Home Screen click on See All Tools > Action Wizard, or from Menu go to View > Tools > Action Wizard
Click on New Action
Under Default Option on the right side pane, next to Add Files… click the drop-down arrow and change it to Add Folder… then click on the folder icon above default option to select the folder where all of your files are
Click on Save from the left side pane in the Save & Export section
Click the Add [⊕→] to move it to the right pane
Click on the Specify Settings button to set your Output Options. Make sure you change the output format to “Export File(s) to Alternate Format” and select the desired File Type (Word Document)
Select Save to Local Folder option
Run your new action to bulk change PDFs to Word documents
From the Home Screen click on See All Tools > Action Wizard, or from Menu go to View > Tools > Action Wizard
Click on the action you want to run from the right-side pane. Ex. PDF to Word
You can view the files from your folder, and once you're ready click on Start
While the batch action is running you will notice Adobe is opening the files to process them.
You will need to keep Adobe open, but you can continue to work on your computer as the batch runs in the background
You can click on Stop if you need to stop the process, and can click on Resume to pick up where it left off
Once the batch action is done, the button on the right-side pane will say Completed and you can view a Full Report of the actions and time it took to complete if needed
Need More Help?
If you need further assistance, please contact the Service Desk

Click on View

description: Classify and protect documents in bulk, generally for upload to a Microsoft Teams site.
environment:
Office
Word, Excel, Powerpoint
PDF
Restricted
Data Classification
Internal Users
External Users
fullText:
Issue/Question
How do I restrict or encrypt a document to protect it
How do I restrict or encrypt a large group of documents in bulk
Environment
Office
Word, Excel, Powerpoint
PDF
Restricted
Data Classification
Internal Users
External Users
Cause
Sensitive or Restricted data can be protected by applying Microsoft Sensitivity Labels to documents. Data Stewards at USD may opt to secure privileged data in this way. Current versions of Office, Purview Information Protection Viewer, Adobe Acrobat and Adobe Acrobat Reader support the ability to label and read these types of secured files. Older versions of some software may not support this feature and you will need to upgrade or update the program to view the data.
Resolution
Make sure you have installed the latest version of Purview Information Protection Client
Open File Explorer and Select a group of files to protect
Right-click and select Classify and Protect
Sign-in with your USD account, if prompted
Set the label on the file to restricted, this encrypts the file and
Makes files read-only
Disables printing
Disables screenshots
Disables editing
Disables save-as
Disables export-as
Select the customer permission level of Viewer
Give users permission to the view the file
Click the address book icon to select users or groups from the USD address book
Add lists of users internal and external using the format below
john@contoso.com ; sales@contoso.com ; fabrikam.com ; etc
Add the group of a Microsoft Teams site to make a dynamic user list that changes as you change membership of your Microsoft Teams site
Set an expiration date for access to the files
Select Apply to finalize
Upload the newly protected documents to your Team Site or share them as authorized by Data Stewards.
NOTE: Once files have been classified and protected, permission changes require that steps 3-10 be repeated. This includes uploading the documents again.
Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance

description: How do I classify a document?
environment:
Office
Word, Excel, Powerpoint
Outlook
Restricted
Data Classification
Internal Users
External Users
fullText:
Issue/Question
How do I label or set the classification on a file to protect it
Environment
Office
Word, Excel, Powerpoint
Outlook
Restricted
Data Classification
Internal Users
External Users
Cause
Sensitive or Restricted data can be protected by applying Microsoft Sensitivity Labels to documents. Current versions of Office support the ability to label and read these types of secured files. Older versions of some software may not support this feature and you will need to upgrade or update the program to view the data. USD will auto-classify data if it is not manually classified.
Resolution
Make sure you have the latest version of Office 365 installed
On the Home Tab, or the Message tab if you are using Outlook, click the Sensitivity button
Set the sensitivity label on the file to Public, Internal, or Restricted. This sets the sensitivity of the file and allows for automated data loss prevention.
OR
On the title bar of the app next to the file name in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint click the No Label button.
Set the sensitivity label on the file to Public, Internal, or Restricted. This sets the sensitivity of the file and allows for automated data loss prevention.
Depending on the content of the file labels may be applied automatically. You may see something like the following.
If the sensitivity label applied to the file is incorrect it can be changed. If it is being changed to a less restrictive label justification may be required.
Removal of labels entirely is not permitted. All files and data at USD need to be labeled and classified.
Please contact the Service Desk if you need further assistance

Environment
Windows
BitLocker
Microsoft Account
Cause
A change in the BIOS can prompt BitLocker to request a recovery key

The BitLocker recovery key can be found by going to Microsoft's recovery key site and logging in with the Microsoft account tied to this device

There may be one or more devices or keys listed, but choose the desired device, and start with the most recent key
Note: It will be listed under Recovery Key and is a 48-digit key

fullText:
Issue/Question
You have either already completed the survey or your session has expired
Survey shows results but no results can be retrieved
Environment
Qualtrics
Cause
Some settings in the survey may need changed
Resolution
Troubleshooting Errors in Qualtrics
Click in upper right corner of screen
Click Open in New Tab at bottom of popup window at the right
Type the error message in the search box at top of screen
Read through help documentation for suggestions to issue
Try suggestions if it applies
If Survey shows responses but cannot download or view responses
When under Data & Analysis it shows Recorded responses (0/35) or something similar and the main screen says The responses you are looking for do not exist there is some sort of latency occurring
Click Survey
Cick Survey Flow icon to the left hover over it will say Survey flow
Click +Add a New Element Here
Click Embedded Data
Click in dropdown and type reindex
Click Apply
Click on Data & Analysis at the top and the data should now be there
If none of the suggestions help then
Please contact the Service Desk with the following information:
Error message
Survey name
Survey Owner

description: What is the D2L Navigation Bar?
fullText:
Question
What is the D2L Navigation Bar?
Answer
The Navigation Bar is found at the top of your screen and contains global links. These links will be displayed in the same location and format throughout D2L. The following are commonly used:
My Home: This link is a shortcut back to the My Home page. The shortcut is displayed as a house icon.
Select a course: This shortcut is displayed as a waffle shaped icon. There is a quick course selector located in the minibar. Users can use this to select a different course without going back to the My Home page. Users can also pin favorite classes to the course selector pull-down menu. This shortcut is displayed as a waffle shaped icon.
Message Alerts: Displayed as an envelope icon. This link lets you access D2L email, as well as the Pager
Subscription Alerts: The subscription tool is used to subscribe to discussion, dropbox, or quiz alerts. This shortcut is displayed as a multiple message text box icon
Update Alerts: This link allows you to view any discussion, dropbox, or quiz alerts (If you have subscribed to receive these alerts). This shortcut is displayed as a bell icon
Admin Tools: Grants access to User Related, Organization Related, and ePortfolio (not commonly used)
In addition, in the upper left-hand corner of the screen, you have 5 additional options:
Self-Registration: if you have not been instructed to use this option, you will not need to. This allows you to self-register for courses that have been open to the public. Note that you probably will not be receiving course credit for these courses unless you have been instructed otherwise
Reports: Any reports you have submitted
Help: D2L Student Guides, Instructor Guides, Ally Course Report, and Ally Department Report
Quick Eval: View submission and activities done by students
Insights Portal: Allows faculty to look further into Adoption, Engagement and Assessment Quality
For more information about D2L basics and course setup, please go to the full tutorial from the CTL here: D2L 1
If you need further assistance, please click the CTL Support Request button on this page

title: My Home page on D2L

answer:
The My Home page contains 5 widgets:
News
My Settings
My Courses
Calendar,
Respondus
My Settings: Displays your name, profile picture, and five optional settings:
Profile: Create and edit a profile that will be visible to other D2L users (especially important for online instructors)
Account Settings: Change password, the font (only displayed to you), time zone, and other various account settings
Notifications: Determines how D2L sends notifications to faculty
Email address: allows you to change your existing email address (USD primary should be used)
Locker: The locker tool is a place where users can store and retrieve files. Files in a personal locker are not accessible to others unless they are made public. Files stored in the locker can be accessed from any course. We recommend using Manage Files instead.
My Courses: This widget displays all of the courses for which you are currently enrolled. If you are enrolled in more than twelve courses, there is a View All Coursees (20+) link at the bottom of the page.
Calendar: the calendar tool can be used to link course-related events and store personal events.
News: This tool is used to communicate updates, changes, and new information to all D2L users from SDBOR. This widget cannot be edited on your "My Home" page, but you will be able to utilize a similar widget and feature within your individual courses that can be edited to reflect your course
Respondus: Contains the tool to import assessments questions into your D2L course
For more information about D2L basics and course setup, please view the full tutorial from the CTL here: D2L 1
If you need further assistance, please click the CTL Support Request button on this page

title: Settings in D2L

answer:
For each discussion topic, in each of a user’s courses, users can elect to receive email notification alerts. For example, an instructor may want to receive an instant email alert whenever a student posts to a discussion topic. Instructors may also decide to subscribe to a discussion topic for a specific period of time; for example, an instructor who is traveling may want to receive email alerts when students post in that week’s discussion assignment since s/he will have limited D2L access. In any case, it is not recommended to subscribe to all discussions for an entire course due to the excessive email volume that will follow.
Go to the Discussions page
Click on Subscribe within the drop-down menu to the right of the topic you wish to subscribe to
In the Customize Notifications window, specify whether you want to receive an email immediately after a post is made (click Send me an instant notification) or whether you want to receive an email once per day with a list of all posts that were made for the day (click Include in my summary of activity)
Click the Subscribe button
Repeat steps 1 through 3 to subscribe to other discussions
Alternatively, select a topic and click the Subscribe star icon below the topic title
For more information about Communication and Personal Tools, please view the full tutorial from the CTL here: D2L 3
If you need further assistance, please click the CTL Support Request button on this page

answer:
To enable Monitor, click on Require Respondus LockDown Browser for this exam
This will prompt you to choose which Proctoring option you would like to
Don't require proctoring for this exam
Require Respondus Monitor (automated proctoring) for this exam - Students are recorded during the exam. Suspicious events are flagged, and the instructor can view the video after the exam is submitted. Faculty have the option to select from the following options when using Respondus monitor:
Webcam Only - Recordings will only include the student's face and environment
Webcam + Screen - Recordings will include the student's face/environment and their screen during the exam
Screen Only - Recordings will only include the student's screen during the exam
Allow instructor live proctoring for this exam (via Zoom, Teams, etc) - the instructor watches students remotely during an online test. This feature requires the use of a video conference system such as Zoom or MS Teams. Students are not recorded, and the instructor is not alerted to suspicious activity.
Next select the items to be included in the Startup Sequence, which includes the steps a student must complete prior to the start of an exam. Clicking Preview will allow you to see what the step will look like as the student will see it. Notice each step must be fulfilled prior to taking the exam.
Next, select the Face Detection Options preferred for the exam. Both boxes are checked by default as the recommended setting.
Advanced Settings: These allow additional features that work under Respondus Monitor and include the follwowing options:
Allow use of an iPad for this exam - allows students to complete the assessment using an iPad
Allow switching to another application during the assessment - allows students to use an appilcation version of either Microsoft Excel or Microsoft Word during the exam
Allow this exam to additionally be delivered in a proctored lab - allows students the option of taking the exam with a proctor (e.g., the USD Testing Center). NOTE: If selecting this option, please ensure there is a password in the Password Settings section of the LockDown Browser Settings.
Enable "Show Your Work" step at end of exam - allows students to show pages of work at the end using photos taken with their webcam. This work can be reviewed by faculty when grading exams.
Second Camera: This options requires students to use a second camera in addition to the webcam on their computer. NOTE: Students will need to be notified in advance and provide explicit instructions for how to set up the second camera if faculty elect this option.
For more information about Respondus Lockdown Browser, please view the full tutorial from the CTL here: LockDown Browser
If you need further assistance, please click the CTL Support Request button on this page

sections.text: How do I enable Respondus Monitor for a D2L exam?

sections.heading: Answer
sections.text:
To enable Monitor, click on Require Respondus LockDown Browser for this exam
This will prompt you to choose which Proctoring option you would like to
Don't require proctoring for this exam
Require Respondus Monitor (automated proctoring) for this exam - Students are recorded during the exam. Suspicious events are flagged, and the instructor can view the video after the exam is submitted. Faculty have the option to select from the following options when using Respondus monitor:
Webcam Only - Recordings will only include the student's face and environment
Webcam + Screen - Recordings will include the student's face/environment and their screen during the exam
Screen Only - Recordings will only include the student's screen during the exam
Allow instructor live proctoring for this exam (via Zoom, Teams, etc) - the instructor watches students remotely during an online test. This feature requires the use of a video conference system such as Zoom or MS Teams. Students are not recorded, and the instructor is not alerted to suspicious activity.
Next select the items to be included in the Startup Sequence, which includes the steps a student must complete prior to the start of an exam. Clicking Preview will allow you to see what the step will look like as the student will see it. Notice each step must be fulfilled prior to taking the exam.
Next, select the Face Detection Options preferred for the exam. Both boxes are checked by default as the recommended setting.
Advanced Settings: These allow additional features that work under Respondus Monitor and include the follwowing options:
Allow use of an iPad for this exam - allows students to complete the assessment using an iPad
Allow switching to another application during the assessment - allows students to use an appilcation version of either Microsoft Excel or Microsoft Word during the exam
Allow this exam to additionally be delivered in a proctored lab - allows students the option of taking the exam with a proctor (e.g., the USD Testing Center). NOTE: If selecting this option, please ensure there is a password in the Password Settings section of the LockDown Browser Settings.
Enable "Show Your Work" step at end of exam - allows students to show pages of work at the end using photos taken with their webcam. This work can be reviewed by faculty when grading exams.
Second Camera: This options requires students to use a second camera in addition to the webcam on their computer. NOTE: Students will need to be notified in advance and provide explicit instructions for how to set up the second camera if faculty elect this option.
For more information about Respondus Lockdown Browser, please view the full tutorial from the CTL here: LockDown Browser
If you need further assistance, please click the CTL Support Request button on this page

title: Google Docs settings

answer:
There are different ways of getting started using Google documents: you can create a new online document, you can upload an existing one, or you can use a template from our templates gallery.
To Create a New Document, go to your Documents List, click the +New button.
As soon as you name the document or start typing, Google Docs will automatically save your work every few seconds. At the top of the document, you'll see text indicating that your document is saving. Once the changes to the documents have been made or when you are done typing, the text at the top will read All changes saved.
To Save a Copy of a document to your computer, you can download it. In your document, go to the File menu and point your mouse to the Download option. Click one of the following file types: HTML (zipped), RTF, Microsoft Word, PDF, and plain text. Your document will download to your computer.
For more information about Google Docs, please view the full tutorial from the CTL here: Google Docs

answer:
Google Docs allows you to upload and store files in the cloud. You can upload both files and folders, including an array of file types ranging from document types to image types to video formats. Here are some of the things you can do when you upload files or folders to Google Docs:
Access your files and folders from any computer, anywhere in the world by signing into Google Docs. The only requirement is that you have an Internet connection.
Share files and folders with friends, family members or colleagues, allowing them to view the files in the Google Docs Viewer.
Convert files to Google Docs format and collaboratively edit these files online.
Upload photos and videos to view or share.

title: Choosing To Work With Google Docs

answer:
Uploaded files have the same privacy and security as any of your other documents in Google Docs. Additionally, the default visibility setting for uploaded files is Private.
An uploaded file or folder can be up to 10GB. If you’d like to convert a file to Google Docs format, the size limit depends on the file type. Learn more about size limits in Google Docs.
You can share any uploaded file with another person. If you’ve converted that file to Google Docs format, you can also collaborate on that doc in real-time with other people. Google Cloud Connect is also an option if you'd like to collaborate on a Microsoft Office document.
For more information about Google Docs, please view the full tutorial from the CTL here: Google Docs

title: Commonly Asked Google Docs Questions

answer:
You can upload existing documents to Google documents at any time. When you're uploading, you can either keep your document in its original file type or convert it to Google Docs format. Converting your document to Google Docs format allows you to edit and collaborate online from any computer.
Note: Compatibility differences between Microsoft Word and Google Docs may cause issues with formatting and line spacing
You can upload the following file types:
.html
.txt
.odt
.rtf
.doc and .docx
To upload a document, you will first need to be on Google Drive. Follow these steps to do that:
On your address bar, type: http://docs.usd.edu
Follow these steps to upload a document
Click New icon in the top left of your Documents List
Click File Upload
Click the document you'd like to upload
Click Open
It will upload it as a Microsoft Word document
Click on Open with Google Docs if you'd like to be able to edit and collaborate on the document online
Note: Uploaded document files that are converted to Google documents format can't be larger than 1 MB
The uploaded file will appear in your Documents List as a Google Doc

title: Google Docs Margins

answer:
You can change indentations at the paragraph level. To adjust indentations across several paragraphs, select the relevant text and adjust the specific indent.
First line indent: This small rectangle on the ruler adjusts the beginning position of a paragraph and can be changed for each paragraph.
Left indent: The leftmost indent adjusts the second and subsequent lines of a paragraph; this indent is controlled by dragging the downward facing triangle along the ruler.
Right indent: This indent, the rightmost downward facing triangle, adjusts how far toward the right side of a page a particular paragraph extends.

title: Indents in Google Docs

answer:
Like indents, tab stops affect documents at the specific paragraph level. Each tab stop determines how text is aligned relative to it: a left tab stop left aligns particular text to the tab stop, a center tab stop center-aligns it, and a right tab stop right aligns that text. To add a tab stop, just click anywhere in the ruler and select a tab stop. You can move text between tab stops affecting the same line by pressing the Tab key on your keyboard.
For more information about Google Docs, please view the full tutorial from the CTL here: Google Docs

description: How do I use the Paint Format tool in Google Docs
fullText:
Question
What is the Paint Format tool in Google Docs?
How do I use the Paint Format tool in Google Docs?
Instructions
Google documents lets you copy the formatting you’ve applied to a specific section of text to another section using the paint format tool. If you’re familiar with the paint format tool in Google spreadsheets, this works in a similar manner.
To use this tool, click in the text that's formatted in the way that you want to copy. Then, click the paintbrush icon in your toolbar, and click in the text to which you want to apply the formatting. The formatting from the original text will be copied to the selected text.
To change the formatting in multiple places within your document, double-click the paintbrush icon. You'll enter a mode that lets you highlight multiple text selections, and apply the same formatting to each selection. When you're done applying formatting to these selections, click the paintbrush icon again.
You can also use the paint format tool with keyboard shortcuts. Ctrl+Option+C (Cmd+Option+C for Mac) will copy just the formatting of the text you've selected, not the actual text and Ctrl+Option+V (Cmd+Option+V for Mac) will apply that formatting to a different text selection.
Need More Help?
For more information about Google Docs, please view the full tutorial from the CTL here: Google Docs

Comments are a handy way of adding notes to your regular document text and are visible to viewers and collaborators. These can be valuable for communicating with collaborators about specific parts of the document, as well as making notes about changes you've made or would like to make. When you publish your document as a web page or print it, the comments will disappear.
To add a comment to your document, follow these instructions:
Place your cursor where you'd like your comment to appear or highlight text that you'd like to comment on.
Go to the Insert menu and click the comment.
Or when you have the text highlighted a Add a comment option should pop up on the right hand side of your document.
Click the Comment icon. You can also use the keyboard shortcut Ctrl+Alt+M (Cmd+ Option+ M for Mac) to insert a comment.
Type your comment in the box that appears to the right of the document, and press the “Comment” button
There is also an option to make a suggestion on the document. You highlight the text you want to make a suggestion about, and the comment button and suggestion button will pop up. The suggestion button is green.
To resolve a comment or discussion thread, click the comment and click Resolve.
To view the comment history on a thread, including resolved comments, click the Comments drop-down menu in the upper right of your document, and click Show comment stream.
For more information about Google Docs, please view the full tutorial from the CTL here: Google Docs
If you need further assistance, please click the CTL Support Request button on this page.

When you are working in Google Docs it is constantly saving the changes you are making. The great thing about Google Docs is that if you make changes on Monday and then you make changes on Friday, you can later decide to restore the Monday changes to the actual document. To restore an older version of your document, go to File and click See version history.
When you click on this the See version history a dialog box will appear on the right hand side and you will see a list of changes that were made, who made the changes, and the date and time the changes were made. You can click on the older versions to see which changes were made. There are three dots on the right hand side of the different versions and this allows you to name that version or to make a copy of it. If you make a copy of it this will create a new document in your drive containing the content from that version of the document you were on.
If you want to restore an older version of the document click on the version you would like to restore and click on three vertical dots to the right of it. Then click Restore this version, then click Restore.
For more information about Google Docs, please view the full tutorial from the CTL here: Google Docs

Now that you've created your Google document, you can share it with your friends, family, or coworkers. You can do this directly from the document.
Click the box Share at the top right of your document. Then, type the email addresses of people you want to share your document with. You can add a single person or a mailing list.
To the right of the list of names, click Can view, Can edit, or Can comment from the drop-down menu.
If you'd like to add a message to your invitation, click Add message and enter some text.
Click Send. To skip sending an invitation, unselect the option Notify people. Your collaborators and viewers will still be able to access the document from their Documents List, but won't receive an email invitation.
In the Sharing settings dialog, you can also see who has access to your document, change the level of access people have, remove editors, commentators, and viewers, and change your document's visibility option.

title: Chatting With Others on a Shared Google Doc

answer:
You can share your docs with just the people you want, and you can specify exactly what level of access (view or edit) each person has.
Here's how to add specific editors and viewers:
Open the doc you want to share.
Click Share in the upper-right corner of the doc.
At the bottom of the Sharing settings window, under Add people, type the email addresses of the people you want to share with.
To the right of the list of names, choose Can view or Can edit from the drop-down menu.
Two quick options to consider (to share with default settings, feel free to skip this note):
By default, people who can edit your doc will also be able to share it with additional people. You can remove that ability by clicking Change next to Editors will be allowed to add people... before you click Share.
By default, everyone you share a doc with will get an invitation email. If you'd rather not notify them, deselect the Send notifications box. They'll have access the next time they sign in.
Keep in mind that when you email a link to someone to share it with they can forward the link on to someone else and then that person will have access to your document. If you see someone who has access to your document and you want to remove them you as the owner of the document have the ability to remove them.
For more information about Google Docs, please view the full tutorial from the CTL here: Google Docs
If you need further assistance, please click the CTL Support Request button on this page.

Offline access is allowed on a computer-by-computer basis. In other words, you must allow offline access for each individual computer where you'd like to view your documents and spreadsheets without an Internet connection. Docs you create and files you upload have some limits built in.
Documents: 1,024,000 characters, regardless of the number of pages or font size. Uploaded document files that are converted to Google documents format can’t be larger than 2MB.
Spreadsheets: 400,000 cells, with a maximum of 256 columns per sheet. Uploaded spreadsheet files that are converted to Google spreadsheets format can’t be larger than 20MB, and need to be under 400,000 cells and 256 columns per sheet.
If you're close to exceeding size limits, you'll see a message at the top of your spreadsheet that indicates which limit you're about to reach:
Number of Cells: Total of 400,000 cells across all sheets
Number of Columns: 256 columns per sheet
Number of Formulas: 40,000 cells containing formulas
Number of Tabs: 200 sheets per workbook
GoogleFinance formulas: 1,000 GoogleFinance formulas
GoogleLookup formulas: 1,000 GoogleLookup formulas
ImportRange formulas: 50 cross-workbook reference formulas
ImportData, ImportHtml, ImportFeed, or ImportXml formulas: 50 functions for external data
Complexity: VLOOKUP and HLOOKUP formulas tend to be more complex than other functions, and may slow down your spreadsheet. After getting data points through VLOOKUP and HLOOKUP, try re-pasting them as "values only" to reduce spreadsheet size
These size limits also affect the spreadsheets that collect form responses (for example, if you send a survey). To determine the number of responses that a form can take, you need to take into account the number of questions in your form and the number of other cells of data in your spreadsheet.
Presentations: Presentations created in Google Docs can be up to 10MB -- which is about 200 slides. Uploaded presentation files that are converted into Google presentations format can also be up to 10MB.
Drawings: We’ve never seen anyone make a drawing that was too big (but that’s not a dare).
Other files: Files that you upload but don’t convert to Google Docs format can be up to 10GB each.
This upload limit is larger than the free storage space given to each Google Docs user. Every user is given 1GB of free storage space for files, and can purchase additional Google Docs storage to upload larger files.
For more information about Google Docs, please view the full tutorial from the CTL here: Google Docs
If you need further assistance, please click the CTL Support Request button on this page.

Free storage space is specific to each product. Free storage from one product cannot be used by or transferred to another product.
Gmail provides 7+ GB (and counting) for Gmail messages.
Docs provides 1 GB for your uploaded files (documents created in Google Docs and converted files don't count towards your storage, but do have some size limitations).
Picasa Web provides 1 GB for photos and videos. Files under certain sizes don't count towards this limit. This limit applies to photos uploaded to Picasa Web Albums and photos uploaded at original size to Google+ from the Picasa 3.9 software.
Google+ provides unlimited storage for photos uploaded in Google+, which are automatically resized to 2048 pixels. Videos up to 15 minutes in length are also free.
For more information about Google Docs, please view the full tutorial from the CTL here: Google Docs
If you need further assistance, please click the CTL Support Request button on this page.

You're able to view Google documents and spreadsheets even when you don't have an Internet connection. This is particularly useful when you're on an airplane or train without wireless Internet.
Here are some important notes about using Google Docs when you're offline:
You'll need to Set up Docs offline from your Documents List to start accessing your documents and spreadsheets without an Internet connection.
Offline access is available in Chrome only.
Offline access is available only for documents and spreadsheets. Presentations, drawings and other items from your Documents List are not available offline at this time.
Documents and spreadsheets are only available in view-only mode. You must restore your Internet connection to make any edits.
You can't create new documents and spreadsheets while you're offline.
You'll need to allow offline access separately on each computer where you want to view your Google Docs offline.
For more information about Google Docs, please view the full tutorial from the CTL here: Google Docs
If you need further assistance, please click the CTL Support Request button on this page.

Grackle Docs is a third-party add-on in Google Chrome that automatically checks 22 criteria against WCAG 2.0 and accessible PDF standards. It uses a wizard to guide the content author to make an accessible Google Doc that can also be exported to an accessible PDF.
Grackle Docs creates unlimited conversions to a tagged PDF from a Google Doc.
It features an Alt Text Catalog feature that allows you to build a collection of images and the related Alt-Text. This is a time-saver compared to re-entering alt-text each time an image is added.
Users can copy and paste sections of a Google document to and from other documents, maintaining accessibility tags.
Users can set document properties of a PDF file when it is created.
It also has a built-in wizard for table tagging.
For more information about Grackle Docs, please view the full tutorial from the CTL here: Grackle Docs
If you need further assistance, please click the CTL Support Request button on this page.

Headings should be used. To set headings in your document, use the Styles feature on the toolbar ribbon. Click the down down arrow next to Normal text to access heading styles.
Grackle Docs recommends that a single Heading 1 (H1) tag be used in the document, but multiple H1 tags can be used regardless of the warning.
Headings should be properly nested. It is recommended that headings are properly nested. H1, H2, H3, paragraph text, etc., in that order. However, it is acceptable to use an H1, H2, H3 repeated sequence throughout the document in order to have a consistent Table of Contents if that feature is being used.
